verses.textZh: 耶稣基督的启示，就是神赐给他，叫他把快要发生的事指示他的众仆人。他就差派天使显示给他的仆人约翰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣基督的启示，就是神赐给他，叫他把快要发生的事指示他的众仆人。他就差派天使显示给他的仆人约翰。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣基督的启示，就是神赐给他，叫他将必要快成的事指示他的众仆人。他就差遣使者晓谕他的仆人约翰。
verses.textEnNiv: The revelation from Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show his servants what must soon take place. He made it known by sending his angel to his servant John,
verses.textEnEsv: The revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things that must soon take place. He made it known by sending his angel to his servant John,
verses.textEnNkjv: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants—things which must shortly take place. And He sent and signified it by His angel to His servant John,
verses.textEnNlt: This is a revelation from Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show his servants the events that must soon take place. He sent an angel to present this revelation to his servant John,
verses.textEnNasb: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show to His bond-servants, the things which must soon take place; and He sent and communicated it by His angel to His bond-servant John,
verses.textEn: The revelation from Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show his servants what must soon take place. He made it known by sending his angel to his servant John,

verses.textZh: 约翰把神的道，和耶稣基督的见证，凡是自己所看见的，都见证出来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰把神的道，和耶稣基督的见证，凡是自己所看见的，都见证出来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰便将神的道和耶稣基督的见证，凡自己所看见的都证明出来。
verses.textEnNiv: who testifies to everything he saw—that is, the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: who bore witness to the word of God and to the testimony of Jesus Christ, even to all that he saw.
verses.textEnNkjv: who bore witness to the word of God, and to the testimony of Jesus Christ, to all things that he saw.
verses.textEnNlt: who faithfully reported everything he saw. This is his report of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: who testified to the word of God and to the testimony of Jesus Christ, everything that he saw.
verses.textEn: who testifies to everything he saw—that is, the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 读这书上预言的人，和那些听见这预言并且遵守书中记载的人，都是有福的！因为时候近了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 读这书上预言的人，和那些听见这预言并且遵守书中记载的人，都是有福的！因为时候近了。
verses.textZhCuv: 念这书上预言的和那些听见又遵守其中所记载的，都是有福的，因为日期近了。
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear it and take to heart what is written in it, because the time is near.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear, and who keep what is written in it, for the time is near.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written in it; for the time is near.
verses.textEnNlt: God blesses the one who reads the words of this prophecy to the church, and he blesses all who listen to its message and obey what it says, for the time is near.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is the one who reads, and those who hear the words of the prophecy and keep the things which are written in it; for the time is near.
verses.textEn: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear it and take to heart what is written in it, because the time is near.

verses.textZh: 约翰写信给在亚西亚的七个教会。愿恩惠平安，从那位今在、昔在、以后要来的神，从他宝座前的七灵，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰写信给在亚西亚的七个教会。愿恩惠平安，从那位今在、昔在、以后要来的神，从他宝座前的七灵，
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰写信给亚细亚的七个教会。但愿从那昔在、今在、以后永在的神，和他宝座前的七灵，
verses.textEnNiv: John, To the seven churches in the province of Asia: Grace and peace to you from him who is, and who was, and who is to come, and from the seven spirits before his throne,
verses.textEnEsv: John to the seven churches that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from him who is and who was and who is to come, and from the seven spirits who are before his throne,
verses.textEnNkjv: John, to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from Him who is and who was and who is to come, and from the seven Spirits who are before His throne,
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from John to the seven churches in the province of Asia. Grace and peace to you from the one who is, who always was, and who is still to come; from the sevenfold Spirit before his throne;
verses.textEnNasb: John to the seven churches that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from Him who is, and who was, and who is to come, and from the seven spirits who are before His throne,
verses.textEn: John, To the seven churches in the province of Asia: Grace and peace to you from him who is, and who was, and who is to come, and from the seven spirits before his throne,

verses.textZh: 又从那信实的见证人、死人中首先复生的、地上众君王的统治者耶稣基督临到你们。 他爱我们，用自己的血把我们从我们的罪中释放出来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从那信实的见证人、死人中首先复生的、地上众君王的统治者耶稣基督临到你们。 他爱我们，用自己的血把我们从我们的罪中释放出来，
verses.textZhCuv: 并那诚实作见证的、从死里首先复活、为世上君王元首的耶稣基督，有恩惠、平安归与你们！ 他爱我们，用自己的血使我们脱离 罪恶，
verses.textEnNiv: and from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us and has freed us from our sins by his blood,
verses.textEnEsv: and from Jesus Christ the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of kings on earth. To him who loves us and has freed us from our sins by his blood
verses.textEnNkjv: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler over the kings of the earth. To Him who loved us and washed us from our sins in His own blood,
verses.textEnNlt: and from Jesus Christ. He is the faithful witness to these things, the first to rise from the dead, and the ruler of all the kings of the world. All glory to him who loves us and has freed us from our sins by shedding his blood for us.
verses.textEnNasb: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and released us from our sins by His blood—
verses.textEn: and from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us and has freed us from our sins by his blood,

verses.textZh: 又使我们成为国度，作他父神的祭司。愿荣耀权能都归给他，直到永永远远。阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又使我们成为国度，作他父神的祭司。愿荣耀权能都归给他，直到永永远远。阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 又使我们成为国民，作他父神的祭司。但愿荣耀、权能归给他，直到永永远远。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: and has made us to be a kingdom and priests to serve his God and Father—to him be glory and power for ever and ever! Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: and made us a kingdom, priests to his God and Father, to him be glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: and has made us kings and priests to His God and Father, to Him be glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: He has made us a Kingdom of priests for God his Father. All glory and power to him forever and ever! Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: and He made us into a kingdom, priests to His God and Father—to Him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
verses.textEn: and has made us to be a kingdom and priests to serve his God and Father—to him be glory and power for ever and ever! Amen.

verses.textZh: 看哪，他驾着云降临， 每一个人都要看见他， 连那些刺过他的人也要看见他， 地上的万族都要因他哀号。 这是必定的，阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，他驾着云降临， 每一个人都要看见他， 连那些刺过他的人也要看见他， 地上的万族都要因他哀号。 这是必定的，阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，他驾云降临！ 众目要看见他， 连刺他的人也要看见他； 地上的万族都要因他哀哭。 这话是真实的。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: "Look, he is coming with the clouds," and "every eye will see him, even those who pierced him"; and all peoples on earth "will mourn because of him." So shall it be! Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, even those who pierced him, and all tribes of the earth will wail on account of him. Even so. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, He is coming with clouds, and every eye will see Him, even they who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him. Even so, Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Look! He comes with the clouds of heaven. And everyone will see him— even those who pierced him. And all the nations of the world will mourn for him. Yes! Amen!
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him, even those who pierced Him; and all the tribes of the earth will mourn over Him. So it is to be. Amen.
verses.textEn: "Look, he is coming with the clouds," and "every eye will see him, even those who pierced him"; and all peoples on earth "will mourn because of him." So shall it be! Amen.

verses.textZh: 主神说："我是阿拉法，我是俄梅格；我是今在、昔在、以后要来，全能的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 主神说："我是阿拉法，我是俄梅格；我是今在、昔在、以后要来，全能的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 主神说：「我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛 ，是昔在、今在、以后永在的全能者。」
verses.textEnNiv: "I am the Alpha and the Omega," says the Lord God, "who is, and who was, and who is to come, the Almighty."
verses.textEnEsv: "I am the Alpha and the Omega," says the Lord God, "who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty."
verses.textEnNkjv: "I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End," says the Lord, "who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty."
verses.textEnNlt: "I am the Alpha and the Omega—the beginning and the end," says the Lord God. "I am the one who is, who always was, and who is still to come—the Almighty One."
verses.textEnNasb: "I am the Alpha and the Omega," says the Lord God, "who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty."
verses.textEn: "I am the Alpha and the Omega," says the Lord God, "who is, and who was, and who is to come, the Almighty."

verses.textZh: 我约翰，就是你们的弟兄，在耶稣里跟你们一同分享患难、国度和忍耐的，为了神的道和耶稣的见证，曾经在那名叫拔摩的海岛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我约翰，就是你们的弟兄，在耶稣里跟你们一同分享患难、国度和忍耐的，为了神的道和耶稣的见证，曾经在那名叫拔摩的海岛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我－约翰就是你们的弟兄，和你们在耶稣的患难、国度、忍耐里一同有分，为神的道，并为给耶稣作的见证，曾在那名叫拔摩的海岛上。
verses.textEnNiv: I, John, your brother and companion in the suffering and kingdom and patient endurance that are ours in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: I, John, your brother and partner in the tribulation and the kingdom and the patient endurance that are in Jesus, was on the island called Patmos on account of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: I, John, both your brother and companion in the tribulation and kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was on the island that is called Patmos for the word of God and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: I, John, am your brother and your partner in suffering and in God’s Kingdom and in the patient endurance to which Jesus calls us. I was exiled to the island of Patmos for preaching the word of God and for my testimony about Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: I, John, your brother and fellow participant in the tribulation and kingdom and perseverance in Jesus, was on the island called Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.
verses.textEn: I, John, your brother and companion in the suffering and kingdom and patient endurance that are ours in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.

verses.textZh: 有一个主日，我在灵里，听见在我后边有一个大声音，好象号筒的响声，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个主日，我在灵里，听见在我后边有一个大声音，好象号筒的响声，
verses.textZhCuv: 当主日，我被圣灵感动，听见在我后面有大声音如吹号，说：
verses.textEnNiv: On the Lord’s Day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,
verses.textEnEsv: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet
verses.textEnNkjv: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s Day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, as of a trumpet,
verses.textEnNlt: It was the Lord’s Day, and I was worshiping in the Spirit. Suddenly, I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet blast.
verses.textEnNasb: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice like the sound of a trumpet,
verses.textEn: On the Lord’s Day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,

verses.textZh: 说："<red>你所看见的，要写在书上，也要寄给以弗所、士每拿、别迦摩、推雅推拉、撒狄、非拉铁非、老底嘉七个教会。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："<red>你所看见的，要写在书上，也要寄给以弗所、士每拿、别迦摩、推雅推拉、撒狄、非拉铁非、老底嘉七个教会。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 「<red>你所看见的当写在书上，达与以弗所、士每拿、别迦摩、推雅推喇、撒狄、非拉铁非、老底嘉那七个教会。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: which said: <red>“Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia and Laodicea.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "Write what you see in a book and send it to the seven churches, to Ephesus and to Smyrna and to Pergamum and to Thyatira and to Sardis and to Philadelphia and to Laodicea."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last," and, "What you see, write in a book and send it to the seven churches which are in Asia: to Ephesus, to Smyrna, to Pergamos, to Thyatira, to Sardis, to Philadelphia, and to Laodicea."
verses.textEnNlt: It said, "Write in a book everything you see, and send it to the seven churches in the cities of Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea."
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "Write on a scroll what you see, and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea."
verses.textEn: which said: <red>“Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia and Laodicea.”</red>

verses.textZh: 我转过身来要看看那跟我说话的声音是谁发的；一转过来，就看见七个金灯台。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我转过身来要看看那跟我说话的声音是谁发的；一转过来，就看见七个金灯台。
verses.textZhCuv: 我转过身来，要看是谁发声与我说话；既转过来，就看见七个金灯台。
verses.textEnNiv: I turned around to see the voice that was speaking to me. And when I turned I saw seven golden lampstands,
verses.textEnEsv: Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking to me, and on turning I saw seven golden lampstands,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. And having turned I saw seven golden lampstands,
verses.textEnNlt: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me. And after turning I saw seven golden lampstands;
verses.textEn: I turned around to see the voice that was speaking to me. And when I turned I saw seven golden lampstands,

verses.textZh: 灯台中间有一位好象人子的，身上穿著直垂到脚的长衣，胸间束着金带。
verses.textZhCnvs: 灯台中间有一位好象人子的，身上穿著直垂到脚的长衣，胸间束着金带。
verses.textZhCuv: 灯台中间有一位好像人子，身穿长衣，直垂到脚，胸间束着金带。
verses.textEnNiv: and among the lampstands was someone like a son of man, dressed in a robe reaching down to his feet and with a golden sash around his chest.
verses.textEnEsv: and in the midst of the lampstands one like a son of man, clothed with a long robe and with a golden sash around his chest.
verses.textEnNkjv: and in the midst of the seven lampstands One like the Son of Man, clothed with a garment down to the feet and girded about the chest with a golden band.
verses.textEnNlt: And standing in the middle of the lampstands was someone like the Son of Man. He was wearing a long robe with a gold sash across his chest.
verses.textEnNasb: and in the middle of the lampstands I saw one like a son of man, clothed in a robe reaching to the feet, and wrapped around the chest with a golden sash.
verses.textEn: and among the lampstands was someone like a son of man, dressed in a robe reaching down to his feet and with a golden sash around his chest.

verses.textZh: 他的头和头发像白羊毛、像雪一样洁白，他的眼睛好象火焰，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的头和头发像白羊毛、像雪一样洁白，他的眼睛好象火焰，
verses.textZhCuv: 他的头与发皆白，如白羊毛，如雪；眼目如同火焰；
verses.textEnNiv: The hair on his head was white like wool, as white as snow, and his eyes were like blazing fire.
verses.textEnEsv: The hairs of his head were white, like white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire,
verses.textEnNkjv: His head and hair were white like wool, as white as snow, and His eyes like a flame of fire;
verses.textEnNlt: His head and his hair were white like wool, as white as snow. And his eyes were like flames of fire.
verses.textEnNasb: His head and His hair were white like white wool, like snow; and His eyes were like a flame of fire.
verses.textEn: The hair on his head was white like wool, as white as snow, and his eyes were like blazing fire.

verses.textZh: 他的两脚好象在炉中精炼过的发光的铜，他的声音好象众水的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的两脚好象在炉中精炼过的发光的铜，他的声音好象众水的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 脚好像在炉中锻炼光明的铜；声音如同众水的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: His feet were like bronze glowing in a furnace, and his voice was like the sound of rushing waters.
verses.textEnEsv: his feet were like burnished bronze, refined in a furnace, and his voice was like the roar of many waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: His feet were like fine brass, as if refined in a furnace, and His voice as the sound of many waters;
verses.textEnNlt: His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace, and his voice thundered like mighty ocean waves.
verses.textEnNasb: His feet were like burnished bronze when it has been heated to a glow in a furnace, and His voice was like the sound of many waters.
verses.textEn: His feet were like bronze glowing in a furnace, and his voice was like the sound of rushing waters.

verses.textZh: 他的右手拿着七星，有一把两刃的利剑从他口中吐出来；他的脸发光好象正午的烈日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的右手拿着七星，有一把两刃的利剑从他口中吐出来；他的脸发光好象正午的烈日。
verses.textZhCuv: 他右手拿着七星，从他口中出来一把两刃的利剑；面貌如同烈日放光。
verses.textEnNiv: In his right hand he held seven stars, and coming out of his mouth was a sharp, double-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining in all its brilliance.
verses.textEnEsv: In his right hand he held seven stars, from his mouth came a sharp two-edged sword, and his face was like the sun shining in full strength.
verses.textEnNkjv: He had in His right hand seven stars, out of His mouth went a sharp two-edged sword, and His countenance was like the sun shining in its strength.
verses.textEnNlt: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp two-edged sword came from his mouth. And his face was like the sun in all its brilliance.
verses.textEnNasb: In His right hand He held seven stars, and out of His mouth came a sharp two-edged sword; and His face was like the sun shining in its strength.
verses.textEn: In his right hand he held seven stars, and coming out of his mouth was a sharp, double-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining in all its brilliance.

verses.textZh: 我看见了他，就仆倒在他脚前，像死了一样。他用右手按着我，说："<red>不要怕！我是首先的，我是末后的，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见了他，就仆倒在他脚前，像死了一样。他用右手按着我，说："<red>不要怕！我是首先的，我是末后的，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我一看见，就仆倒在他脚前，像死了一样。他用右手按着我，说：「不要惧怕！我是首先的，我是末后的，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: When I saw him, I fell at his feet as though dead. Then he placed his right hand on me and said: <red>“Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When I saw him, I fell at his feet as though dead. But he laid his right hand on me, saying, "Fear not, I am the first and the last,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when I saw Him, I fell at His feet as dead. But He laid His right hand on me, saying to me, "Do not be afraid; I am the First and the Last.
verses.textEnNlt: When I saw him, I fell at his feet as if I were dead. But he laid his right hand on me and said, "Don’t be afraid! I am the First and the Last.
verses.textEnNasb: When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man. And He placed His right hand on me, saying, "Do not be afraid; I am the first and the last,
verses.textEn: When I saw him, I fell at his feet as though dead. Then he placed his right hand on me and said: <red>“Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>又是永活的；我曾经死过，看哪，现在又活着，直活到永永远远，并且拿着死亡和阴间的钥匙。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>又是永活的；我曾经死过，看哪，现在又活着，直活到永永远远，并且拿着死亡和阴间的钥匙。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又是那存活的；我曾死过，现在又活了，直活到永永远远；并且拿着死亡和阴间的钥匙。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I am the Living One; I was dead, and now look, I am alive for ever and ever! And I hold the keys of death and Hades.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and the living one. I died, and behold I am alive forevermore, and I have the keys of Death and Hades.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am He who lives, and was dead, and behold, I am alive forevermore. Amen. And I have the keys of Hades and of Death.
verses.textEnNlt: I am the living one. I died, but look—I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of death and the grave.
verses.textEnNasb: and the living One; and I was dead, and behold, I am alive forevermore, and I have the keys of death and of Hades.
verses.textEn: <red>I am the Living One; I was dead, and now look, I am alive for ever and ever! And I hold the keys of death and Hades.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以，你要把所看见的，现在的，和今后将要发生的事都写下来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以，你要把所看见的，现在的，和今后将要发生的事都写下来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以你要把所看见的，和现在的事，并将来必成的事，都写出来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Write, therefore, what you have seen, what is now and what will take place later.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Write therefore the things that you have seen, those that are and those that are to take place after this.
verses.textEnNkjv: Write the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will take place after this.
verses.textEnNlt: "Write down what you have seen—both the things that are now happening and the things that will happen.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore write the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will take place after these things.
verses.textEn: <red>“Write, therefore, what you have seen, what is now and what will take place later.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你所看见在我右手中的七星和七个金灯台的奥秘就是这样：七星是七个教会的使者，七灯台是七个教会。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你所看见在我右手中的七星和七个金灯台的奥秘就是这样：七星是七个教会的使者，七灯台是七个教会。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>论到你所看见、在我右手中的七星和七个金灯台的奥秘，那七星就是七个教会的使者，七灯台就是七个教会。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The mystery of the seven stars that you saw in my right hand and of the seven golden lampstands is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: As for the mystery of the seven stars that you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lampstands, the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
verses.textEnNkjv: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in My right hand, and the seven golden lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands which you saw are the seven churches.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the meaning of the mystery of the seven stars you saw in my right hand and the seven gold lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the mystery of the seven stars which you saw in My right hand, and the seven golden lampstands: the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
verses.textEn: <red>The mystery of the seven stars that you saw in my right hand and of the seven golden lampstands is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你要写信给在以弗所教会的使者，说： ‘那右手拿着七星，在七个金灯台中间行走的，这样说：</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你要写信给在以弗所教会的使者，说： ‘那右手拿着七星，在七个金灯台中间行走的，这样说：</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你要写信给以弗所教会的使者，说：『那右手拿着七星、在七个金灯台中间行走的，说：</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These are the words of him who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: ‘The words of him who holds the seven stars in his right hand, who walks among the seven golden lampstands.
verses.textEnNkjv: "To the angel of the church of Ephesus write, ‘These things says He who holds the seven stars in His right hand, who walks in the midst of the seven golden lampstands:
verses.textEnNlt: "Write this letter to the angel of the church in Ephesus. This is the message from the one who holds the seven stars in his right hand, the one who walks among the seven gold lampstands:
verses.textEnNasb: "To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: The One who holds the seven stars in His right hand, the One who walks among the seven golden lampstands, says this:
verses.textEn: <red>“To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These are the words of him who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我知道你的行为、你的劳苦、你的忍耐，也知道你不能容忍恶人。你也曾经试验那些自称是使徒，而其实不是使徒的人，看出他们是假的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我知道你的行为、你的劳苦、你的忍耐，也知道你不能容忍恶人。你也曾经试验那些自称是使徒，而其实不是使徒的人，看出他们是假的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我知道你的行为、劳碌、忍耐，也知道你不能容忍恶人。你也曾试验那自称为使徒却不是使徒的，看出他们是假的来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I know your deeds, your hard work and your perseverance. I know that you cannot tolerate wicked people, that you have tested those who claim to be apostles but are not, and have found them false.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "‘I know your works, your toil and your patient endurance, and how you cannot bear with those who are evil, but have tested those who call themselves apostles and are not, and found them to be false.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I know your works, your labor, your patience, and that you cannot bear those who are evil. And you have tested those who say they are apostles and are not, and have found them liars;
verses.textEnNlt: "I know all the things you do. I have seen your hard work and your patient endurance. I know you don’t tolerate evil people. You have examined the claims of those who say they are apostles but are not. You have discovered they are liars.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I know your deeds and your labor and perseverance, and that you cannot tolerate evil people, and you have put those who call themselves apostles to the test, and they are not, and you found them to be false;
verses.textEn: <red>I know your deeds, your hard work and your perseverance. I know that you cannot tolerate wicked people, that you have tested those who claim to be apostles but are not, and have found them false.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你有忍耐，曾为我的名的缘故忍受一切，并不困倦。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你有忍耐，曾为我的名的缘故忍受一切，并不困倦。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你也能忍耐，曾为我的名劳苦，并不乏倦。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You have persevered and have endured hardships for my name, and have not grown weary.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I know you are enduring patiently and bearing up for my name’s sake, and you have not grown weary.
verses.textEnNkjv: and you have persevered and have patience, and have labored for My name’s sake and have not become weary.
verses.textEnNlt: You have patiently suffered for me without quitting.
verses.textEnNasb: and you have perseverance and have endured on account of My name, and have not become weary.
verses.textEn: <red>You have persevered and have endured hardships for my name, and have not grown weary.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而有一件事我要责备你，就是你已经离弃了你起初的爱。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而有一件事我要责备你，就是你已经离弃了你起初的爱。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>然而有一件事我要责备你，就是你把起初的爱心离弃了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Yet I hold this against you: You have forsaken the love you had at first.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I have this against you, that you have abandoned the love you had at first.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless I have this against you, that you have left your first love.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I have this complaint against you. You don’t love me or each other as you did at first!
verses.textEnNasb: But I have this against you, that you have left your first love.
verses.textEn: <red>Yet I hold this against you: You have forsaken the love you had at first.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以，你应当回想你是从哪里坠落的，并且要悔改，作起初所作的事。你若不悔改，我就要来到你那里，把你的灯台从原处移去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以，你应当回想你是从哪里坠落的，并且要悔改，作起初所作的事。你若不悔改，我就要来到你那里，把你的灯台从原处移去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，应当回想你是从哪里坠落的，并要悔改，行起初所行的事。你若不悔改，我就临到你那里，把你的灯台从原处挪去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Consider how far you have fallen! Repent and do the things you did at first. If you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Remember therefore from where you have fallen; repent, and do the works you did at first. If not, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place, unless you repent.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember therefore from where you have fallen; repent and do the first works, or else I will come to you quickly and remove your lampstand from its place—unless you repent.
verses.textEnNlt: Look how far you have fallen! Turn back to me and do the works you did at first. If you don’t repent, I will come and remove your lampstand from its place among the churches.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, remember from where you have fallen, and repent, and do the deeds you did at first; or else I am coming to you and I will remove your lampstand from its place—unless you repent.
verses.textEn: <red>Consider how far you have fallen! Repent and do the things you did at first. If you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不过你有这一个优点，就是你恨恶尼哥拉党的作为，那也是我所恨恶的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不过你有这一个优点，就是你恨恶尼哥拉党的作为，那也是我所恨恶的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>然而你还有一件可取的事，就是你恨恶尼哥拉一党人的行为，这也是我所恨恶的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But you have this in your favor: You hate the practices of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Yet this you have: you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
verses.textEnNkjv: But this you have, that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
verses.textEnNlt: But this is in your favor: You hate the evil deeds of the Nicolaitans, just as I do.
verses.textEnNasb: But you have this, that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
verses.textEn: <red>But you have this in your favor: You hate the practices of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，有耳的就应当听。得胜的，我必定把神乐园里生命树的果子赐给他吃。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，有耳的就应当听。得胜的，我必定把神乐园里生命树的果子赐给他吃。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！得胜的，我必将神乐园中生命树的果子赐给他吃。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who is victorious, I will give the right to eat from the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who conquers I will grant to eat of the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the midst of the Paradise of God." ’
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone with ears to hear must listen to the Spirit and understand what he is saying to the churches. To everyone who is victorious I will give fruit from the tree of life in the paradise of God.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of God.’
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who is victorious, I will give the right to eat from the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你要写信给在士每拿教会的使者，说： ‘那首先的、末后的、曾经死去而又活过来的，这样说：</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你要写信给在士每拿教会的使者，说： ‘那首先的、末后的、曾经死去而又活过来的，这样说：</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你要写信给士每拿教会的使者，说：『那首先的、末后的、死过又活的，说：</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of him who is the First and the Last, who died and came to life again.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write: ‘The words of the first and the last, who died and came to life.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write, ‘These things says the First and the Last, who was dead, and came to life:
verses.textEnNlt: "Write this letter to the angel of the church in Smyrna. This is the message from the one who is the First and the Last, who was dead but is now alive:
verses.textEnNasb: "And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write: The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life, says this:
verses.textEn: <red>“To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of him who is the First and the Last, who died and came to life again.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我知道你的患难和贫穷，但你却是富足的。我也知道那些自称是犹太人所说毁谤的话，其实他们不是犹太人，而是撒但的党徒。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我知道你的患难和贫穷，但你却是富足的。我也知道那些自称是犹太人所说毁谤的话，其实他们不是犹太人，而是撒但的党徒。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我知道你的患难，你的贫穷（你却是富足的），也知道那自称是犹太人所说的毁谤话，其实他们不是犹太人，乃是撒但一会的人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I know your afflictions and your poverty—yet you are rich! I know about the slander of those who say they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "‘I know your tribulation and your poverty ( but you are rich) and the slander of those who say that they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I know your works, tribulation, and poverty (but you are rich); and I know the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
verses.textEnNlt: "I know about your suffering and your poverty—but you are rich! I know the blasphemy of those opposing you. They say they are Jews, but they are not, because their synagogue belongs to Satan.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I know your tribulation and your poverty (but you are rich), and the slander by those who say they are Jews, and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
verses.textEn: <red>I know your afflictions and your poverty—yet you are rich! I know about the slander of those who say they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你不要怕你将要受的苦。看哪！魔鬼将要把你们中间几个人下在监里，叫你们受试炼，你们要受患难十天。你要忠心至死，我就把那生命的冠冕赐给你。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你不要怕你将要受的苦。看哪！魔鬼将要把你们中间几个人下在监里，叫你们受试炼，你们要受患难十天。你要忠心至死，我就把那生命的冠冕赐给你。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你将要受的苦你不用怕。魔鬼要把你们中间几个人下在监里，叫你们被试炼，你们必受患难十日。你务要至死忠心，我就赐给你那生命的冠冕。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Do not be afraid of what you are about to suffer. I tell you, the devil will put some of you in prison to test you, and you will suffer persecution for ten days. Be faithful, even to the point of death, and I will give you life as your victor’s crown.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested, and for ten days you will have tribulation. Be faithful unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not fear any of those things which you are about to suffer. Indeed, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested, and you will have tribulation ten days. Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be afraid of what you are about to suffer. The devil will throw some of you into prison to test you. You will suffer for ten days. But if you remain faithful even when facing death, I will give you the crown of life.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, so that you will be tested, and you will have tribulation for ten days. Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.
verses.textEn: <red>Do not be afraid of what you are about to suffer. I tell you, the devil will put some of you in prison to test you, and you will suffer persecution for ten days. Be faithful, even to the point of death, and I will give you life as your victor’s crown.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，有耳的就应当听。得胜的，决不会受第二次死的害。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，有耳的就应当听。得胜的，决不会受第二次死的害。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！得胜的，必不受第二次死的害。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who is victorious will not be hurt at all by the second death.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who conquers will not be hurt by the second death.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. He who overcomes shall not be hurt by the second death." ’
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone with ears to hear must listen to the Spirit and understand what he is saying to the churches. Whoever is victorious will not be harmed by the second death.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be hurt by the second death.’
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who is victorious will not be hurt at all by the second death.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你要写信给在别迦摩教会的使者，说： ‘那有一把两刃利剑的，这样说：</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你要写信给在别迦摩教会的使者，说： ‘那有一把两刃利剑的，这样说：</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你要写信给别迦摩教会的使者，说：『那有两刃利剑的，说：</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These are the words of him who has the sharp, double-edged sword.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "And to the angel of the church in Pergamum write: ‘The words of him who has the sharp two-edged sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write, ‘These things says He who has the sharp two-edged sword:
verses.textEnNlt: "Write this letter to the angel of the church in Pergamum. This is the message from the one with the sharp two-edged sword:
verses.textEnNasb: "And to the angel of the church in Pergamum write: The One who has the sharp two-edged sword says this:
verses.textEn: <red>“To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These are the words of him who has the sharp, double-edged sword.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我知道你居住的地方，就是撒但王座所在的地方。当我忠心的见证人安提帕在你们那里，就是在撒但居住的地方被杀的那些日子，你还持守我的名，没有否认对我的信仰。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我知道你居住的地方，就是撒但王座所在的地方。当我忠心的见证人安提帕在你们那里，就是在撒但居住的地方被杀的那些日子，你还持守我的名，没有否认对我的信仰。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我知道你的居所，就是有撒但座位之处；当我忠心的见证人安提帕在你们中间、撒但所住的地方被杀之时，你还坚守我的名，没有弃绝我的道。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I know where you live—where Satan has his throne. Yet you remain true to my name. You did not renounce your faith in me, not even in the days of Antipas, my faithful witness, who was put to death in your city—where Satan lives.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "‘I know where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. Yet you hold fast my name, and you did not deny my faith even in the days of Antipas my faithful witness, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I know your works, and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. And you hold fast to My name, and did not deny My faith even in the days in which Antipas was My faithful martyr, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
verses.textEnNlt: "I know that you live in the city where Satan has his throne, yet you have remained loyal to me. You refused to deny me even when Antipas, my faithful witness, was martyred among you there in Satan’s city.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I know where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is; and you hold firmly to My name, and did not deny My faith even in the days of Antipas, My witness, My faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
verses.textEn: <red>I know where you live—where Satan has his throne. Yet you remain true to my name. You did not renounce your faith in me, not even in the days of Antipas, my faithful witness, who was put to death in your city—where Satan lives.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而有几件事我要责备你，因为在你那里有些人持守巴兰的教训。这巴兰曾经教导巴勒把绊脚石放在以色列人面前，叫他们吃祭过偶像的食物，并且行淫乱。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而有几件事我要责备你，因为在你那里有些人持守巴兰的教训。这巴兰曾经教导巴勒把绊脚石放在以色列人面前，叫他们吃祭过偶像的食物，并且行淫乱。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>然而，有几件事我要责备你：因为在你那里有人服从了巴兰的教训；这巴兰曾教导巴勒将绊脚石放在以色列人面前，叫他们吃祭偶像之物，行奸淫的事。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Nevertheless, I have a few things against you: There are some among you who hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to entice the Israelites to sin so that they ate food sacrificed to idols and committed sexual immorality.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I have a few things against you: you have some there who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the sons of Israel, so that they might eat food sacrificed to idols and practice sexual immorality.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I have a few things against you, because you have there those who hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I have a few complaints against you. You tolerate some among you whose teaching is like that of Balaam, who showed Balak how to trip up the people of Israel. He taught them to sin by eating food offered to idols and by committing sexual sin.
verses.textEnNasb: But I have a few things against you, because you have some there who hold the teaching of Balaam, who kept teaching Balak to put a stumbling block before the sons of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols and to commit sexual immorality.
verses.textEn: <red>Nevertheless, I have a few things against you: There are some among you who hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to entice the Israelites to sin so that they ate food sacrificed to idols and committed sexual immorality.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>同样，你也有些人持守尼哥拉党的教训。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>同样，你也有些人持守尼哥拉党的教训。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你那里也有人照样服从了尼哥拉一党人的教训。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Likewise, you also have those who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So also you have some who hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus you also have those who hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.
verses.textEnNlt: In a similar way, you have some Nicolaitans among you who follow the same teaching.
verses.textEnNasb: So you too, have some who in the same way hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
verses.textEn: <red>Likewise, you also have those who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以，你应当悔改；如果不悔改，我就很快地来到你们那里，用我口中的剑跟他们作战。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以，你应当悔改；如果不悔改，我就很快地来到你们那里，用我口中的剑跟他们作战。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，你当悔改；若不悔改，我就快临到你那里，用我口中的剑攻击他们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Repent therefore! Otherwise, I will soon come to you and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore repent. If not, I will come to you soon and war against them with the sword of my mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Repent, or else I will come to you quickly and will fight against them with the sword of My mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: Repent of your sin, or I will come to you suddenly and fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore repent; or else I am coming to you quickly, and I will wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.
verses.textEn: <red>Repent therefore! Otherwise, I will soon come to you and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，有耳的就应当听。得胜的，我必定把那隐藏的吗哪赐给他，并且赐他一块白石，石上写着新的名字，这名字除了那领受的人以外，是没有人能知道的。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，有耳的就应当听。得胜的，我必定把那隐藏的吗哪赐给他，并且赐他一块白石，石上写着新的名字，这名字除了那领受的人以外，是没有人能知道的。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！得胜的，我必将那隐藏的吗哪赐给他，并赐他一块白石，石上写着新名；除了那领受的以外，没有人能认识。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who is victorious, I will give some of the hidden manna. I will also give that person a white stone with a new name written on it, known only to the one who receives it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who conquers I will give some of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, with a new name written on the stone that no one knows except the one who receives it.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes I will give some of the hidden manna to eat. And I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows except him who receives it." ’
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone with ears to hear must listen to the Spirit and understand what he is saying to the churches. To everyone who is victorious I will give some of the manna that has been hidden away in heaven. And I will give to each one a white stone, and on the stone will be engraved a new name that no one understands except the one who receives it.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give some of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and a new name written on the stone which no one knows except the one who receives it.’
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who is victorious, I will give some of the hidden manna. I will also give that person a white stone with a new name written on it, known only to the one who receives it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你要写信给在推雅推拉教会的使者，说： ‘神的儿子，那眼睛像火焰、两脚像光铜的，这样说：</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你要写信给在推雅推拉教会的使者，说： ‘神的儿子，那眼睛像火焰、两脚像光铜的，这样说：</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你要写信给推雅推喇教会的使者，说：『那眼目如火焰、脚像光明铜的神之子说：</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like blazing fire and whose feet are like burnished bronze.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write: ‘The words of the Son of God, who has eyes like a flame of fire, and whose feet are like burnished bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write, ‘These things says the Son of God, who has eyes like a flame of fire, and His feet like fine brass:
verses.textEnNlt: "Write this letter to the angel of the church in Thyatira. This is the message from the Son of God, whose eyes are like flames of fire, whose feet are like polished bronze:
verses.textEnNasb: "And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write: The Son of God, who has eyes like a flame of fire, and feet like burnished bronze, says this:
verses.textEn: <red>“To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like blazing fire and whose feet are like burnished bronze.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我知道你的行为，你的爱心、信心、服侍和忍耐，也知道你后来所作的比先前的还要多。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我知道你的行为，你的爱心、信心、服侍和忍耐，也知道你后来所作的比先前的还要多。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我知道你的行为、爱心、信心、勤劳、忍耐，又知道你末后所行的善事，比起初所行的更多。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I know your deeds, your love and faith, your service and perseverance, and that you are now doing more than you did at first.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "‘I know your works, your love and faith and service and patient endurance, and that your latter works exceed the first.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I know your works, love, service, faith, and your patience; and as for your works, the last are more than the first.
verses.textEnNlt: "I know all the things you do. I have seen your love, your faith, your service, and your patient endurance. And I can see your constant improvement in all these things.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I know your deeds, and your love and faith, and service and perseverance, and that your deeds of late are greater than at first.
verses.textEn: <red>I know your deeds, your love and faith, your service and perseverance, and that you are now doing more than you did at first.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而有一件事我要责备你，就是你容让那自称是先知的妇人耶洗别，教导和引诱我的众仆人行淫乱，吃祭过偶像的食物。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而有一件事我要责备你，就是你容让那自称是先知的妇人耶洗别，教导和引诱我的众仆人行淫乱，吃祭过偶像的食物。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>然而，有一件事我要责备你，就是你容让那自称是先知的妇人耶洗别教导我的仆人，引诱他们行奸淫，吃祭偶像之物。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Nevertheless, I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet. By her teaching she misleads my servants into sexual immorality and the eating of food sacrificed to idols.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I have this against you, that you tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess and is teaching and seducing my servants to practice sexual immorality and to eat food sacrificed to idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless I have a few things against you, because you allowthat woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess, to teach and seduce My servants to commit sexual immorality and eat things sacrificed to idols.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I have this complaint against you. You are permitting that woman—that Jezebel who calls herself a prophet—to lead my servants astray. She teaches them to commit sexual sin and to eat food offered to idols.
verses.textEnNasb: But I have this against you, that you tolerate the woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess, and she teaches and leads My bond-servants astray so that they commit sexual immorality and eat things sacrificed to idols.
verses.textEn: <red>Nevertheless, I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet. By her teaching she misleads my servants into sexual immorality and the eating of food sacrificed to idols.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我曾给她时间，让她悔改，她却不肯为她的淫行悔改。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我曾给她时间，让她悔改，她却不肯为她的淫行悔改。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我曾给她悔改的机会，她却不肯悔改她的淫行。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I have given her time to repent of her immorality, but she is unwilling.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I gave her time to repent of her sexual immorality, and she did not repent.
verses.textEnNlt: I gave her time to repent, but she does not want to turn away from her immorality.
verses.textEnNasb: I gave her time to repent, and she does not want to repent of her sexual immorality.
verses.textEn: <red>I have given her time to repent of her immorality, but she is unwilling.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>看哪，我要把她拋在大患难的床上；那些跟她行淫乱的人，如果不为她的行为悔改，我也要把他们拋在大患难中。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>看哪，我要把她拋在大患难的床上；那些跟她行淫乱的人，如果不为她的行为悔改，我也要把他们拋在大患难中。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>看哪，我要叫她病卧在床。那些与她行淫的人，若不悔改所行的，我也要叫他们同受大患难。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So I will cast her on a bed of suffering, and I will make those who commit adultery with her suffer intensely, unless they repent of her ways.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I will throw her onto a sickbed, and those who commit adultery with her I will throw into great tribulation, unless they repent of her works,
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed I will cast her into a sickbed, and those who commit adultery with her into great tribulation, unless they repent of their deeds.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, I will throw her on a bed of suffering, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer greatly unless they repent and turn away from her evil deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I will throw her on a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her into great tribulation, unless they repent of her deeds.
verses.textEn: <red>So I will cast her on a bed of suffering, and I will make those who commit adultery with her suffer intensely, unless they repent of her ways.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我必以死亡击杀她的儿女；众教会就都知道我是察验人肺腑心肠的，我要照着你们的行为报应你们各人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我必以死亡击杀她的儿女；众教会就都知道我是察验人肺腑心肠的，我要照着你们的行为报应你们各人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我又要杀死她的党类 ，叫众教会知道，我是那察看人肺腑心肠的，并要照你们的行为报应你们各人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I will strike her children dead. Then all the churches will know that I am he who searches hearts and minds, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and I will strike her children dead. And all the churches will know that I am he who searches mind and heart, and I will give to each of you according to your works.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will kill her children with death, and all the churches shall know that I am He who searches the minds and hearts. And I will give to each one of you according to your works.
verses.textEnNlt: I will strike her children dead. Then all the churches will know that I am the one who searches out the thoughts and intentions of every person. And I will give to each of you whatever you deserve.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will kill her children with plague, and all the churches will know that I am He who searches the minds and hearts; and I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.
verses.textEn: <red>I will strike her children dead. Then all the churches will know that I am he who searches hearts and minds, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>至于你们其余在推雅推拉的人，就是不跟从那教训，不认识所谓撒但深奥的事的人，我告诉你们，我不会把别的重担放在你们身上。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>至于你们其余在推雅推拉的人，就是不跟从那教训，不认识所谓撒但深奥的事的人，我告诉你们，我不会把别的重担放在你们身上。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>至于你们推雅推喇其余的人，就是一切不从那教训、不晓得他们素常所说撒但深奥之理的人，我告诉你们，我不将别的担子放在你们身上。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Now I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, to you who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned Satan’s so-called deep secrets, ‘I will not impose any other burden on you,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold this teaching, who have not learned what some call the deep things of Satan, to you I say, I do not lay on you any other burden.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now to you I say, and to the rest in Thyatira, as many as do not have this doctrine, who have not known the depths of Satan, as they say, I will put on you no other burden.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I also have a message for the rest of you in Thyatira who have not followed this false teaching (‘deeper truths,’ as they call them—depths of Satan, actually). I will ask nothing more of you
verses.textEnNasb: But I say to you, the rest who are in Thyatira, who do not hold this teaching, who have not known the deep things of Satan, as they call them—I place no other burden on you.
verses.textEn: <red>Now I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, to you who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned Satan’s so-called deep secrets, ‘I will not impose any other burden on you,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不过，你们要持守已经得着的，直到我来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不过，你们要持守已经得着的，直到我来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但你们已经有的，总要持守，直等到我来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>except to hold on to what you have until I come.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Only hold fast what you have until I come.
verses.textEnNkjv: But hold fast what you have till I come.
verses.textEnNlt: except that you hold tightly to what you have until I come.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless what you have, hold firmly until I come.
verses.textEn: <red>except to hold on to what you have until I come.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>得胜的，又遵守我的旨意到底的， 我必把统治列国的权柄赐给他，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>得胜的，又遵守我的旨意到底的， 我必把统治列国的权柄赐给他，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那得胜又遵守我命令到底的，我要赐给他权柄制伏列国；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>To the one who is victorious and does my will to the end, I will give authority over the nations—</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The one who conquers and who keeps my works until the end, to him I will give authority over the nations,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he who overcomes, and keeps My works until the end, to him I will give power over the nations—
verses.textEnNlt: To all who are victorious, who obey me to the very end, To them I will give authority over all the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who overcomes, and the one who keeps My deeds until the end, I will give him authority over the nations;
verses.textEn: <red>To the one who is victorious and does my will to the end, I will give authority over the nations—</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他必用铁杖治理他们， 好象打碎陶器一样粉碎他们， 好象我从父领受了权柄一样；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他必用铁杖治理他们， 好象打碎陶器一样粉碎他们， 好象我从父领受了权柄一样；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他必用铁杖辖管 他们，将他们如同窑户的瓦器打得粉碎，像我从我父领受的权柄一样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>that one ‘will rule them with an iron scepter and will dash them to pieces like pottery’ —just as I have received authority from my Father.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and he will rule them with a rod of iron, as when earthen pots are broken in pieces, even as I myself have received authority from my Father.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘He shall rule them with a rod of iron; They shall be dashed to pieces like the potter’s vessels’— as I also have received from My Father;
verses.textEnNlt: They will rule the nations with an iron rod and smash them like clay pots.
verses.textEnNasb: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron, as the vessels of the potter are shattered, as I also have received authority from My Father;
verses.textEn: <red>that one ‘will rule them with an iron scepter and will dash them to pieces like pottery’ —just as I have received authority from my Father.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我还要把晨星赐给他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我还要把晨星赐给他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我又要把晨星赐给他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I will also give that one the morning star.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And I will give him the morning star.
verses.textEnNkjv: and I will give him the morning star.
verses.textEnNlt: They will have the same authority I received from my Father, and I will also give them the morning star!
verses.textEnNasb: and I will give him the morning star.
verses.textEn: <red>I will also give that one the morning star.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，有耳的就应当听。’"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，有耳的就应当听。’"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches." ’
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone with ears to hear must listen to the Spirit and understand what he is saying to the churches.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.’
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你要写信给在撒狄教会的使者，说： ‘那有神七灵和七星的这样说：我知道你的行为，你有名声，说你是活着的，其实你是死的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你要写信给在撒狄教会的使者，说： ‘那有神七灵和七星的这样说：我知道你的行为，你有名声，说你是活着的，其实你是死的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你要写信给撒狄教会的使者，说：『那有神的七灵和七星的，说：我知道你的行为，按名你是活的，其实是死的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of him who holds the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "And to the angel of the church in Sardis write: ‘The words of him who has the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. "‘I know your works. You have the reputation of being alive, but you are dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And to the angel of the church in Sardis write, ‘These things says He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars: "I know your works, that you have a name that you are alive, but you are dead.
verses.textEnNlt: "Write this letter to the angel of the church in Sardis. This is the message from the one who has the sevenfold Spirit of God and the seven stars: "I know all the things you do, and that you have a reputation for being alive—but you are dead.
verses.textEnNasb: "To the angel of the church in Sardis write: He who has the seven spirits of God and the seven stars, says this: ‘I know your deeds, that you have a name that you are alive, and yet you are dead.
verses.textEn: <red>“To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of him who holds the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你要警醒，把那些剩下来将要死的坚强起来；因为我见你的行为在我神面前是不完全的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你要警醒，把那些剩下来将要死的坚强起来；因为我见你的行为在我神面前是不完全的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你要警醒，坚固那剩下将要衰微 的；因我见你的行为，在我神面前，没有一样是完全的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Wake up! Strengthen what remains and is about to die, for I have found your deeds unfinished in the sight of my God.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Wake up, and strengthen what remains and is about to die, for I have not found your works complete in the sight of my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die, for I have not found your works perfect before God.
verses.textEnNlt: Wake up! Strengthen what little remains, for even what is left is almost dead. I find that your actions do not meet the requirements of my God.
verses.textEnNasb: Be constantly alert, and strengthen the things that remain, which were about to die; for I have not found your deeds completed in the sight of My God.
verses.textEn: <red>Wake up! Strengthen what remains and is about to die, for I have found your deeds unfinished in the sight of my God.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以，你应当回想你是怎样领受、怎样听见的；应该遵守，也应该悔改。你若不警醒，我就要像贼来到一样。我甚么时候来到你那里，你决不能知道。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以，你应当回想你是怎样领受、怎样听见的；应该遵守，也应该悔改。你若不警醒，我就要像贼来到一样。我甚么时候来到你那里，你决不能知道。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以要回想你是怎样领受、怎样听见的，又要遵守，并要悔改。若不警醒，我必临到你那里，如同贼一样。我几时临到，你也决不能知道。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Remember, therefore, what you have received and heard; hold it fast, and repent. But if you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what time I will come to you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Remember, then, what you received and heard. Keep it, and repent. If you will not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what hour I will come against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember therefore how you have received and heard; hold fast and repent. Therefore if you will not watch, I will come upon you as a thief, and you will not know what hour I will come upon you.
verses.textEnNlt: Go back to what you heard and believed at first; hold to it firmly. Repent and turn to me again. If you don’t wake up, I will come to you suddenly, as unexpected as a thief.
verses.textEnNasb: So remember what you have received and heard; and keep it, and repent. Then if you are not alert, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what hour I will come to you.
verses.textEn: <red>Remember, therefore, what you have received and heard; hold it fast, and repent. But if you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what time I will come to you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而在撒狄你还有几名是未曾玷污自己衣服的，他们要身穿白衣与我同行；因为他们是配得上的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而在撒狄你还有几名是未曾玷污自己衣服的，他们要身穿白衣与我同行；因为他们是配得上的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>然而在撒狄，你还有几名是未曾污秽自己衣服的，他们要穿白衣与我同行，因为他们是配得过的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Yet you have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their clothes. They will walk with me, dressed in white, for they are worthy.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Yet you have still a few names in Sardis, people who have not soiled their garments, and they will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have a few names even in Sardis who have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with Me in white, for they are worthy.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yet there are some in the church in Sardis who have not soiled their clothes with evil. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.
verses.textEnNasb: But you have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their garments; and they will walk with Me in white, for they are worthy.
verses.textEn: <red>Yet you have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their clothes. They will walk with me, dressed in white, for they are worthy.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>得胜的，也必这样身穿白衣，我决不从生命册上涂抹他的名，我还要在我父和他的众天使面前，承认他的名。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>得胜的，也必这样身穿白衣，我决不从生命册上涂抹他的名，我还要在我父和他的众天使面前，承认他的名。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡得胜的必这样穿白衣，我也必不从生命册上涂抹他的名；且要在我父面前，和我父众使者面前，认他的名。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The one who is victorious will, like them, be dressed in white. I will never blot out the name of that person from the book of life, but will acknowledge that name before my Father and his angels.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The one who conquers will be clothed thus in white garments, and I will never blot his name out of the book of life. I will confess his name before my Father and before his angels.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who overcomes shall be clothed in white garments, and I will not blot out his name from the Book of Life; but I will confess his name before My Father and before His angels.
verses.textEnNlt: All who are victorious will be clothed in white. I will never erase their names from the Book of Life, but I will announce before my Father and his angels that they are mine.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who overcomes will be clothed the same way, in white garments; and I will not erase his name from the book of life, and I will confess his name before My Father and before His angels.
verses.textEn: <red>The one who is victorious will, like them, be dressed in white. I will never blot out the name of that person from the book of life, but will acknowledge that name before my Father and his angels.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，有耳的就应当听。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，有耳的就应当听。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches." ’
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone with ears to hear must listen to the Spirit and understand what he is saying to the churches.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.’
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你要写信给在非拉铁非教会的使者，说： ‘那圣洁的、真实的， 拿着大卫的钥匙， 开了就没有人能关， 关了就没有人能开的 ，这样说：</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你要写信给在非拉铁非教会的使者，说： ‘那圣洁的、真实的， 拿着大卫的钥匙， 开了就没有人能关， 关了就没有人能开的 ，这样说：</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你要写信给非拉铁非教会的使者，说：『那圣洁、真实、拿着大卫的钥匙、开了就没有人能关、关了就没有人能开的，说：</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of him who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: ‘The words of the holy one, the true one, who has the key of David, who opens and no one will shut, who shuts and no one opens.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write, ‘These things says He who is holy, He who is true, "He who has the key of David, He who opens and no one shuts, and shuts and no one opens":
verses.textEnNlt: "Write this letter to the angel of the church in Philadelphia. This is the message from the one who is holy and true, the one who has the key of David. What he opens, no one can close; and what he closes, no one can open:
verses.textEnNasb: "And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: He who is holy, who is true, who has the key of David, who opens and no one will shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says this:
verses.textEn: <red>“To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of him who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我知道你的行为，看哪！我已经在你面前给你一道开着的门，是没有人能关的；因为你有一点点力量，也遵守我的道，没有否认我的名。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我知道你的行为，看哪！我已经在你面前给你一道开着的门，是没有人能关的；因为你有一点点力量，也遵守我的道，没有否认我的名。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我知道你的行为，你略有一点力量，也曾遵守我的道，没有弃绝我的名。看哪，我在你面前给你一个敞开的门，是无人能关的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I know your deeds. See, I have placed before you an open door that no one can shut. I know that you have little strength, yet you have kept my word and have not denied my name.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "‘I know your works. Behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one is able to shut. I know that you have but little power, and yet you have kept my word and have not denied my name.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I know your works. See, I have set before you an open door, and no one can shut it; for you have a little strength, have kept My word, and have not denied My name.
verses.textEnNlt: "I know all the things you do, and I have opened a door for you that no one can close. You have little strength, yet you obeyed my word and did not deny me.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I know your deeds. Behold, I have put before you an open door which no one can shut, because you have a little power, and have followed My word, and have not denied My name.
verses.textEn: <red>I know your deeds. See, I have placed before you an open door that no one can shut. I know that you have little strength, yet you have kept my word and have not denied my name.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>看哪！从撒但的一党，就是自称是犹太人，其实不是犹太人，而是说谎的人中，我要使他们一些人来在你脚前下拜，并且知道我已经爱了你。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>看哪！从撒但的一党，就是自称是犹太人，其实不是犹太人，而是说谎的人中，我要使他们一些人来在你脚前下拜，并且知道我已经爱了你。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那撒但一会的，自称是犹太人，其实不是犹太人，乃是说谎话的，我要使他们来，在你脚前下拜，也使他们知道我是已经爱你了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I will make those who are of the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews though they are not, but are liars—I will make them come and fall down at your feet and acknowledge that I have loved you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I will make those of the synagogue of Satan who say that they are Jews and are not, but lie—behold, I will make them come and bow down before your feet, and they will learn that I have loved you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed I will make those of the synagogue of Satan, who say they are Jews and are not, but lie—indeed I will make them come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.
verses.textEnNlt: Look, I will force those who belong to Satan’s synagogue—those liars who say they are Jews but are not—to come and bow down at your feet. They will acknowledge that you are the ones I love.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I will make those of the synagogue of Satan, who say that they are Jews and are not, but lie—I will make them come and bow down before your feet, and make them know that I have loved you.
verses.textEn: <red>I will make those who are of the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews though they are not, but are liars—I will make them come and fall down at your feet and acknowledge that I have loved you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你既然遵守了我忍耐的道，我也必定保守你脱离那试炼的时候；这就是那将要临到普天下，来试炼住在地上的人的时候。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你既然遵守了我忍耐的道，我也必定保守你脱离那试炼的时候；这就是那将要临到普天下，来试炼住在地上的人的时候。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你既遵守我忍耐的道，我必在普天下人受试炼的时候，保守你免去你的试炼。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Since you have kept my command to endure patiently, I will also keep you from the hour of trial that is going to come on the whole world to test the inhabitants of the earth.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Because you have kept my word about patient endurance, I will keep you from the hour of trial that is coming on the whole world, to try those who dwell on the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because you have kept My command to persevere, I also will keep you from the hour of trial which shall come upon the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: "Because you have obeyed my command to persevere, I will protect you from the great time of testing that will come upon the whole world to test those who belong to this world.
verses.textEnNasb: Because you have kept My word of perseverance, I also will keep you from the hour of the testing, that hour which is about to come upon the whole world, to test those who live on the earth.
verses.textEn: <red>Since you have kept my command to endure patiently, I will also keep you from the hour of trial that is going to come on the whole world to test the inhabitants of the earth.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我必快来！你要持守你所有的，不要让人拿走你的冠冕。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我必快来！你要持守你所有的，不要让人拿走你的冠冕。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我必快来，你要持守你所有的，免得人夺去你的冠冕。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I am coming soon. Hold on to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I am coming soon. Hold fast what you have, so that no one may seize your crown.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I am coming quickly! Hold fast what you have, that no one may take your crown.
verses.textEnNlt: I am coming soon. Hold on to what you have, so that no one will take away your crown.
verses.textEnNasb: I am coming quickly; hold firmly to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.
verses.textEn: <red>I am coming soon. Hold on to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>得胜的，我要叫他在我神的圣所里作柱子，他决不再出去，我也要把我神的名，和我神的城的名，就是那从天上、从我神那里降下来的新耶路撒冷，以及我的新名，都写在他身上。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>得胜的，我要叫他在我神的圣所里作柱子，他决不再出去，我也要把我神的名，和我神的城的名，就是那从天上、从我神那里降下来的新耶路撒冷，以及我的新名，都写在他身上。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>得胜的，我要叫他在我神殿中作柱子，他也必不再从那里出去。我又要将我神的名和我神城的名（这城就是从天上、从我神那里降下来的新耶路撒冷），并我的新名，都写在他上面。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The one who is victorious I will make a pillar in the temple of my God. Never again will they leave it. I will write on them the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which is coming down out of heaven from my God; and I will also write on them my new name.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The one who conquers, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God. Never shall he go out of it, and I will write on him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down from my God out of heaven, and my own new name.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of My God, and he shall go out no more. I will write on him the name of My God and the name of the city of My God, the New Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from My God. And I will write on him My new name.
verses.textEnNlt: All who are victorious will become pillars in the Temple of my God, and they will never have to leave it. And I will write on them the name of my God, and they will be citizens in the city of my God—the new Jerusalem that comes down from heaven from my God. And I will also write on them my new name.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will not go out from it anymore; and I will write on him the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from My God, and My new name.
verses.textEn: <red>The one who is victorious I will make a pillar in the temple of my God. Never again will they leave it. I will write on them the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which is coming down out of heaven from my God; and I will also write on them my new name.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，有耳的就应当听。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，有耳的就应当听。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches." ’
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone with ears to hear must listen to the Spirit and understand what he is saying to the churches.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.’
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你要写信给在老底嘉教会的使者，说： ‘那位阿们的，忠信真实的见证人，神创造万有的根源，这样说：</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你要写信给在老底嘉教会的使者，说： ‘那位阿们的，忠信真实的见证人，神创造万有的根源，这样说：</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你要写信给老底嘉教会的使者，说：『那为阿们的，为诚信真实见证的，在神创造万物之上为元首的，说：</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the ruler of God’s creation.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "And to the angel of the church in Laodicea write: ‘The words of the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of God’s creation.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And to the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write, ‘These things says the Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of the creation of God:
verses.textEnNlt: "Write this letter to the angel of the church in Laodicea. This is the message from the one who is the Amen—the faithful and true witness, the beginning of God’s new creation:
verses.textEnNasb: "To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: The Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Origin of the creation of God, says this:
verses.textEn: <red>“To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the ruler of God’s creation.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我知道你的行为，你不冷也不热；我巴不得你或冷或热。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我知道你的行为，你不冷也不热；我巴不得你或冷或热。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我知道你的行为，你也不冷也不热；我巴不得你或冷或热。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I know your deeds, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were either one or the other!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "‘I know your works: you are neither cold nor hot. Would that you were either cold or hot!
verses.textEnNkjv: "I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I could wish you were cold or hot.
verses.textEnNlt: "I know all the things you do, that you are neither hot nor cold. I wish that you were one or the other!
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I know your deeds, that you are neither cold nor hot; I wish that you were cold or hot.
verses.textEn: <red>I know your deeds, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were either one or the other!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为你好象温水，不热也不冷，所以我要把你从我口中吐出去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为你好象温水，不热也不冷，所以我要把你从我口中吐出去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你既如温水，也不冷也不热，所以我必从我口中把你吐出去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So, because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to spit you out of my mouth.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will spit you out of my mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: So then, because you are lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will vomit you out of My mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: But since you are like lukewarm water, neither hot nor cold, I will spit you out of my mouth!
verses.textEnNasb: So because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of My mouth.
verses.textEn: <red>So, because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to spit you out of my mouth.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你说：我是富足的，已经发了财，毫无缺乏。却不知你是困苦的、可怜的、贫穷的、瞎眼的、赤身的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你说：我是富足的，已经发了财，毫无缺乏。却不知你是困苦的、可怜的、贫穷的、瞎眼的、赤身的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你说：我是富足，已经发了财，一样都不缺；却不知道你是那困苦、可怜、贫穷、瞎眼、赤身的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You say, ‘I am rich; I have acquired wealth and do not need a thing.’ But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind and naked.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For you say, "I am rich, I have prospered, and I need nothing," not realizing that you are wretched, pitiable, poor, blind, and naked.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because you say, ‘I am rich, have become wealthy, and have need of nothing’—and do not know that you are wretched, miserable, poor, blind, and naked—
verses.textEnNlt: You say, ‘I am rich. I have everything I want. I don’t need a thing!’ And you don’t realize that you are wretched and miserable and poor and blind and naked.
verses.textEnNasb: Because you say, "I am rich, and have become wealthy, and have no need of anything," and you do not know that you are wretched, miserable, poor, blind, and naked,
verses.textEn: <red>You say, ‘I am rich; I have acquired wealth and do not need a thing.’ But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind and naked.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我劝你向我买精炼的金子，使你富足；又买白衣穿上，使你赤身的羞耻不会显露出来；也买眼药膏抹你的眼睛，使你可以看见。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我劝你向我买精炼的金子，使你富足；又买白衣穿上，使你赤身的羞耻不会显露出来；也买眼药膏抹你的眼睛，使你可以看见。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我劝你向我买火炼的金子，叫你富足；又买白衣穿上，叫你赤身的羞耻不露出来；又买眼药擦你的眼睛，使你能看见。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I counsel you to buy from me gold refined in the fire, so you can become rich; and white clothes to wear, so you can cover your shameful nakedness; and salve to put on your eyes, so you can see.</red>
