verses.textEnEsv: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, so that you may be rich, and white garments so that you may clothe yourself and the shame of your nakedness may not be seen, and salve to anoint your eyes, so that you may see.
verses.textEnNkjv: I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined in the fire, that you may be rich; and white garments, that you may be clothed, that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and anoint your eyes with eye salve, that you may see.
verses.textEnNlt: So I advise you to buy gold from me—gold that has been purified by fire. Then you will be rich. Also buy white garments from me so you will not be shamed by your nakedness, and ointment for your eyes so you will be able to see.
verses.textEnNasb: I advise you to buy from Me gold refined by fire so that you may become rich, and white garments so that you may clothe yourself and the shame of your nakedness will not be revealed; and eye salve to apply to your eyes so that you may see.
verses.textEn: <red>I counsel you to buy from me gold refined in the fire, so you can become rich; and white clothes to wear, so you can cover your shameful nakedness; and salve to put on your eyes, so you can see.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡是我所爱的，我就责备管教；所以你要热心，也要悔改。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡是我所爱的，我就责备管教；所以你要热心，也要悔改。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡我所疼爱的，我就责备管教他；所以你要发热心，也要悔改。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Those whom I love I rebuke and discipline. So be earnest and repent.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Those whom I love, I reprove and discipline, so be zealous and repent.
verses.textEnNkjv: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten. Therefore be zealous and repent.
verses.textEnNlt: I correct and discipline everyone I love. So be diligent and turn from your indifference.
verses.textEnNasb: Those whom I love, I rebuke and discipline; therefore be zealous and repent.
verses.textEn: <red>Those whom I love I rebuke and discipline. So be earnest and repent.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>看哪！我站在门外敲门；如果有人听见我的声音就开门的，我要进到他那里去，我要跟他在一起，他也要跟我在一起吃饭。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>看哪！我站在门外敲门；如果有人听见我的声音就开门的，我要进到他那里去，我要跟他在一起，他也要跟我在一起吃饭。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>看哪，我站在门外叩门，若有听见我声音就开门的，我要进到他那里去，我与他，他与我一同坐席。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with that person, and they with me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and eat with him, and he with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and dine with him, and he with Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look! I stand at the door and knock. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in, and we will share a meal together as friends.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I stand at the door and knock; if anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with Me.
verses.textEn: <red>Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with that person, and they with me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>得胜的，我必定赐他和我一同坐在我的宝座上，正像我得了胜和我父一同坐在他的宝座上一样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>得胜的，我必定赐他和我一同坐在我的宝座上，正像我得了胜和我父一同坐在他的宝座上一样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>得胜的，我要赐他在我宝座上与我同坐，就如我得了胜，在我父的宝座上与他同坐一般。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>To the one who is victorious, I will give the right to sit with me on my throne, just as I was victorious and sat down with my Father on his throne.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The one who conquers, I will grant him to sit with me on my throne, as I also conquered and sat down with my Father on his throne.
verses.textEnNkjv: To him who overcomes I will grant to sit with Me on My throne, as I also overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who are victorious will sit with me on my throne, just as I was victorious and sat with my Father on his throne.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who overcomes, I will grant to him to sit with Me on My throne, as I also overcame and sat with My Father on His throne.
verses.textEn: <red>To the one who is victorious, I will give the right to sit with me on my throne, just as I was victorious and sat down with my Father on his throne.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，有耳的就应当听。’"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，有耳的就应当听。’"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>圣灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone with ears to hear must listen to the Spirit and understand what he is saying to the churches."
verses.textEnNasb: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.’ "
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.”</red>

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，我观看，见天上有一道门开着；并且有我第一次听见的那个好象号筒的声音，对我说："<red>你上这里来！我要把以后必定发生的事指示你。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，我观看，见天上有一道门开着；并且有我第一次听见的那个好象号筒的声音，对我说："<red>你上这里来！我要把以后必定发生的事指示你。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，我观看，见天上有门开了。我初次听见好像吹号的声音，对我说：「<red>你上到这里来，我要将以后必成的事指示你。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: After this I looked, and there before me was a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had first heard speaking to me like a trumpet said, <red>“Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after this.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: After this I looked, and behold, a door standing open in heaven! And the first voice, which I had heard speaking to me like a trumpet, said, "Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after this."
verses.textEnNkjv: After these things I looked, and behold, a door standing open in heaven. And the first voice which I heard was like a trumpet speaking with me, saying, "Come up here, and I will show you things which must take place after this."
verses.textEnNlt: Then as I looked, I saw a door standing open in heaven, and the same voice I had heard before spoke to me like a trumpet blast. The voice said, "Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after this."
verses.textEnNasb: After these things I looked, and behold, a door standing open in heaven, and the first voice which I had heard, like the sound of a trumpet speaking with me, said, "Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after these things."
verses.textEn: After this I looked, and there before me was a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had first heard speaking to me like a trumpet said, <red>“Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after this.”</red>

verses.textZh: 立刻，我在灵里，就看见有一个宝座，设立在天上，有一位坐在宝座上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 立刻，我在灵里，就看见有一个宝座，设立在天上，有一位坐在宝座上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我立刻被圣灵感动，见有一个宝座安置在天上，又有一位坐在宝座上。
verses.textEnNiv: At once I was in the Spirit, and there before me was a throne in heaven with someone sitting on it.
verses.textEnEsv: At once I was in the Spirit, and behold, a throne stood in heaven, with one seated on the throne.
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately I was in the Spirit; and behold, a throne set in heaven, and One sat on the throne.
verses.textEnNlt: And instantly I was in the Spirit, and I saw a throne in heaven and someone sitting on it.
verses.textEnNasb: Immediately I was in the Spirit; and behold, a throne was standing in heaven, and someone was sitting on the throne.
verses.textEn: At once I was in the Spirit, and there before me was a throne in heaven with someone sitting on it.

verses.textZh: 那位坐着的，看来好象碧玉和红宝石，又有彩虹围绕着宝座，看来好象绿宝石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那位坐着的，看来好象碧玉和红宝石，又有彩虹围绕着宝座，看来好象绿宝石。
verses.textZhCuv: 看那坐着的，好像碧玉和红宝石；又有虹围着宝座，好像绿宝石。
verses.textEnNiv: And the one who sat there had the appearance of jasper and ruby. A rainbow that shone like an emerald encircled the throne.
verses.textEnEsv: And he who sat there had the appearance of jasper and carnelian, and around the throne was a rainbow that had the appearance of an emerald.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He who sat there was like a jasper and a sardius stone in appearance; and therewas a rainbow around the throne, in appearance like an emerald.
verses.textEnNlt: The one sitting on the throne was as brilliant as gemstones—like jasper and carnelian. And the glow of an emerald circled his throne like a rainbow.
verses.textEnNasb: And He who was sitting was like a jasper stone and a sardius in appearance; and there was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald in appearance.
verses.textEn: And the one who sat there had the appearance of jasper and ruby. A rainbow that shone like an emerald encircled the throne.

verses.textZh: 宝座的周围有二十四个座位，上面坐着二十四位长老，身穿白衣，头戴金冠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 宝座的周围有二十四个座位，上面坐着二十四位长老，身穿白衣，头戴金冠。
verses.textZhCuv: 宝座的周围又有二十四个座位；其上坐着二十四位长老，身穿白衣，头上戴着金冠冕。
verses.textEnNiv: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and seated on them were twenty-four elders. They were dressed in white and had crowns of gold on their heads.
verses.textEnEsv: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones, and seated on the thrones were twenty-four elders, clothed in white garments, with golden crowns on their heads.
verses.textEnNkjv: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones, and on the thrones I saw twenty-four elders sitting, clothed in white robes; and they had crowns of gold on their heads.
verses.textEnNlt: Twenty-four thrones surrounded him, and twenty-four elders sat on them. They were all clothed in white and had gold crowns on their heads.
verses.textEnNasb: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones; and upon the thrones I saw twenty-four elders sitting, clothed in white garments, and golden crowns on their heads.
verses.textEn: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and seated on them were twenty-four elders. They were dressed in white and had crowns of gold on their heads.

verses.textZh: 有闪电、响声、雷轰从宝座中发出；又有七枝火炬在宝座前点着，这就是神的七灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有闪电、响声、雷轰从宝座中发出；又有七枝火炬在宝座前点着，这就是神的七灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 有闪电、声音、雷轰从宝座中发出；又有七盏火灯在宝座前点着；这七灯就是神的七灵。
verses.textEnNiv: From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings and peals of thunder. In front of the throne, seven lamps were blazing. These are the seven spirits of God.
verses.textEnEsv: From the throne came flashes of lightning, and rumblings and peals of thunder, and before the throne were burning seven torches of fire, which are the seven spirits of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: And from the throne proceeded lightnings, thunderings, and voices. Seven lamps of fire were burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
verses.textEnNlt: From the throne came flashes of lightning and the rumble of thunder. And in front of the throne were seven torches with burning flames. This is the sevenfold Spirit of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Out from the throne *came flashes of lightning and sounds and peals of thunder. And there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven spirits of God;
verses.textEn: From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings and peals of thunder. In front of the throne, seven lamps were blazing. These are the seven spirits of God.

verses.textZh: 宝座前有一个看来好象水晶的玻璃海。 在宝座中间和宝座周围有四个活物，前后布满了眼睛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 宝座前有一个看来好象水晶的玻璃海。 在宝座中间和宝座周围有四个活物，前后布满了眼睛。
verses.textZhCuv: 宝座前好像一个玻璃海，如同水晶。 宝座中和宝座周围有四个活物，前后遍体都满了眼睛。
verses.textEnNiv: Also in front of the throne there was what looked like a sea of glass, clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, and they were covered with eyes, in front and in back.
verses.textEnEsv: and before the throne there was as it were a sea of glass, like crystal. And around the throne, on each side of the throne, are four living creatures, full of eyes in front and behind:
verses.textEnNkjv: Before the throne there was a sea of glass, like crystal. And in the midst of the throne, and around the throne, were four living creatures full of eyes in front and in back.
verses.textEnNlt: In front of the throne was a shiny sea of glass, sparkling like crystal. In the center and around the throne were four living beings, each covered with eyes, front and back.
verses.textEnNasb: and before the throne there was something like a sea of glass, like crystal; and in the center and around the throne, four living creatures full of eyes in front and behind.
verses.textEn: Also in front of the throne there was what looked like a sea of glass, clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, and they were covered with eyes, in front and in back.

verses.textZh: 第一个活物像狮子，第二个活物像牛犊，第三个活物的脸面像人，第四个活物像飞鹰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一个活物像狮子，第二个活物像牛犊，第三个活物的脸面像人，第四个活物像飞鹰。
verses.textZhCuv: 第一个活物像狮子，第二个像牛犊，第三个脸面像人，第四个像飞鹰。
verses.textEnNiv: The first living creature was like a lion, the second was like an ox, the third had a face like a man, the fourth was like a flying eagle.
verses.textEnEsv: the first living creature like a lion, the second living creature like an ox, the third living creature with the face of a man, and the fourth living creature like an eagle in flight.
verses.textEnNkjv: The first living creature was like a lion, the second living creature like a calf, the third living creature had a face like a man, and the fourth living creature was like a flying eagle.
verses.textEnNlt: The first of these living beings was like a lion; the second was like an ox; the third had a human face; and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.
verses.textEnNasb: The first living creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like that of a man, and the fourth creature was like a flying eagle.
verses.textEn: The first living creature was like a lion, the second was like an ox, the third had a face like a man, the fourth was like a flying eagle.

verses.textZh: 四个活物各有六个翅膀，里外布满了眼睛。他们昼夜不停地说： "圣哉！圣哉！圣哉！ 主、全能的神， 昔在、今在、以后要来的那一位。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 四个活物各有六个翅膀，里外布满了眼睛。他们昼夜不停地说： "圣哉！圣哉！圣哉！ 主、全能的神， 昔在、今在、以后要来的那一位。"
verses.textZhCuv: 四活物各有六个翅膀，遍体内外都满了眼睛。他们昼夜不住地说： 圣哉！圣哉！圣哉！ 主神是昔在、今在、 以后永在的全能者。
verses.textEnNiv: Each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around, even under its wings. Day and night they never stop saying: " ‘Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty,’ who was, and is, and is to come."
verses.textEnEsv: And the four living creatures, each of them with six wings, are full of eyes all around and within, and day and night they never cease to say, "Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!"
verses.textEnNkjv: The four living creatures, each having six wings, were full of eyes around and within. And they do not rest day or night, saying: "Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, Who was and is and is to come!"
verses.textEnNlt: Each of these living beings had six wings, and their wings were covered all over with eyes, inside and out. Day after day and night after night they keep on saying, "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty— the one who always was, who is, and who is still to come."
verses.textEnNasb: And the four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within; and day and night they do not cease to say, "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come."
verses.textEn: Each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around, even under its wings. Day and night they never stop saying: " ‘Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty,’ who was, and is, and is to come."

verses.textZh: 每逢四个活物把荣耀、尊贵、感谢献给那坐在宝座上，活到永永远远的那一位的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 每逢四个活物把荣耀、尊贵、感谢献给那坐在宝座上，活到永永远远的那一位的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 每逢四活物将荣耀、尊贵、感谢归给那坐在宝座上、活到永永远远者的时候，
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever the living creatures give glory, honor and thanks to him who sits on the throne and who lives for ever and ever,
verses.textEnEsv: And whenever the living creatures give glory and honor and thanks to him who is seated on the throne, who lives forever and ever,
verses.textEnNkjv: Whenever the living creatures give glory and honor and thanks to Him who sits on the throne, who lives forever and ever,
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever the living beings give glory and honor and thanks to the one sitting on the throne (the one who lives forever and ever),
verses.textEnNasb: And when the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to Him who sits on the throne, to Him who lives forever and ever,
verses.textEn: Whenever the living creatures give glory, honor and thanks to him who sits on the throne and who lives for ever and ever,

verses.textZh: 二十四位长老就俯伏在坐在宝座上那一位的面前，敬拜那活到永永远远的，又把他们的冠冕放在宝座前，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 二十四位长老就俯伏在坐在宝座上那一位的面前，敬拜那活到永永远远的，又把他们的冠冕放在宝座前，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 那二十四位长老就俯伏在坐宝座的面前敬拜那活到永永远远的，又把他们的冠冕放在宝座前，说：
verses.textEnNiv: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives for ever and ever. They lay their crowns before the throne and say:
verses.textEnEsv: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who is seated on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever. They cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: the twenty-four elders fall down before Him who sits on the throne and worship Him who lives forever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: the twenty-four elders fall down and worship the one sitting on the throne (the one who lives forever and ever). And they lay their crowns before the throne and say,
verses.textEnNasb: the twenty-four elders will fall down before Him who sits on the throne, and they will worship Him who lives forever and ever, and will cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
verses.textEn: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives for ever and ever. They lay their crowns before the throne and say:

verses.textZh: "主、我们的神， 你是配得荣耀、尊贵、权能的， 因为你创造了万有， 万有都是因着你的旨意而存在，而被造的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "主、我们的神， 你是配得荣耀、尊贵、权能的， 因为你创造了万有， 万有都是因着你的旨意而存在，而被造的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的主，我们的神， 你是配得荣耀、尊贵、权柄的； 因为你创造了万物， 并且万物是因你的旨意被创造而有的。
verses.textEnNiv: "You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for you created all things, and by your will they were created and have their being."
verses.textEnEsv: "Worthy are you, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for you created all things, and by your will they existed and were created."
verses.textEnNkjv: "You are worthy, O Lord, To receive glory and honor and power; For You created all things, And by Your will they exist and were created."
verses.textEnNlt: "You are worthy, O Lord our God, to receive glory and honor and power. For you created all things, and they exist because you created what you pleased."
verses.textEnNasb: "Worthy are You, our Lord and our God, to receive glory and honor and power; for You created all things, and because of Your will they existed, and were created."
verses.textEn: "You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for you created all things, and by your will they were created and have their being."

verses.textZh: 我看见那位坐在宝座上的，右手拿着书卷，这书卷的两面都写满了字，用七个印封着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见那位坐在宝座上的，右手拿着书卷，这书卷的两面都写满了字，用七个印封着。
verses.textZhCuv: 我看见坐宝座的右手中有书卷，里外都写着字，用七印封严了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I saw in the right hand of him who sat on the throne a scroll with writing on both sides and sealed with seven seals.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I saw in the right hand of him who was seated on the throne a scroll written within and on the back, sealed with seven seals.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I saw in the right hand of Him who sat on the throne a scroll written inside and on the back, sealed with seven seals.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I saw a scroll in the right hand of the one who was sitting on the throne. There was writing on the inside and the outside of the scroll, and it was sealed with seven seals.
verses.textEnNasb: I saw in the right hand of Him who sat on the throne a scroll written inside and on the back, sealed up with seven seals.
verses.textEn: Then I saw in the right hand of him who sat on the throne a scroll with writing on both sides and sealed with seven seals.

verses.textZh: 我又看见一位大力的天使，大声宣告说："谁配展开那书卷，拆开它的封印呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见一位大力的天使，大声宣告说："谁配展开那书卷，拆开它的封印呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见一位大力的天使大声宣传说：「有谁配展开那书卷，揭开那七印呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, "Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?"
verses.textEnEsv: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, "Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, "Who is worthy to open the scroll and to loose its seals?"
verses.textEnNlt: And I saw a strong angel, who shouted with a loud voice: "Who is worthy to break the seals on this scroll and open it?"
verses.textEnNasb: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, "Who is worthy to open the scroll and to break its seals?"
verses.textEn: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, "Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?"

verses.textZh: 在天上、地上、地底下，没有一个能够展开书卷观看的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在天上、地上、地底下，没有一个能够展开书卷观看的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在天上、地上、地底下，没有能展开、能观看那书卷的。
verses.textEnNiv: But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth could open the scroll or even look inside it.
verses.textEnEsv: And no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or to look into it,
verses.textEnNkjv: And no one in heaven or on the earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll, or to look at it.
verses.textEnNlt: But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll and read it.
verses.textEnNasb: And no one in heaven or on the earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or to look into it.
verses.textEn: But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth could open the scroll or even look inside it.

verses.textZh: 因为没有人配展开观看书卷，我就大哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为没有人配展开观看书卷，我就大哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为没有配展开、配观看那书卷的，我就大哭。
verses.textEnNiv: I wept and wept because no one was found who was worthy to open the scroll or look inside.
verses.textEnEsv: and I began to weep loudly because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or to look into it.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open and read the scroll, or to look at it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I began to weep bitterly because no one was found worthy to open the scroll and read it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I began to weep greatly because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or to look into it.
verses.textEn: I wept and wept because no one was found who was worthy to open the scroll or look inside.

verses.textZh: 长老中有一位对我说："不要哭！看哪，那从犹大支派出来的狮子，大卫的根，他已经得胜了，他能够展开那书卷，拆开它的七印。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 长老中有一位对我说："不要哭！看哪，那从犹大支派出来的狮子，大卫的根，他已经得胜了，他能够展开那书卷，拆开它的七印。"
verses.textZhCuv: 长老中有一位对我说：「不要哭！看哪，犹大支派中的狮子，大卫的根，他已得胜，能以展开那书卷，揭开那七印。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then one of the elders said to me, "Do not weep! See, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed. He is able to open the scroll and its seven seals."
verses.textEnEsv: And one of the elders said to me, "Weep no more; behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has conquered, so that he can open the scroll and its seven seals."
verses.textEnNkjv: But one of the elders said to me, "Do not weep. Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has prevailed to open the scroll and to loose its seven seals."
verses.textEnNlt: But one of the twenty-four elders said to me, "Stop weeping! Look, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the heir to David’s throne, has won the victory. He is worthy to open the scroll and its seven seals."
verses.textEnNasb: And one of the elders *said to me, "Stop weeping; behold, the Lion that is from the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome so as to be able to open the scroll and its seven seals."
verses.textEn: Then one of the elders said to me, "Do not weep! See, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed. He is able to open the scroll and its seven seals."

verses.textZh: 我又看见在宝座和四个活物中间，并且在众长老中间，有羊羔站着，像是被杀过的。他有七角七眼，就是神的七灵，奉差遣到全地去的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见在宝座和四个活物中间，并且在众长老中间，有羊羔站着，像是被杀过的。他有七角七眼，就是神的七灵，奉差遣到全地去的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见宝座与四活物，并长老之中有羔羊站立，像是被杀过的，有七角七眼，就是神的七灵，奉差遣往普天下去的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I saw a Lamb, looking as if it had been slain, standing at the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: And between the throne and the four living creatures and among the elders I saw a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, with seven horns and with seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I looked, and behold, in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I saw a Lamb that looked as if it had been slaughtered, but it was now standing between the throne and the four living beings and among the twenty-four elders. He had seven horns and seven eyes, which represent the sevenfold Spirit of God that is sent out into every part of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: And I saw between the throne (with the four living creatures) and the elders a Lamb standing, as if slaughtered, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
verses.textEn: Then I saw a Lamb, looking as if it had been slain, standing at the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.

verses.textZh: 羊羔走过去，从坐在宝座上那位的右手中取了书卷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 羊羔走过去，从坐在宝座上那位的右手中取了书卷。
verses.textZhCuv: 这羔羊前来，从坐宝座的右手里拿了书卷。
verses.textEnNiv: He went and took the scroll from the right hand of him who sat on the throne.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went and took the scroll from the right hand of him who was seated on the throne.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He came and took the scroll out of the right hand of Him who sat on the throne.
verses.textEnNlt: He stepped forward and took the scroll from the right hand of the one sitting on the throne.
verses.textEnNasb: And He came and took the scroll out of the right hand of Him who sat on the throne.
verses.textEn: He went and took the scroll from the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

verses.textZh: 他拿了书卷之后，四个活物和二十四位长老就俯伏在羊羔面前，各拿着琴和盛满了香的金炉，这香就是众圣徒的祈祷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他拿了书卷之后，四个活物和二十四位长老就俯伏在羊羔面前，各拿着琴和盛满了香的金炉，这香就是众圣徒的祈祷。
verses.textZhCuv: 他既拿了书卷，四活物和二十四位长老就俯伏在羔羊面前，各拿着琴和盛满了香的金炉；这香就是众圣徒的祈祷。
verses.textEnNiv: And when he had taken it, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of God’s people.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each holding a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when He had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
verses.textEnNlt: And when he took the scroll, the four living beings and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp, and they held gold bowls filled with incense, which are the prayers of God’s people.
verses.textEnNasb: When He had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one holding a harp and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
verses.textEn: And when he had taken it, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of God’s people.

verses.textZh: 他们唱着新歌，说： "你配取书卷，配拆开封印， 因为你曾被杀，曾用你的血， 从各支派、各方言、各民族、各邦国， 把人买了来归给神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们唱着新歌，说： "你配取书卷，配拆开封印， 因为你曾被杀，曾用你的血， 从各支派、各方言、各民族、各邦国， 把人买了来归给神，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们唱新歌，说： 你配拿书卷， 配揭开七印； 因为你曾被杀， 用自己的血 从各族、各方、各民、各国中买了人来， 叫他们归于神，
verses.textEnNiv: And they sang a new song, saying: "You are worthy to take the scroll and to open its seals, because you were slain, and with your blood you purchased for God persons from every tribe and language and people and nation.
verses.textEnEsv: And they sang a new song, saying, "Worthy are you to take the scroll and to open its seals, for you were slain, and by your blood you ransomed people for God from every tribe and language and people and nation,
verses.textEnNkjv: And they sang a new song, saying: "You are worthy to take the scroll, And to open its seals; For You were slain, And have redeemed us to God by Your blood Out of every tribe and tongue and people and nation,
verses.textEnNlt: And they sang a new song with these words: "You are worthy to take the scroll and break its seals and open it. For you were slaughtered, and your blood has ransomed people for God from every tribe and language and people and nation.
verses.textEnNasb: And they *sang a new song, saying, "Worthy are You to take the scroll and to break its seals; for You were slaughtered, and You purchased people for God with Your blood from every tribe, language, people, and nation.
verses.textEn: And they sang a new song, saying: "You are worthy to take the scroll and to open its seals, because you were slain, and with your blood you purchased for God persons from every tribe and language and people and nation.

verses.textZh: 使他们成为我们神的国度和祭司， 他们要在地上执掌王权。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 使他们成为我们神的国度和祭司， 他们要在地上执掌王权。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又叫他们成为国民， 作祭司归于神， 在地上执掌王权。
verses.textEnNiv: You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will reign on the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: and you have made them a kingdom and priests to our God, and they shall reign on the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: And have made us kings and priests to our God; And we shall reign on the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: And you have caused them to become a Kingdom of priests for our God. And they will reign on the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: You have made them into a kingdom and priests to our God, and they will reign upon the earth."
verses.textEn: You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will reign on the earth."

verses.textZh: 我又观看，听见了千千万万天使的声音，他们都在宝座、活物和长老的四周，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又观看，听见了千千万万天使的声音，他们都在宝座、活物和长老的四周，
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见且听见，宝座与活物并长老的周围有许多天使的声音；他们的数目有千千万万，
verses.textEnNiv: Then I looked and heard the voice of many angels, numbering thousands upon thousands, and ten thousand times ten thousand. They encircled the throne and the living creatures and the elders.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I looked, and I heard around the throne and the living creatures and the elders the voice of many angels, numbering myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I looked, and I heard the voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders; and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands,
verses.textEnNlt: Then I looked again, and I heard the voices of thousands and millions of angels around the throne and of the living beings and the elders.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels around the throne and the living creatures and the elders; and the number of them was myriads of myriads, and thousands of thousands,
verses.textEn: Then I looked and heard the voice of many angels, numbering thousands upon thousands, and ten thousand times ten thousand. They encircled the throne and the living creatures and the elders.

verses.textZh: 大声说： "被杀的羊羔是配得 权能、丰富、智慧、力量、 尊贵、荣耀、颂赞的！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大声说： "被杀的羊羔是配得 权能、丰富、智慧、力量、 尊贵、荣耀、颂赞的！"
verses.textZhCuv: 大声说： 曾被杀的羔羊是配得 权柄、丰富、智慧、能力、 尊贵、荣耀、颂赞的。
verses.textEnNiv: In a loud voice they were saying: "Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain, to receive power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and praise!"
verses.textEnEsv: saying with a loud voice, "Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and wealth and wisdom and might and honor and glory and blessing!"
verses.textEnNkjv: saying with a loud voice: "Worthy is the Lamb who was slain To receive power and riches and wisdom, And strength and honor and glory and blessing!"
verses.textEnNlt: And they sang in a mighty chorus: "Worthy is the Lamb who was slaughtered— to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing."
verses.textEnNasb: saying with a loud voice, "Worthy is the Lamb that was slaughtered to receive power, wealth, wisdom, might, honor, glory, and blessing."
verses.textEn: In a loud voice they were saying: "Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain, to receive power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and praise!"

verses.textZh: 我又听见在天上、地上、地底下和海里的一切被造之物，以及天地间的万有，都说： "愿颂赞、尊贵、荣耀、能力， 都归给坐在宝座上的那一位和羊羔， 直到永永远远！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又听见在天上、地上、地底下和海里的一切被造之物，以及天地间的万有，都说： "愿颂赞、尊贵、荣耀、能力， 都归给坐在宝座上的那一位和羊羔， 直到永永远远！"
verses.textZhCuv: 我又听见在天上、地上、地底下、沧海里，和天地间一切所有被造之物，都说： 但愿颂赞、尊贵、荣耀、权势 都归给坐宝座的和羔羊， 直到永永远远！
verses.textEnNiv: Then I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and on the sea, and all that is in them, saying: "To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power, for ever and ever!"
verses.textEnEsv: And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying, "To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be blessing and honor and glory and might forever and ever!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And every creature which is in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, I heard saying: "Blessing and honor and glory and power Be to Him who sits on the throne, And to the Lamb, forever and ever!"
verses.textEnNlt: And then I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea. They sang: "Blessing and honor and glory and power belong to the one sitting on the throne and to the Lamb forever and ever."
verses.textEnNasb: And I heard every created thing which is in heaven, or on the earth, or under the earth, or on the sea, and all the things in them, saying, "To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion forever and ever."
verses.textEn: Then I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and on the sea, and all that is in them, saying: "To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power, for ever and ever!"

verses.textZh: 四个活物就说："阿们！"众长老也俯伏敬拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 四个活物就说："阿们！"众长老也俯伏敬拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 四活物就说：「阿们！」众长老也俯伏敬拜。
verses.textEnNiv: The four living creatures said, "Amen," and the elders fell down and worshiped.
verses.textEnEsv: And the four living creatures said, "Amen!" and the elders fell down and worshiped.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the four living creatures said, "Amen!" And the twenty-four elders fell down and worshiped Him who lives forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: And the four living beings said, "Amen!" And the twenty-four elders fell down and worshiped the Lamb.
verses.textEnNasb: And the four living creatures were saying, "Amen." And the elders fell down and worshiped.
verses.textEn: The four living creatures said, "Amen," and the elders fell down and worshiped.

verses.textZh: 羊羔揭开了七印的第一个印的时候，我观看，就听见四个活物中的一个，发出好象雷轰的声响，说："你来！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 羊羔揭开了七印的第一个印的时候，我观看，就听见四个活物中的一个，发出好象雷轰的声响，说："你来！"
verses.textZhCuv: 我看见羔羊揭开七印中第一印的时候，就听见四活物中的一个活物，声音如雷，说：「你来！」
verses.textEnNiv: I watched as the Lamb opened the first of the seven seals. Then I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice like thunder, "Come!"
verses.textEnEsv: Now I watched when the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say with a voice like thunder, "Come!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals; and I heard one of the four living creatures saying with a voice like thunder, "Come and see."
verses.textEnNlt: As I watched, the Lamb broke the first of the seven seals on the scroll. Then I heard one of the four living beings say with a voice like thunder, "Come!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then I saw when the Lamb broke one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying as with a voice of thunder, "Come !"
verses.textEn: I watched as the Lamb opened the first of the seven seals. Then I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice like thunder, "Come!"

verses.textZh: 我观看，见有一匹白马；骑在马上的拿着弓，有冠冕赐给他，他就出去，得胜并且要再得胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看，见有一匹白马；骑在马上的拿着弓，有冠冕赐给他，他就出去，得胜并且要再得胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就观看，见有一匹白马；骑在马上的，拿着弓，并有冠冕赐给他。他便出来，胜了又要胜。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked, and there before me was a white horse! Its rider held a bow, and he was given a crown, and he rode out as a conqueror bent on conquest.
verses.textEnEsv: And I looked, and behold, a white horse! And its rider had a bow, and a crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I looked, and behold, a white horse. He who sat on it had a bow; and a crown was given to him, and he went out conquering and to conquer.
verses.textEnNlt: I looked up and saw a white horse standing there. Its rider carried a bow, and a crown was placed on his head. He rode out to win many battles and gain the victory.
verses.textEnNasb: I looked, and behold, a white horse, and the one who sat on it had a bow; and a crown was given to him, and he went out conquering and to conquer.
verses.textEn: I looked, and there before me was a white horse! Its rider held a bow, and he was given a crown, and he rode out as a conqueror bent on conquest.

verses.textZh: 羊羔揭开了第二个印的时候，我听见第二个活物说："你来！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 羊羔揭开了第二个印的时候，我听见第二个活物说："你来！"
verses.textZhCuv: 揭开第二印的时候，我听见第二个活物说：「你来！」
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, "Come!"
verses.textEnEsv: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, "Come!"
verses.textEnNkjv: When He opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, "Come and see."
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lamb broke the second seal, I heard the second living being say, "Come!"
verses.textEnNasb: When He broke the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, "Come !"
verses.textEn: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, "Come!"

verses.textZh: 就另有一匹红马出来，骑在马上的得了权柄，可以从地上夺去和平，使人互相残杀，又有一把大刀赐给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就另有一匹红马出来，骑在马上的得了权柄，可以从地上夺去和平，使人互相残杀，又有一把大刀赐给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 就另有一匹马出来，是红的，有权柄给了那骑马的，可以从地上夺去太平，使人彼此相杀；又有一把大刀赐给他。
verses.textEnNiv: Then another horse came out, a fiery red one. Its rider was given power to take peace from the earth and to make people kill each other. To him was given a large sword.
verses.textEnEsv: And out came another horse, bright red. Its rider was permitted to take peace from the earth, so that people should slay one another, and he was given a great sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: Another horse, fiery red, went out. And it was granted to the one who sat on it to take peace from the earth, and that people should kill one another; and there was given to him a great sword.
verses.textEnNlt: Then another horse appeared, a red one. Its rider was given a mighty sword and the authority to take peace from the earth. And there was war and slaughter everywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: And another, a red horse, went out; and to him who sat on it, it was granted to take peace from the earth, and that people would kill one another; and a large sword was given to him.
verses.textEn: Then another horse came out, a fiery red one. Its rider was given power to take peace from the earth and to make people kill each other. To him was given a large sword.

verses.textZh: 羊羔揭开了第三个印的时候，我听见第三个活物说："你来！"我观看，见有一匹黑马；骑在马上的，手中拿着天平。
verses.textZhCnvs: 羊羔揭开了第三个印的时候，我听见第三个活物说："你来！"我观看，见有一匹黑马；骑在马上的，手中拿着天平。
verses.textZhCuv: 揭开第三印的时候，我听见第三个活物说：「你来！」我就观看，见有一匹黑马；骑在马上的，手里拿着天平。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, "Come!" I looked, and there before me was a black horse! Its rider was holding a pair of scales in his hand.
verses.textEnEsv: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, "Come!" And I looked, and behold, a black horse! And its rider had a pair of scales in his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, "Come and see." So I looked, and behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a pair of scales in his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lamb broke the third seal, I heard the third living being say, "Come!" I looked up and saw a black horse, and its rider was holding a pair of scales in his hand.
verses.textEnNasb: When He broke the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, "Come !" I looked, and behold, a black horse, and the one who sat on it had a pair of scales in his hand.
verses.textEn: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, "Come!" I looked, and there before me was a black horse! Its rider was holding a pair of scales in his hand.

verses.textZh: 我听见在四个活物中间，仿佛有声音说："一公升小麦卖一个银币，三公升大麦卖一个银币，油和酒也不可糟蹋。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见在四个活物中间，仿佛有声音说："一公升小麦卖一个银币，三公升大麦卖一个银币，油和酒也不可糟蹋。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见在四活物中似乎有声音说：「一钱银子买一升麦子，一钱银子买三升大麦；油和酒不可糟蹋。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I heard what sounded like a voice among the four living creatures, saying, "Two pounds of wheat for a day’s wages, and six pounds of barley for a day’s wages, and do not damage the oil and the wine!"
verses.textEnEsv: And I heard what seemed to be a voice in the midst of the four living creatures, saying, "A quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius, and do not harm the oil and wine!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying, "A quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius; and do not harm the oil and the wine."
verses.textEnNlt: And I heard a voice from among the four living beings say, "A loaf of wheat bread or three loaves of barley will cost a day’s pay. And don’t waste the olive oil and wine."
verses.textEnNasb: And I heard something like a voice in the center of the four living creatures saying, "A quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius; and do not damage the oil and the wine."
verses.textEn: Then I heard what sounded like a voice among the four living creatures, saying, "Two pounds of wheat for a day’s wages, and six pounds of barley for a day’s wages, and do not damage the oil and the wine!"

verses.textZh: 羊羔揭开了第四个印的时候，我听见第四个活物的声音说："你来！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 羊羔揭开了第四个印的时候，我听见第四个活物的声音说："你来！"
verses.textZhCuv: 揭开第四印的时候，我听见第四个活物说：「你来！」
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, "Come!"
verses.textEnEsv: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, "Come!"
verses.textEnNkjv: When He opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, "Come and see."
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lamb broke the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living being say, "Come!"
verses.textEnNasb: When the Lamb broke the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, "Come !"
verses.textEn: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, "Come!"

verses.textZh: 我观看，见有一匹灰马；骑在马上的，名字叫作"死"。阴间也跟随着他。他们得了权柄可以管辖地上的四分之一，又要用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫和地上的野兽去杀人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看，见有一匹灰马；骑在马上的，名字叫作"死"。阴间也跟随着他。他们得了权柄可以管辖地上的四分之一，又要用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫和地上的野兽去杀人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就观看，见有一匹灰色马；骑在马上的，名字叫作死，阴府也随着他；有权柄赐给他们，可以用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫 、野兽，杀害地上四分之一的人。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked, and there before me was a pale horse! Its rider was named Death, and Hades was following close behind him. They were given power over a fourth of the earth to kill by sword, famine and plague, and by the wild beasts of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: And I looked, and behold, a pale horse! And its rider’s name was Death, and Hades followed him. And they were given authority over a fourth of the earth, to kill with sword and with famine and with pestilence and by wild beasts of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I looked, and behold, a pale horse. And the name of him who sat on it was Death, and Hades followed with him. And power was given to them over a fourth of the earth, to kill with sword, with hunger, with death, and by the beasts of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: I looked up and saw a horse whose color was pale green. Its rider was named Death, and his companion was the Grave. These two were given authority over one-fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword and famine and disease and wild animals.
verses.textEnNasb: I looked, and behold, an ashen horse; and the one who sat on it had the name Death, and Hades was following with him. Authority was given to them over a fourth of the earth, to kill with sword, and famine, and plague, and by the wild animals of the earth.
verses.textEn: I looked, and there before me was a pale horse! Its rider was named Death, and Hades was following close behind him. They were given power over a fourth of the earth to kill by sword, famine and plague, and by the wild beasts of the earth.

verses.textZh: 羊羔揭开了第五个印的时候，我看见祭坛底下，有为了神的道，并且为了自己所作的见证而被杀的人的灵魂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 羊羔揭开了第五个印的时候，我看见祭坛底下，有为了神的道，并且为了自己所作的见证而被杀的人的灵魂。
verses.textZhCuv: 揭开第五印的时候，我看见在祭坛底下，有为神的道、并为作见证被杀之人的灵魂，
verses.textEnNiv: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain because of the word of God and the testimony they had maintained.
verses.textEnEsv: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God and for the witness they had borne.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God and for the testimony which they held.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lamb broke the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of all who had been martyred for the word of God and for being faithful in their testimony.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Lamb broke the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed because of the word of God, and because of the testimony which they had maintained;
verses.textEn: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain because of the word of God and the testimony they had maintained.

verses.textZh: 他们大声喊叫，说："圣洁真实的主啊！你不审判住在地上的人，给我们伸流血的冤，要到几时呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们大声喊叫，说："圣洁真实的主啊！你不审判住在地上的人，给我们伸流血的冤，要到几时呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 大声喊着说：「圣洁真实的主啊，你不审判住在地上的人，给我们伸流血的冤，要等到几时呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: They called out in a loud voice, "How long, Sovereign Lord, holy and true, until you judge the inhabitants of the earth and avenge our blood?"
verses.textEnEsv: They cried out with a loud voice, "O Sovereign Lord, holy and true, how long before you will judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, "How long, O Lord, holy and true, until You judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?"
verses.textEnNlt: They shouted to the Lord and said, "O Sovereign Lord, holy and true, how long before you judge the people who belong to this world and avenge our blood for what they have done to us?"
verses.textEnNasb: and they cried out with a loud voice, saying, "How long, O Lord, holy and true, will You refrain from judging and avenging our blood on those who live on the earth?"
verses.textEn: They called out in a loud voice, "How long, Sovereign Lord, holy and true, until you judge the inhabitants of the earth and avenge our blood?"

verses.textZh: 于是有白袍赐给他们各人，又有话吩咐他们要安息一会儿，等到那些与他们同作仆人和弟兄，像他们一样将要被杀的人，凑满了数目的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是有白袍赐给他们各人，又有话吩咐他们要安息一会儿，等到那些与他们同作仆人和弟兄，像他们一样将要被杀的人，凑满了数目的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是有白衣赐给他们各人；又有话对他们说，还要安息片时，等着一同作仆人的和他们的弟兄也像他们被杀，满足了数目。
verses.textEnNiv: Then each of them was given a white robe, and they were told to wait a little longer, until the full number of their fellow servants, their brothers and sisters, were killed just as they had been.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they were each given a white robe and told to rest a little longer, until the number of their fellow servants and their brothers should be complete, who were to be killed as they themselves had been.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a white robe was given to each of them; and it was said to them that they should rest a little while longer, until both thenumberof their fellow servants and their brethren, who would be killed as they were, was completed.
verses.textEnNlt: Then a white robe was given to each of them. And they were told to rest a little longer until the full number of their brothers and sisters —their fellow servants of Jesus who were to be martyred—had joined them.
verses.textEnNasb: And a white robe was given to each of them; and they were told that they were to rest for a little while longer, until the number of their fellow servants and their brothers and sisters who were to be killed even as they had been, was completed also.
verses.textEn: Then each of them was given a white robe, and they were told to wait a little longer, until the full number of their fellow servants, their brothers and sisters, were killed just as they had been.

verses.textZh: 羊羔揭开了第六个印的时候，我观看，大地震就发生了。太阳变黑，像粗糙的黑毛布；整个月亮变红，像血一样；
verses.textZhCnvs: 羊羔揭开了第六个印的时候，我观看，大地震就发生了。太阳变黑，像粗糙的黑毛布；整个月亮变红，像血一样；
verses.textZhCuv: 揭开第六印的时候，我又看见地大震动，日头变黑像毛布，满月变红像血，
verses.textEnNiv: I watched as he opened the sixth seal. There was a great earthquake. The sun turned black like sackcloth made of goat hair, the whole moon turned blood red,
verses.textEnEsv: When he opened the sixth seal, I looked, and behold, there was a great earthquake, and the sun became black as sackcloth, the full moon became like blood,
verses.textEnNkjv: I looked when He opened the sixth seal, and behold, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became like blood.
verses.textEnNlt: I watched as the Lamb broke the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became as dark as black cloth, and the moon became as red as blood.
verses.textEnNasb: And I looked when He broke the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake; and the sun became as black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became like blood;
verses.textEn: I watched as he opened the sixth seal. There was a great earthquake. The sun turned black like sackcloth made of goat hair, the whole moon turned blood red,

verses.textZh: 天上的星辰坠落在地上，像无花果树被大风摇动，落下还没有成熟的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天上的星辰坠落在地上，像无花果树被大风摇动，落下还没有成熟的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 天上的星辰坠落于地，如同无花果树被大风摇动，落下未熟的果子一样。
verses.textEnNiv: and the stars in the sky fell to earth, as figs drop from a fig tree when shaken by a strong wind.
verses.textEnEsv: and the stars of the sky fell to the earth as the fig tree sheds its winter fruit when shaken by a gale.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the stars of heaven fell to the earth, as a fig tree drops its late figs when it is shaken by a mighty wind.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the stars of the sky fell to the earth like green figs falling from a tree shaken by a strong wind.
verses.textEnNasb: and the stars of the sky fell to the earth, as a fig tree drops its unripe figs when shaken by a great wind.
verses.textEn: and the stars in the sky fell to earth, as figs drop from a fig tree when shaken by a strong wind.

verses.textZh: 天隐退了，像书被卷起来一样；山岭和海岛都从原处移去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天隐退了，像书被卷起来一样；山岭和海岛都从原处移去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 天就挪移，好像书卷被卷起来；山岭海岛都被挪移离开本位。
verses.textEnNiv: The heavens receded like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was removed from its place.
verses.textEnEsv: The sky vanished like a scroll that is being rolled up, and every mountain and island was removed from its place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the sky receded as a scroll when it is rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved out of its place.
verses.textEnNlt: The sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all of the mountains and islands were moved from their places.
verses.textEnNasb: The sky was split apart like a scroll when it is rolled up, and every mountain and island was removed from its place.
verses.textEn: The heavens receded like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was removed from its place.

verses.textZh: 地上的君王、大臣、军长、财主、勇士和所有作奴隶的、自由的，都藏在山洞和岩穴里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地上的君王、大臣、军长、财主、勇士和所有作奴隶的、自由的，都藏在山洞和岩穴里。
verses.textZhCuv: 地上的君王、臣宰、将军、富户、壮士，和一切为奴的、自主的，都藏在山洞和岩石穴里，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the kings of the earth, the princes, the generals, the rich, the mighty, and everyone else, both slave and free, hid in caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the kings of the earth and the great ones and the generals and the rich and the powerful, and everyone, slave and free, hid themselves in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the kings of the earth, the great men, the rich men, the commanders, the mighty men, every slave and every free man, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains,
verses.textEnNlt: Then everyone—the kings of the earth, the rulers, the generals, the wealthy, the powerful, and every slave and free person—all hid themselves in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the kings of the earth and the eminent people, and the commanders and the wealthy and the strong, and every slave and free person hid themselves in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains;
verses.textEn: Then the kings of the earth, the princes, the generals, the rich, the mighty, and everyone else, both slave and free, hid in caves and among the rocks of the mountains.

verses.textZh: 他们向山岭和岩石说："倒在我们身上吧！把我们藏起来，躲避坐在宝座上那位的面，和羊羔的震怒！
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们向山岭和岩石说："倒在我们身上吧！把我们藏起来，躲避坐在宝座上那位的面，和羊羔的震怒！
verses.textZhCuv: 向山和岩石说：「倒在我们身上吧！把我们藏起来，躲避坐宝座者的面目和羔羊的忿怒；
verses.textEnNiv: They called to the mountains and the rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb!
verses.textEnEsv: calling to the mountains and rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the face of him who is seated on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to the mountains and rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the face of Him who sits on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb!
verses.textEnNlt: And they cried to the mountains and the rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the face of the one who sits on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb.
verses.textEnNasb: and they *said to the mountains and the rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the sight of Him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb;
verses.textEn: They called to the mountains and the rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb!

verses.textZh: 因为他们震怒的大日子来到了，谁能站立得住呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们震怒的大日子来到了，谁能站立得住呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们忿怒的大日到了，谁能站得住呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: For the great day of their wrath has come, and who can withstand it?"
verses.textEnEsv: for the great day of their wrath has come, and who can stand?"
verses.textEnNkjv: For the great day of His wrath has come, and who is able to stand?"
verses.textEnNlt: For the great day of their wrath has come, and who is able to survive?"
verses.textEnNasb: for the great day of Their wrath has come, and who is able to stand?"
verses.textEn: For the great day of their wrath has come, and who can withstand it?"

verses.textZh: 这事以后，我看见四位天使站在地的四极，掌握着地上的四风，不使风吹在地上、海上和任何树上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事以后，我看见四位天使站在地的四极，掌握着地上的四风，不使风吹在地上、海上和任何树上。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，我看见四位天使站在地的四角，执掌地上四方的风，叫风不吹在地上、海上，和树上。
verses.textEnNiv: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth to prevent any wind from blowing on the land or on the sea or on any tree.
verses.textEnEsv: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth, that no wind might blow on earth or sea or against any tree.
verses.textEnNkjv: After these things I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, on the sea, or on any tree.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds so they did not blow on the earth or the sea, or even on any tree.
verses.textEnNasb: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.
verses.textEn: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth to prevent any wind from blowing on the land or on the sea or on any tree.

verses.textZh: 我又看见另外一位天使，从日出之地上来，拿着永活神的印，向那四位得了权柄可以伤害地和海的天使，大声呼喊，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见另外一位天使，从日出之地上来，拿着永活神的印，向那四位得了权柄可以伤害地和海的天使，大声呼喊，
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见另有一位天使，从日出之地上来，拿着永生神的印。他就向那得着权柄能伤害地和海的四位天使大声喊着说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then I saw another angel coming up from the east, having the seal of the living God. He called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:
verses.textEnEsv: Then I saw another angel ascending from the rising of the sun, with the seal of the living God, and he called with a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm earth and sea,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God. And he cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was granted to harm the earth and the sea,
verses.textEnNlt: And I saw another angel coming up from the east, carrying the seal of the living God. And he shouted to those four angels, who had been given power to harm land and sea,
verses.textEnNasb: And I saw another angel ascending from the rising of the sun, holding the seal of the living God; and he called out with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was granted to harm the earth and the sea,
verses.textEn: Then I saw another angel coming up from the east, having the seal of the living God. He called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:

verses.textZh: 说："你们不要伤害地、海和树木，等我们在神众仆人的额上先盖上了印。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："你们不要伤害地、海和树木，等我们在神众仆人的额上先盖上了印。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「地与海并树木，你们不可伤害，等我们印了我们神众仆人的额。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not harm the land or the sea or the trees until we put a seal on the foreheads of the servants of our God."
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "Do not harm the earth or the sea or the trees, until we have sealed the servants of our God on their foreheads."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "Do not harm the earth, the sea, or the trees till we have sealed the servants of our God on their foreheads."
verses.textEnNlt: "Wait! Don’t harm the land or the sea or the trees until we have placed the seal of God on the foreheads of his servants."
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "Do not harm the earth, or the sea, or the trees until we have sealed the bond-servants of our God on their foreheads."
verses.textEn: "Do not harm the land or the sea or the trees until we put a seal on the foreheads of the servants of our God."

verses.textZh: 我听见被盖印的人的数目，以色列子孙各支派中被盖印的共有十四万四千人：
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见被盖印的人的数目，以色列子孙各支派中被盖印的共有十四万四千人：
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见以色列人各支派中受印的数目有十四万四千。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I heard the number of those who were sealed: 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And I heard the number of the sealed, 144,000, sealed from every tribe of the sons of Israel:
verses.textEnNkjv: And I heard the number of those who were sealed. One hundred and forty-four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel were sealed:
verses.textEnNlt: And I heard how many were marked with the seal of God—144,000 were sealed from all the tribes of Israel:
verses.textEnNasb: And I heard the number of those who were sealed: 144,000, sealed from every tribe of the sons of Israel:
verses.textEn: Then I heard the number of those who were sealed: 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel.

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，我观看，见有一大群人，没有人能数得过来，是从各邦国、各支派、各民族、各方言来的。他们都站在宝座和羊羔面前，身穿白袍，手里拿着棕树枝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，我观看，见有一大群人，没有人能数得过来，是从各邦国、各支派、各民族、各方言来的。他们都站在宝座和羊羔面前，身穿白袍，手里拿着棕树枝。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，我观看，见有许多的人，没有人能数过来，是从各国、各族、各民、各方来的，站在宝座和羔羊面前，身穿白衣，手拿棕树枝，
verses.textEnNiv: After this I looked, and there before me was a great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, people and language, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. They were wearing white robes and were holding palm branches in their hands.
verses.textEnEsv: After this I looked, and behold, a great multitude that no one could number, from every nation, from all tribes and peoples and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands,
verses.textEnNkjv: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no one could number, of all nations, tribes, peoples, and tongues, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, with palm branches in their hands,
verses.textEnNlt: After this I saw a vast crowd, too great to count, from every nation and tribe and people and language, standing in front of the throne and before the Lamb. They were clothed in white robes and held palm branches in their hands.
verses.textEnNasb: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no one could count, from every nation and all the tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed in white robes, and palm branches were in their hands;
verses.textEn: After this I looked, and there before me was a great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, people and language, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. They were wearing white robes and were holding palm branches in their hands.

verses.textZh: 他们大声呼喊，说： "愿救恩归给那坐在宝座上我们的神，也归给羊羔！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们大声呼喊，说： "愿救恩归给那坐在宝座上我们的神，也归给羊羔！"
verses.textZhCuv: 大声喊着说：「愿救恩归与坐在宝座上我们的神，也归与羔羊！」
verses.textEnNiv: And they cried out in a loud voice: "Salvation belongs to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb."
verses.textEnEsv: and crying out with a loud voice, "Salvation belongs to our God who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!"
verses.textEnNkjv: and crying out with a loud voice, saying, "Salvation belongs to our God who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!"
verses.textEnNlt: And they were shouting with a great roar, "Salvation comes from our God who sits on the throne and from the Lamb!"
verses.textEnNasb: and they *cried out with a loud voice, saying, "Salvation belongs to our God who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb."
verses.textEn: And they cried out in a loud voice: "Salvation belongs to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb."

verses.textZh: 所有的天使都站在宝座、众长老和四个活物的四周。他们在宝座前，面伏在地上敬拜神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的天使都站在宝座、众长老和四个活物的四周。他们在宝座前，面伏在地上敬拜神，
verses.textZhCuv: 众天使都站在宝座和众长老并四活物的周围，在宝座前，面伏于地，敬拜神，
verses.textEnNiv: All the angels were standing around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. They fell down on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,
verses.textEnEsv: And all the angels were standing around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures, and they fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,
verses.textEnNkjv: All the angels stood around the throne and the elders and the four living creatures, and fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,
verses.textEnNlt: And all the angels were standing around the throne and around the elders and the four living beings. And they fell before the throne with their faces to the ground and worshiped God.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the angels were standing around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,
verses.textEn: All the angels were standing around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. They fell down on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,

verses.textZh: 说： "阿们！愿颂赞、荣耀、智慧、 感谢、尊贵、权能、力量， 都归给我们的神， 直到永永远远。阿们！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说： "阿们！愿颂赞、荣耀、智慧、 感谢、尊贵、权能、力量， 都归给我们的神， 直到永永远远。阿们！"
verses.textZhCuv: 说： 阿们！颂赞、荣耀、智慧、 感谢、尊贵、权柄、大力 都归与我们的神， 直到永永远远。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: saying: "Amen! Praise and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God for ever and ever. Amen!"
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and might be to our God forever and ever! Amen."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying: "Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom, Thanksgiving and honor and power and might, Be to our God forever and ever. Amen."
verses.textEnNlt: They sang, "Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen."
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "Amen, blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might belong to our God forever and ever. Amen."
verses.textEn: saying: "Amen! Praise and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God for ever and ever. Amen!"

verses.textZh: 长老中有一位问我："这些身穿白袍的是谁？他们是从哪里来的呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 长老中有一位问我："这些身穿白袍的是谁？他们是从哪里来的呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 长老中有一位问我说：「这些穿白衣的是谁？是从哪里来的？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then one of the elders asked me, "These in white robes—who are they, and where did they come from?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then one of the elders addressed me, saying, "Who are these, clothed in white robes, and from where have they come?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one of the elders answered, saying to me, "Who are these arrayed in white robes, and where did they come from?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then one of the twenty-four elders asked me, "Who are these who are clothed in white? Where did they come from?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then one of the elders responded, saying to me, "These who are clothed in the white robes, who are they, and where have they come from?"
verses.textEn: Then one of the elders asked me, "These in white robes—who are they, and where did they come from?"

verses.textZh: 我对他说："我主啊，你是知道的。"他告诉我："这些人是从大患难中出来的。他们用羊羔的血，把自己的衣袍洗洁白了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我对他说："我主啊，你是知道的。"他告诉我："这些人是从大患难中出来的。他们用羊羔的血，把自己的衣袍洗洁白了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我对他说：「我主，你知道。」他向我说：「这些人是从大患难中出来的，曾用羔羊的血把衣裳洗白净了。
verses.textEnNiv: I answered, "Sir, you know." And he said, "These are they who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
verses.textEnEsv: I said to him, "Sir, you know." And he said to me, "These are the ones coming out of the great tribulation. They have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I said to him, "Sir, you know." So he said to me, "These are the ones who come out of the great tribulation, and washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
verses.textEnNlt: And I said to him, "Sir, you are the one who knows." Then he said to me, "These are the ones who died in the great tribulation. They have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb and made them white.
verses.textEnNasb: I said to him, "My lord, you know." And he said to me, "These are the ones who come out of the great tribulation, and they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
verses.textEn: I answered, "Sir, you know." And he said, "These are they who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

verses.textZh: 因此，他们可以在神的宝座前，并且日夜在他的圣所里事奉他。那坐在宝座上的必展开帐幕覆庇他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，他们可以在神的宝座前，并且日夜在他的圣所里事奉他。那坐在宝座上的必展开帐幕覆庇他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，他们在神宝座前，昼夜在他殿中事奉他。坐宝座的要用帐幕覆庇他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, "they are before the throne of God and serve him day and night in his temple; and he who sits on the throne will shelter them with his presence.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore they are before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple; and he who sits on the throne will shelter them with his presence.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and serve Him day and night in His temple. And He who sits on the throne will dwell among them.
verses.textEnNlt: "That is why they stand in front of God’s throne and serve him day and night in his Temple. And he who sits on the throne will give them shelter.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason they are before the throne of God, and they serve Him day and night in His temple; and He who sits on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.
verses.textEn: Therefore, "they are before the throne of God and serve him day and night in his temple; and he who sits on the throne will shelter them with his presence.

verses.textZh: 他们必不再饿，也不再渴；太阳和一切炎热必不伤害他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必不再饿，也不再渴；太阳和一切炎热必不伤害他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不再饥，不再渴；日头和炎热也必不伤害他们。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Never again will they hunger; never again will they thirst. The sun will not beat down on them,’ nor any scorching heat.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst anymore; the sun shall not strike them, nor any scorching heat.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall neither hunger anymore nor thirst anymore; the sun shall not strike them, nor any heat;
verses.textEnNlt: They will never again be hungry or thirsty; they will never be scorched by the heat of the sun.
verses.textEnNasb: They will no longer hunger nor thirst, nor will the sun beat down on them, nor any scorching heat;
verses.textEn: ‘Never again will they hunger; never again will they thirst. The sun will not beat down on them,’ nor any scorching heat.

verses.textZh: 因为在宝座中间的羊羔必牧养他们，领他们到生命水的泉源那里。神也必抹去他们的一切眼泪。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为在宝座中间的羊羔必牧养他们，领他们到生命水的泉源那里。神也必抹去他们的一切眼泪。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为宝座中的羔羊必牧养他们，领他们到生命水的泉源；神也必擦去他们一切的眼泪。」
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lamb at the center of the throne will be their shepherd; ‘he will lead them to springs of living water.’ ‘And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lamb in the midst of the throne will be their shepherd, and he will guide them to springs of living water, and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes."
verses.textEnNkjv: for the Lamb who is in the midst of the throne will shepherd them and lead them to living fountains of waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lamb on the throne will be their Shepherd. He will lead them to springs of life-giving water. And God will wipe every tear from their eyes."
verses.textEnNasb: for the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd, and will guide them to springs of the water of life; and God will wipe every tear from their eyes."
verses.textEn: For the Lamb at the center of the throne will be their shepherd; ‘he will lead them to springs of living water.’ ‘And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’ "

verses.textZh: 羊羔揭开第七个印的时候，天上静默了大约半小时。
verses.textZhCnvs: 羊羔揭开第七个印的时候，天上静默了大约半小时。
verses.textZhCuv: 羔羊揭开第七印的时候，天上寂静约有二刻。
verses.textEnNiv: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
verses.textEnEsv: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lamb broke the seventh seal on the scroll, there was silence throughout heaven for about half an hour.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Lamb broke the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
verses.textEn: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

verses.textZh: 我看见站在神面前的七位天使，有七枝号筒赐给了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见站在神面前的七位天使，有七枝号筒赐给了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我看见那站在神面前的七位天使，有七枝号赐给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and to them were given seven trumpets.
verses.textEnNlt: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and they were given seven trumpets.
verses.textEnNasb: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.
verses.textEn: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

verses.textZh: 另外有一位天使来了，拿着金香炉，站在祭坛前。有许多香赐给了他，好与所有圣徒的祈祷一同献在宝座前的金坛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 另外有一位天使来了，拿着金香炉，站在祭坛前。有许多香赐给了他，好与所有圣徒的祈祷一同献在宝座前的金坛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 另有一位天使，拿着金香炉来，站在祭坛旁边。有许多香赐给他，要和众圣徒的祈祷一同献在宝座前的金坛上。
verses.textEnNiv: Another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer, with the prayers of all God’s people, on the golden altar in front of the throne.
verses.textEnEsv: And another angel came and stood at the altar with a golden censer, and he was given much incense to offer with the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar before the throne,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then another angel, having a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.
verses.textEnNlt: Then another angel with a gold incense burner came and stood at the altar. And a great amount of incense was given to him to mix with the prayers of God’s people as an offering on the gold altar before the throne.
verses.textEnNasb: Another angel came and stood at the altar, holding a golden censer; and much incense was given to him, so that he might add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.
verses.textEn: Another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer, with the prayers of all God’s people, on the golden altar in front of the throne.

verses.textZh: 那香的烟和众圣徒的祈祷，就从天使手中一同升到神面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那香的烟和众圣徒的祈祷，就从天使手中一同升到神面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 那香的烟和众圣徒的祈祷从天使的手中一同升到神面前。
verses.textEnNiv: The smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God’s people, went up before God from the angel’s hand.
verses.textEnEsv: and the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, rose before God from the hand of the angel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, ascended before God from the angel’s hand.
verses.textEnNlt: The smoke of the incense, mixed with the prayers of God’s holy people, ascended up to God from the altar where the angel had poured them out.
verses.textEnNasb: And the smoke of the incense ascended from the angel’s hand with the prayers of the saints before God.
verses.textEn: The smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God’s people, went up before God from the angel’s hand.

verses.textZh: 天使拿着香炉，用坛上的火把它装满了，投在地上；于是就有雷轰、响声、闪电和地震。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天使拿着香炉，用坛上的火把它装满了，投在地上；于是就有雷轰、响声、闪电和地震。
verses.textZhCuv: 天使拿着香炉，盛满了坛上的火，倒在地上；随有雷轰、大声、闪电、地震。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it on the earth; and there came peals of thunder, rumblings, flashes of lightning and an earthquake.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the angel took the censer and filled it with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth, and there were peals of thunder, rumblings, flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and threw it to the earth. And there were noises, thunderings, lightnings, and an earthquake.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel filled the incense burner with fire from the altar and threw it down upon the earth; and thunder crashed, lightning flashed, and there was a terrible earthquake.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the angel took the censer and filled it with the fire of the altar, and hurled it to the earth; and there were peals of thunder and sounds, and flashes of lightning and an earthquake.
verses.textEn: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it on the earth; and there came peals of thunder, rumblings, flashes of lightning and an earthquake.

verses.textZh: 拿着七枝号筒的七位天使，预备好了要吹号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿着七枝号筒的七位天使，预备好了要吹号。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿着七枝号的七位天使就预备要吹。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared to blow them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the seven angels with the seven trumpets prepared to blow their mighty blasts.
verses.textEnNasb: And the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound them.
verses.textEn: Then the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.

verses.textZh: 第一位天使吹号，就有冰雹和混杂着血的火，投在地上。地的三分之一烧掉了，树的三分之一烧掉了，所有的青草也烧掉了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一位天使吹号，就有冰雹和混杂着血的火，投在地上。地的三分之一烧掉了，树的三分之一烧掉了，所有的青草也烧掉了。
verses.textZhCuv: 第一位天使吹号，就有雹子与火搀着血丢在地上；地的三分之一和树的三分之一被烧了，一切的青草也被烧了。
verses.textEnNiv: The first angel sounded his trumpet, and there came hail and fire mixed with blood, and it was hurled down on the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, a third of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.
verses.textEnEsv: The first angel blew his trumpet, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and these were thrown upon the earth. And a third of the earth was burned up, and a third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.
verses.textEnNkjv: The first angel sounded: And hail and fire followed, mingled with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. And a third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.
verses.textEnNlt: The first angel blew his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. One-third of the earth was set on fire, one-third of the trees were burned, and all the green grass was burned.
verses.textEnNasb: The first sounded, and there was hail and fire mixed with blood, and it was hurled to the earth; and a third of the earth was burned up, and a third of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.
verses.textEn: The first angel sounded his trumpet, and there came hail and fire mixed with blood, and it was hurled down on the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, a third of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.

verses.textZh: 第二位天使吹号，就有一座好象燃烧着的大山，投在海里。海的三分之一变成了血，
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二位天使吹号，就有一座好象燃烧着的大山，投在海里。海的三分之一变成了血，
verses.textZhCuv: 第二位天使吹号，就有仿佛火烧着的大山扔在海中；海的三分之一变成血，
verses.textEnNiv: The second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a huge mountain, all ablaze, was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned into blood,
