verses.textEnEsv: The second angel blew his trumpet, and something like a great mountain, burning with fire, was thrown into the sea, and a third of the sea became blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the second angel sounded: And something like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea, and a third of the sea became blood.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the second angel blew his trumpet, and a great mountain of fire was thrown into the sea. One-third of the water in the sea became blood,
verses.textEnNasb: The second angel sounded, and something like a great mountain burning with fire was hurled into the sea; and a third of the sea became blood,
verses.textEn: The second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a huge mountain, all ablaze, was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned into blood,

verses.textZh: 海里受造的活物死了三分之一，船只也毁坏了三分之一。
verses.textZhCnvs: 海里受造的活物死了三分之一，船只也毁坏了三分之一。
verses.textZhCuv: 海中的活物死了三分之一，船只也坏了三分之一。
verses.textEnNiv: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: A third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: one-third of all things living in the sea died, and one-third of all the ships on the sea were destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: and a third of the creatures which were in the sea and had life, died; and a third of the ships were destroyed.
verses.textEn: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.

verses.textZh: 第三位天使吹号，就有一颗燃烧着的大星，好象火把一样，从天上落下来，落在江河的三分之一上，和众水的泉源上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三位天使吹号，就有一颗燃烧着的大星，好象火把一样，从天上落下来，落在江河的三分之一上，和众水的泉源上。
verses.textZhCuv: 第三位天使吹号，就有烧着的大星，好像火把从天上落下来，落在江河的三分之一和众水的泉源上。
verses.textEnNiv: The third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star, blazing like a torch, fell from the sky on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water—
verses.textEnEsv: The third angel blew his trumpet, and a great star fell from heaven, blazing like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the third angel sounded: And a great star fell from heaven, burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the third angel blew his trumpet, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch. It fell on one-third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
verses.textEnNasb: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from heaven, burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of waters.
verses.textEn: The third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star, blazing like a torch, fell from the sky on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water—

verses.textZh: 这星名叫"苦堇"。众水的三分之一变为"苦堇"，因水变苦，就有许多人因为这水而死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这星名叫"苦堇"。众水的三分之一变为"苦堇"，因水变苦，就有许多人因为这水而死了。
verses.textZhCuv: （这星名叫「茵陈」。）众水的三分之一变为茵陈，因水变苦，就死了许多人。
verses.textEnNiv: the name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters turned bitter, and many people died from the waters that had become bitter.
verses.textEnEsv: The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters became wormwood, and many people died from the water, because it had been made bitter.
verses.textEnNkjv: The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters became wormwood, and many men died from the water, because it was made bitter.
verses.textEnNlt: The name of the star was Bitterness. It made one-third of the water bitter, and many people died from drinking the bitter water.
verses.textEnNasb: The star is named Wormwood; and a third of the waters became wormwood, and many people died from the waters because they were made bitter.
verses.textEn: the name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters turned bitter, and many people died from the waters that had become bitter.

verses.textZh: 第四位天使吹号，太阳的三分之一、月亮的三分之一、星辰的三分之一，就都受到击打，以致日月星的三分之一都变黑了，白天的三分之一没有光，夜晚也是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第四位天使吹号，太阳的三分之一、月亮的三分之一、星辰的三分之一，就都受到击打，以致日月星的三分之一都变黑了，白天的三分之一没有光，夜晚也是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 第四位天使吹号，日头的三分之一、月亮的三分之一、星辰的三分之一都被击打，以致日月星的三分之一黑暗了，白昼的三分之一没有光，黑夜也是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: The fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them turned dark. A third of the day was without light, and also a third of the night.
verses.textEnEsv: The fourth angel blew his trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, and a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of their light might be darkened, and a third of the day might be kept from shining, and likewise a third of the night.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the fourth angel sounded: And a third of the sun was struck, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them were darkened. A third of the day did not shine, and likewise the night.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the fourth angel blew his trumpet, and one-third of the sun was struck, and one-third of the moon, and one-third of the stars, and they became dark. And one-third of the day was dark, and also one-third of the night.
verses.textEnNasb: The fourth angel sounded, and a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck, so that a third of them would be darkened and the day would not shine for a third of it, and the night in the same way.
verses.textEn: The fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them turned dark. A third of the day was without light, and also a third of the night.

verses.textZh: 我观看，就听见一只在高空飞翔的鹰，大声说："有祸了！有祸了！住在地上的人有祸了！因为还有三位天使将要吹其余的号。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看，就听见一只在高空飞翔的鹰，大声说："有祸了！有祸了！住在地上的人有祸了！因为还有三位天使将要吹其余的号。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见一个鹰飞在空中，并听见它大声说：「三位天使要吹那其余的号。你们住在地上的民，祸哉！祸哉！祸哉！」
verses.textEnNiv: As I watched, I heard an eagle that was flying in midair call out in a loud voice: "Woe! Woe! Woe to the inhabitants of the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the other three angels!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then I looked, and I heard an eagle crying with a loud voice as it flew directly overhead, "Woe, woe, woe to those who dwell on the earth, at the blasts of the other trumpets that the three angels are about to blow!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And I looked, and I heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, "Woe, woe, woe to the inhabitants of the earth, because of the remaining blasts of the trumpet of the three angels who are about to sound!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then I looked, and I heard a single eagle crying loudly as it flew through the air, "Terror, terror, terror to all who belong to this world because of what will happen when the last three angels blow their trumpets."
verses.textEnNasb: Then I looked, and I heard an eagle flying in midheaven, saying with a loud voice, "Woe, woe, woe to those who live on the earth, because of the remaining blasts of the trumpet of the three angels who are about to sound!"
verses.textEn: As I watched, I heard an eagle that was flying in midair call out in a loud voice: "Woe! Woe! Woe to the inhabitants of the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the other three angels!"

verses.textZh: 第五位天使吹号，我就看见一颗星从天上落到地上，有无底坑的钥匙赐给它。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第五位天使吹号，我就看见一颗星从天上落到地上，有无底坑的钥匙赐给它。
verses.textZhCuv: 第五位天使吹号，我就看见一个星从天落到地上，有无底坑的钥匙赐给它。
verses.textEnNiv: The fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from the sky to the earth. The star was given the key to the shaft of the Abyss.
verses.textEnEsv: And the fifth angel blew his trumpet, and I saw a star fallen from heaven to earth, and he was given the key to the shaft of the bottomless pit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the fifth angel sounded: And I saw a star fallen from heaven to the earth. To him was given the key to the bottomless pit.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the fifth angel blew his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen to earth from the sky, and he was given the key to the shaft of the bottomless pit.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from heaven which had fallen to the earth; and the key to the shaft of the abyss was given to him.
verses.textEn: The fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from the sky to the earth. The star was given the key to the shaft of the Abyss.

verses.textZh: 它开了无底坑，就有烟从坑里冒出来，好象大火炉的烟，太阳和天空因这坑的烟就都变黑了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它开了无底坑，就有烟从坑里冒出来，好象大火炉的烟，太阳和天空因这坑的烟就都变黑了。
verses.textZhCuv: 它开了无底坑，便有烟从坑里往上冒，好像大火炉的烟；日头和天空都因这烟昏暗了。
verses.textEnNiv: When he opened the Abyss, smoke rose from it like the smoke from a gigantic furnace. The sun and sky were darkened by the smoke from the Abyss.
verses.textEnEsv: He opened the shaft of the bottomless pit, and from the shaft rose smoke like the smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened with the smoke from the shaft.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he opened the bottomless pit, and smoke arose out of the pit like the smoke of a great furnace. So the sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke of the pit.
verses.textEnNlt: When he opened it, smoke poured out as though from a huge furnace, and the sunlight and air turned dark from the smoke.
verses.textEnNasb: He opened the shaft of the abyss, and smoke ascended out of the shaft like the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened from the smoke of the shaft.
verses.textEn: When he opened the Abyss, smoke rose from it like the smoke from a gigantic furnace. The sun and sky were darkened by the smoke from the Abyss.

verses.textZh: 有蝗虫从烟里出来到了地上；有能力赐给牠们，好象地上蝎子的能力一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有蝗虫从烟里出来到了地上；有能力赐给牠们，好象地上蝎子的能力一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 有蝗虫从烟中出来，飞到地上；有能力赐给它们，好像地上蝎子的能力一样，
verses.textEnNiv: And out of the smoke locusts came down on the earth and were given power like that of scorpions of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Then from the smoke came locusts on the earth, and they were given power like the power of scorpions of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then out of the smoke locusts came upon the earth. And to them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
verses.textEnNlt: Then locusts came from the smoke and descended on the earth, and they were given power to sting like scorpions.
verses.textEnNasb: Then out of the smoke came locusts upon the earth, and power was given them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
verses.textEn: And out of the smoke locusts came down on the earth and were given power like that of scorpions of the earth.

verses.textZh: 有话吩咐牠们，不可伤害地上的草，和所有青翠的东西，以及所有的树木，只可伤害那些额上没有神印记的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有话吩咐牠们，不可伤害地上的草，和所有青翠的东西，以及所有的树木，只可伤害那些额上没有神印记的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且吩咐它们说，不可伤害地上的草和各样青物，并一切树木，惟独要伤害额上没有神印记的人。
verses.textEnNiv: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those people who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
verses.textEnEsv: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any green plant or any tree, but only those people who do not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
verses.textEnNkjv: They were commanded not to harm the grass of the earth, or any green thing, or any tree, but only those men who do not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
verses.textEnNlt: They were told not to harm the grass or plants or trees, but only the people who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
verses.textEnNasb: They were told not to hurt the grass of the earth, nor any green thing, nor any tree, but only the people who do not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
verses.textEn: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those people who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.

verses.textZh: 蝗虫没有能力杀死他们，只可使他们受痛苦五个月。他们的痛苦就像人给蝎子螫了的痛苦一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 蝗虫没有能力杀死他们，只可使他们受痛苦五个月。他们的痛苦就像人给蝎子螫了的痛苦一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 但不许蝗虫害死他们，只叫他们受痛苦五个月。这痛苦就像蝎子螫人的痛苦一样。
verses.textEnNiv: They were not allowed to kill them but only to torture them for five months. And the agony they suffered was like that of the sting of a scorpion when it strikes.
verses.textEnEsv: They were allowed to torment them for five months, but not to kill them, and their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it stings someone.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were not given authority to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a man.
verses.textEnNlt: They were told not to kill them but to torture them for five months with pain like the pain of a scorpion sting.
verses.textEnNasb: And they were not permitted to kill anyone, but to torment for five months; and their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it stings a person.
verses.textEn: They were not allowed to kill them but only to torture them for five months. And the agony they suffered was like that of the sting of a scorpion when it strikes.

verses.textZh: 在那些日子，人要求死，却决不得死；切愿要死，死却远离他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些日子，人要求死，却决不得死；切愿要死，死却远离他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那些日子，人要求死，决不得死；愿意死，死却远避他们。
verses.textEnNiv: During those days people will seek death but will not find it; they will long to die, but death will elude them.
verses.textEnEsv: And in those days people will seek death and will not find it. They will long to die, but death will flee from them.
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days men will seek death and will not find it; they will desire to die, and death will flee from them.
verses.textEnNlt: In those days people will seek death but will not find it. They will long to die, but death will flee from them!
verses.textEnNasb: And in those days people will seek death and will not find it; they will long to die, and death will flee from them!
verses.textEn: During those days people will seek death but will not find it; they will long to die, but death will elude them.

verses.textZh: 蝗虫的形象，好象是预备好了要上阵的战马一样。牠们头上戴的好象金冠冕，脸像人的面孔，
verses.textZhCnvs: 蝗虫的形象，好象是预备好了要上阵的战马一样。牠们头上戴的好象金冠冕，脸像人的面孔，
verses.textZhCuv: 蝗虫的形状，好像预备出战的马一样，头上戴的好像金冠冕，脸面好像男人的脸面，
verses.textEnNiv: The locusts looked like horses prepared for battle. On their heads they wore something like crowns of gold, and their faces resembled human faces.
verses.textEnEsv: In appearance the locusts were like horses prepared for battle: on their heads were what looked like crowns of gold; their faces were like human faces,
verses.textEnNkjv: The shape of the locusts was like horses prepared for battle. On their heads were crowns of something like gold, and their faces were like the faces of men.
verses.textEnNlt: The locusts looked like horses prepared for battle. They had what looked like gold crowns on their heads, and their faces looked like human faces.
verses.textEnNasb: The appearance of the locusts was like horses prepared for battle; and on their heads appeared to be crowns like gold, and their faces were like human faces.
verses.textEn: The locusts looked like horses prepared for battle. On their heads they wore something like crowns of gold, and their faces resembled human faces.

verses.textZh: 牠们的头发好象女人的头发，牙齿好象狮子的牙齿；
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们的头发好象女人的头发，牙齿好象狮子的牙齿；
verses.textZhCuv: 头发像女人的头发，牙齿像狮子的牙齿。
verses.textEnNiv: Their hair was like women’s hair, and their teeth were like lions’ teeth.
verses.textEnEsv: their hair like women’s hair, and their teeth like lions’ teeth;
verses.textEnNkjv: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like lions’ teeth.
verses.textEnNlt: They had hair like women’s hair and teeth like the teeth of a lion.
verses.textEnNasb: They had hair like the hair of women, and their teeth were like the teeth of lions.
verses.textEn: Their hair was like women’s hair, and their teeth were like lions’ teeth.

verses.textZh: 牠们的胸甲像铁甲，牠们翅膀的声音好象许多马车奔驰上阵的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们的胸甲像铁甲，牠们翅膀的声音好象许多马车奔驰上阵的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 胸前有甲，好像铁甲。它们翅膀的声音，好像许多车马奔跑上阵的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the thundering of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.
verses.textEnEsv: they had breastplates like breastplates of iron, and the noise of their wings was like the noise of many chariots with horses rushing into battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they had breastplates like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots with many horses running into battle.
verses.textEnNlt: They wore armor made of iron, and their wings roared like an army of chariots rushing into battle.
verses.textEnNasb: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots, of many horses rushing to battle.
verses.textEn: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the thundering of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.

verses.textZh: 牠们好象蝎子一样有尾巴和毒刺，牠们的尾巴能伤害人五个月。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们好象蝎子一样有尾巴和毒刺，牠们的尾巴能伤害人五个月。
verses.textZhCuv: 有尾巴像蝎子，尾巴上的毒钩能伤人五个月。
verses.textEnNiv: They had tails with stingers, like scorpions, and in their tails they had power to torment people for five months.
verses.textEnEsv: They have tails and stings like scorpions, and their power to hurt people for five months is in their tails.
verses.textEnNkjv: They had tails like scorpions, and there were stings in their tails. Their power was to hurt men five months.
verses.textEnNlt: They had tails that stung like scorpions, and for five months they had the power to torment people.
verses.textEnNasb: They have tails like scorpions, and stings; and in their tails is their power to hurt people for five months.
verses.textEn: They had tails with stingers, like scorpions, and in their tails they had power to torment people for five months.

verses.textZh: 牠们有无底坑的使者作王统治牠们。这王的名字，希伯来话叫阿巴顿，希腊话叫阿波伦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们有无底坑的使者作王统治牠们。这王的名字，希伯来话叫阿巴顿，希腊话叫阿波伦。
verses.textZhCuv: 有无底坑的使者作它们的王，按着希伯来话，名叫亚巴顿，希腊话，名叫亚玻伦。
verses.textEnNiv: They had as king over them the angel of the Abyss, whose name in Hebrew is Abaddon and in Greek is Apollyon (that is, Destroyer).
verses.textEnEsv: They have as king over them the angel of the bottomless pit. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek he is called Apollyon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they had as king over them the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in Hebrew is Abaddon, but in Greek he has the name Apollyon.
verses.textEnNlt: Their king is the angel from the bottomless pit; his name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek, Apollyon—the Destroyer.
verses.textEnNasb: They have as king over them, the angel of the abyss; his name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in the Greek he has the name Apollyon.
verses.textEn: They had as king over them the angel of the Abyss, whose name in Hebrew is Abaddon and in Greek is Apollyon (that is, Destroyer).

verses.textZh: 第一样灾祸过去了。看哪，以后还有两样灾祸要来！
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一样灾祸过去了。看哪，以后还有两样灾祸要来！
verses.textZhCuv: 第一样灾祸过去了，还有两样灾祸要来。
verses.textEnNiv: The first woe is past; two other woes are yet to come.
verses.textEnEsv: The first woe has passed; behold, two woes are still to come.
verses.textEnNkjv: One woe is past. Behold, still two more woes are coming after these things.
verses.textEnNlt: The first terror is past, but look, two more terrors are coming!
verses.textEnNasb: The first woe has passed; behold, two woes are still coming after these things.
verses.textEn: The first woe is past; two other woes are yet to come.

verses.textZh: 第六位天使吹号，我听见有一个声音从神面前金坛的四角发出来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 第六位天使吹号，我听见有一个声音从神面前金坛的四角发出来，
verses.textZhCuv: 第六位天使吹号，我就听见有声音从神面前金坛的四角出来，
verses.textEnNiv: The sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice coming from the four horns of the golden altar that is before God.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar before God,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the sixth angel sounded: And I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet, and I heard a voice speaking from the four horns of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,
verses.textEn: The sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice coming from the four horns of the golden altar that is before God.

verses.textZh: 对拿着号筒的第六位天使说："把捆绑在幼发拉底大河的那四个使者放了吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 对拿着号筒的第六位天使说："把捆绑在幼发拉底大河的那四个使者放了吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 吩咐那吹号的第六位天使，说：「把那捆绑在幼发拉底大河的四个使者释放了。」
verses.textEnNiv: It said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, "Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates."
verses.textEnEsv: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, "Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, "Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates."
verses.textEnNlt: And the voice said to the sixth angel who held the trumpet, "Release the four angels who are bound at the great Euphrates River."
verses.textEnNasb: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, "Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates."
verses.textEn: It said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, "Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates."

verses.textZh: 那四个使者就被释放了，他们已经预备好，要在某年某月某日某时杀害人类的三分之一。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那四个使者就被释放了，他们已经预备好，要在某年某月某日某时杀害人类的三分之一。
verses.textZhCuv: 那四个使者就被释放；他们原是预备好了，到某年某月某日某时，要杀人的三分之一。
verses.textEnNiv: And the four angels who had been kept ready for this very hour and day and month and year were released to kill a third of mankind.
verses.textEnEsv: So the four angels, who had been prepared for the hour, the day, the month, and the year, were released to kill a third of mankind.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the four angels, who had been prepared for the hour and day and month and year, were released to kill a third of mankind.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the four angels who had been prepared for this hour and day and month and year were turned loose to kill one-third of all the people on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: And the four angels, who had been prepared for the hour and day and month and year, were released, so that they would kill a third of mankind.
verses.textEn: And the four angels who had been kept ready for this very hour and day and month and year were released to kill a third of mankind.

verses.textZh: 马兵的数目有二万万；他们这个数目我听见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 马兵的数目有二万万；他们这个数目我听见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 马军有二万万；他们的数目我听见了。
verses.textEnNiv: The number of the mounted troops was twice ten thousand times ten thousand. I heard their number.
verses.textEnEsv: The number of mounted troops was twice ten thousand times ten thousand; I heard their number.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the number of the army of the horsemen was two hundred million; I heard the number of them.
verses.textEnNlt: I heard the size of their army, which was 200 million mounted troops.
verses.textEnNasb: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million; I heard the number of them.
verses.textEn: The number of the mounted troops was twice ten thousand times ten thousand. I heard their number.

verses.textZh: 在异象中，我看见那些马和骑马的是这样：骑马的穿著火红紫青和硫磺色的胸甲，马的头好象狮子头，有火、烟和硫磺从马的口中喷出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在异象中，我看见那些马和骑马的是这样：骑马的穿著火红紫青和硫磺色的胸甲，马的头好象狮子头，有火、烟和硫磺从马的口中喷出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在异象中看见那些马和骑马的，骑马的胸前有甲如火，与紫玛瑙并硫磺。马的头好像狮子头，有火、有烟、有硫磺从马的口中出来。
verses.textEnNiv: The horses and riders I saw in my vision looked like this: Their breastplates were fiery red, dark blue, and yellow as sulfur. The heads of the horses resembled the heads of lions, and out of their mouths came fire, smoke and sulfur.
verses.textEnEsv: And this is how I saw the horses in my vision and those who rode them: they wore breastplates the color of fire and of sapphire and of sulfur, and the heads of the horses were like lions’ heads, and fire and smoke and sulfur came out of their mouths.
verses.textEnNkjv: And thus I saw the horses in the vision: those who sat on them had breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the heads of the horses were like the heads of lions; and out of their mouths came fire, smoke, and brimstone.
verses.textEnNlt: And in my vision, I saw the horses and the riders sitting on them. The riders wore armor that was fiery red and dark blue and yellow. The horses had heads like lions, and fire and smoke and burning sulfur billowed from their mouths.
verses.textEnNasb: And this is how I saw in my vision the horses and those who sat on them: the riders had breastplates the color of fire, of hyacinth, and of brimstone; and the heads of the horses are like the heads of lions; and out of their mouths *came fire and smoke and brimstone.
verses.textEn: The horses and riders I saw in my vision looked like this: Their breastplates were fiery red, dark blue, and yellow as sulfur. The heads of the horses resembled the heads of lions, and out of their mouths came fire, smoke and sulfur.

verses.textZh: 马口中喷出来的火、烟和硫磺这三种灾害，杀死了人类的三分之一。
verses.textZhCnvs: 马口中喷出来的火、烟和硫磺这三种灾害，杀死了人类的三分之一。
verses.textZhCuv: 口中所出来的火与烟并硫磺，这三样灾杀了人的三分之一。
verses.textEnNiv: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke and sulfur that came out of their mouths.
verses.textEnEsv: By these three plagues a third of mankind was killed, by the fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths.
verses.textEnNkjv: By these three plagues a third of mankind was killed—by the fire and the smoke and the brimstone which came out of their mouths.
verses.textEnNlt: One-third of all the people on earth were killed by these three plagues—by the fire and smoke and burning sulfur that came from the mouths of the horses.
verses.textEnNasb: A third of mankind was killed by these three plagues, by the fire, the smoke, and the brimstone which came out of their mouths.
verses.textEn: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke and sulfur that came out of their mouths.

verses.textZh: 马的能力是在口中和尾巴上。牠们的尾巴像蛇，并且有头用来伤人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 马的能力是在口中和尾巴上。牠们的尾巴像蛇，并且有头用来伤人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这马的能力是在口里和尾巴上；因这尾巴像蛇，并且有头用以害人。
verses.textEnNiv: The power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails; for their tails were like snakes, having heads with which they inflict injury.
verses.textEnEsv: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails, for their tails are like serpents with heads, and by means of them they wound.
verses.textEnNkjv: For their power is in their mouth and in their tails; for their tails are like serpents, having heads; and with them they do harm.
verses.textEnNlt: Their power was in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails had heads like snakes, with the power to injure people.
verses.textEnNasb: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails; for their tails are like serpents and have heads, and with them they do harm.
verses.textEn: The power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails; for their tails were like snakes, having heads with which they inflict injury.

verses.textZh: 其余没有在这些灾难中被杀的人，仍然不为他们手所作的悔改，还是去拜鬼魔和那些金、银、铜、石头、木头做的，不能看、不能听、也不能走路的偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其余没有在这些灾难中被杀的人，仍然不为他们手所作的悔改，还是去拜鬼魔和那些金、银、铜、石头、木头做的，不能看、不能听、也不能走路的偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 其余未曾被这些灾所杀的人仍旧不悔改自己手所做的，还是去拜鬼魔和那些不能看、不能听、不能走，金、银、铜、木、石的偶像，
verses.textEnNiv: The rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the work of their hands; they did not stop worshiping demons, and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone and wood—idols that cannot see or hear or walk.
verses.textEnEsv: The rest of mankind, who were not killed by these plagues, did not repent of the works of their hands nor give up worshiping demons and idols of gold and silver and bronze and stone and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk,
verses.textEnNkjv: But the rest of mankind, who were not killed by these plagues, did not repent of the works of their hands, that they should not worship demons, and idols of gold, silver, brass, stone, and wood, which can neither see nor hear nor walk.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people who did not die in these plagues still refused to repent of their evil deeds and turn to God. They continued to worship demons and idols made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood—idols that can neither see nor hear nor walk!
verses.textEnNasb: The rest of mankind, who were not killed by these plagues, did not repent of the works of their hands so as not to worship demons and the idols of gold, silver, brass, stone, and wood, which can neither see nor hear nor walk;
verses.textEn: The rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the work of their hands; they did not stop worshiping demons, and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone and wood—idols that cannot see or hear or walk.

verses.textZh: 他们也不为自己的凶杀、邪术、淫乱和偷盗悔改。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们也不为自己的凶杀、邪术、淫乱和偷盗悔改。
verses.textZhCuv: 又不悔改他们那些凶杀、邪术、奸淫、偷窃的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Nor did they repent of their murders, their magic arts, their sexual immorality or their thefts.
verses.textEnEsv: nor did they repent of their murders or their sorceries or their sexual immorality or their thefts.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they did not repent of their murders or their sorceries or their sexual immorality or their thefts.
verses.textEnNlt: And they did not repent of their murders or their witchcraft or their sexual immorality or their thefts.
verses.textEnNasb: and they did not repent of their murders, nor of their witchcraft, nor of their sexual immorality, nor of their thefts.
verses.textEn: Nor did they repent of their murders, their magic arts, their sexual immorality or their thefts.

verses.textZh: 我又看见一位大力的天使从天上降下来，身披云彩，头上有彩虹，脸像太阳，两脚像火柱一样，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见一位大力的天使从天上降下来，身披云彩，头上有彩虹，脸像太阳，两脚像火柱一样，
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见另有一位大力的天使从天降下，披着云彩，头上有虹，脸面像日头，两脚像火柱。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven. He was robed in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head; his face was like the sun, and his legs were like fiery pillars.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow over his head, and his face was like the sun, and his legs like pillars of fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: I saw still another mighty angel coming down from heaven, clothed with a cloud. And a rainbow was on his head, his face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, surrounded by a cloud, with a rainbow over his head. His face shone like the sun, and his feet were like pillars of fire.
verses.textEnNasb: I saw another strong angel coming down from heaven, clothed with a cloud; and the rainbow was on his head, and his face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire;
verses.textEn: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven. He was robed in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head; his face was like the sun, and his legs were like fiery pillars.

verses.textZh: 手里拿着展开的小书卷。他的右脚踏在海上，左脚踏在地上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 手里拿着展开的小书卷。他的右脚踏在海上，左脚踏在地上，
verses.textZhCuv: 他手里拿着小书卷，是展开的。他右脚踏海，左脚踏地，
verses.textEnNiv: He was holding a little scroll, which lay open in his hand. He planted his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land,
verses.textEnEsv: He had a little scroll open in his hand. And he set his right foot on the sea, and his left foot on the land,
verses.textEnNkjv: He had a little book open in his hand. And he set his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land,
verses.textEnNlt: And in his hand was a small scroll that had been opened. He stood with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
verses.textEnNasb: and he had in his hand a little scroll, which was open. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left on the land;
verses.textEn: He was holding a little scroll, which lay open in his hand. He planted his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land,

verses.textZh: 大声呼喊，好象狮子吼叫。他呼喊的时候，就有七雷发声说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大声呼喊，好象狮子吼叫。他呼喊的时候，就有七雷发声说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 大声呼喊，好像狮子吼叫。呼喊完了，就有七雷发声。
verses.textEnNiv: and he gave a loud shout like the roar of a lion. When he shouted, the voices of the seven thunders spoke.
verses.textEnEsv: and called out with a loud voice, like a lion roaring. When he called out, the seven thunders sounded.
verses.textEnNkjv: and cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roars. When he cried out, seven thunders uttered their voices.
verses.textEnNlt: And he gave a great shout like the roar of a lion. And when he shouted, the seven thunders answered.
verses.textEnNasb: and he cried out with a loud voice, as when a lion roars; and when he had cried out, the seven peals of thunder uttered their voices.
verses.textEn: and he gave a loud shout like the roar of a lion. When he shouted, the voices of the seven thunders spoke.

verses.textZh: 七雷说话的时候，我正要写下来，就听见有声音从天上出来，说："七雷所说的你要封住，不可写出来！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 七雷说话的时候，我正要写下来，就听见有声音从天上出来，说："七雷所说的你要封住，不可写出来！"
verses.textZhCuv: 七雷发声之后，我正要写出来，就听见从天上有声音说：「七雷所说的，你要封上，不可写出来。」
verses.textEnNiv: And when the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from heaven say, "Seal up what the seven thunders have said and do not write it down."
verses.textEnEsv: And when the seven thunders had sounded, I was about to write, but I heard a voice from heaven saying, "Seal up what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the seven thunders uttered their voices, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from heaven saying to me, "Seal up the things which the seven thunders uttered, and do not write them."
verses.textEnNlt: When the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write. But I heard a voice from heaven saying, "Keep secret what the seven thunders said, and do not write it down."
verses.textEnNasb: When the seven peals of thunder had spoken, I was about to write; and I heard a voice from heaven, saying, "Seal up the things which the seven peals of thunder have spoken, and do not write them."
verses.textEn: And when the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from heaven say, "Seal up what the seven thunders have said and do not write it down."

verses.textZh: 我看见那站在海上和地上的天使，向天举起右手来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见那站在海上和地上的天使，向天举起右手来，
verses.textZhCuv: 我所看见的那踏海踏地的天使向天举起右手来，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven
verses.textEnNkjv: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land raised up his hand to heaven
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel I saw standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand toward heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven,
verses.textEn: Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven.

verses.textZh: 指着那活到永永远远，创造天和天上之物、地和地上之物、海和海中之物的神起誓，说："必不再延迟了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 指着那活到永永远远，创造天和天上之物、地和地上之物、海和海中之物的神起誓，说："必不再延迟了！
verses.textZhCuv: 指着那创造天和天上之物，地和地上之物，海和海中之物，直活到永永远远的，起誓说：「不再有时日了 。」
verses.textEnNiv: And he swore by him who lives for ever and ever, who created the heavens and all that is in them, the earth and all that is in it, and the sea and all that is in it, and said, "There will be no more delay!
verses.textEnEsv: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and what is in it, the earth and what is in it, and the sea and what is in it, that there would be no more delay,
verses.textEnNkjv: and swore by Him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there should be delay no longer,
verses.textEnNlt: He swore an oath in the name of the one who lives forever and ever, who created the heavens and everything in them, the earth and everything in it, and the sea and everything in it. He said, "There will be no more delay.
verses.textEnNasb: and swore by Him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things in it, and the earth and the things in it, and the sea and the things in it, that there will no longer be a delay,
verses.textEn: And he swore by him who lives for ever and ever, who created the heavens and all that is in them, the earth and all that is in it, and the sea and all that is in it, and said, "There will be no more delay!

verses.textZh: 到第七位天使吹号的时候，神向他的仆人众先知所宣告的奥秘，就要实现了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到第七位天使吹号的时候，神向他的仆人众先知所宣告的奥秘，就要实现了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但在第七位天使吹号发声的时候，神的奥秘就成全了，正如神所传给他仆人众先知的佳音。
verses.textEnNiv: But in the days when the seventh angel is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be accomplished, just as he announced to his servants the prophets."
verses.textEnEsv: but that in the days of the trumpet call to be sounded by the seventh angel, the mystery of God would be fulfilled, just as he announced to his servants the prophets.
verses.textEnNkjv: but in the days of the sounding of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, the mystery of God would be finished, as He declared to His servants the prophets.
verses.textEnNlt: When the seventh angel blows his trumpet, God’s mysterious plan will be fulfilled. It will happen just as he announced it to his servants the prophets."
verses.textEnNasb: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as He announced to His servants the prophets.
verses.textEn: But in the days when the seventh angel is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be accomplished, just as he announced to his servants the prophets."

verses.textZh: 我先前听见那从天上来的声音又对我说："你去，把那站在海上和地上的天使手中展开的书卷拿过来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我先前听见那从天上来的声音又对我说："你去，把那站在海上和地上的天使手中展开的书卷拿过来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我先前从天上所听见的那声音又吩咐我说：「你去，把那踏海踏地之天使手中展开的小书卷取过来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me once more: "Go, take the scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me again, saying, "Go, take the scroll that is open in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the voice which I heard from heaven spoke to me again and said, "Go, take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the voice from heaven spoke to me again: "Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the voice which I heard from heaven, I heard again speaking with me, and saying, "Go, take the scroll which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land."
verses.textEn: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me once more: "Go, take the scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land."

verses.textZh: 我就走到天使那里，请他把小书卷给我。他对我说："你拿着，吃下去。它必使你肚子苦涩，但是口里却好象蜜一样甘甜。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就走到天使那里，请他把小书卷给我。他对我说："你拿着，吃下去。它必使你肚子苦涩，但是口里却好象蜜一样甘甜。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我就走到天使那里，对他说：「请你把小书卷给我。」他对我说：「你拿着吃尽了，便叫你肚子发苦，然而在你口中要甜如蜜。」
verses.textEnNiv: So I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little scroll. He said to me, "Take it and eat it. It will turn your stomach sour, but ‘in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: So I went to the angel and told him to give me the little scroll. And he said to me, "Take and eat it; it will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey."
verses.textEnNkjv: So I went to the angel and said to him, "Give me the little book." And he said to me, "Take and eat it; and it will make your stomach bitter, but it will be as sweet as honey in your mouth."
verses.textEnNlt: So I went to the angel and told him to give me the small scroll. "Yes, take it and eat it," he said. "It will be sweet as honey in your mouth, but it will turn sour in your stomach!"
verses.textEnNasb: And I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little scroll. And he *said to me, "Take it and eat it; it will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey."
verses.textEn: So I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little scroll. He said to me, "Take it and eat it. It will turn your stomach sour, but ‘in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.’ "

verses.textZh: 我把小书卷从天使手中拿过来，吃了，在口里果然甘甜如蜜；但是吃完之后，我肚子就觉得苦涩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把小书卷从天使手中拿过来，吃了，在口里果然甘甜如蜜；但是吃完之后，我肚子就觉得苦涩。
verses.textZhCuv: 我从天使手中把小书卷接过来，吃尽了，在我口中果然甜如蜜，吃了以后，肚子觉得发苦了。
verses.textEnNiv: I took the little scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it. It tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it, my stomach turned sour.
verses.textEnEsv: And I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. It was sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it my stomach was made bitter.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I took the little book out of the angel’s hand and ate it, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth. But when I had eaten it, my stomach became bitter.
verses.textEnNlt: So I took the small scroll from the hand of the angel, and I ate it! It was sweet in my mouth, but when I swallowed it, it turned sour in my stomach.
verses.textEnNasb: I took the little scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it, and in my mouth it was sweet as honey; and when I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.
verses.textEn: I took the little scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it. It tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it, my stomach turned sour.

verses.textZh: 他们又对我说："论到许多民族、邦国、方言和君王，你必须再说预言。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又对我说："论到许多民族、邦国、方言和君王，你必须再说预言。"
verses.textZhCuv: 天使 对我说：「你必指着多民、多国、多方、多王再说预言。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I was told, "You must prophesy again about many peoples, nations, languages and kings."
verses.textEnEsv: And I was told, "You must again prophesy about many peoples and nations and languages and kings."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to me, "You must prophesy again about many peoples, nations, tongues, and kings."
verses.textEnNlt: Then I was told, "You must prophesy again about many peoples, nations, languages, and kings."
verses.textEnNasb: And they *said to me, "You must prophesy again concerning many peoples, nations, languages, and kings."
verses.textEn: Then I was told, "You must prophesy again about many peoples, nations, languages and kings."

verses.textZh: 有一根好象量尺的芦苇赐给了我，又有话说："你起来，把神的圣所和祭坛，以及在里面敬拜的人，都量一量、数一数。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一根好象量尺的芦苇赐给了我，又有话说："你起来，把神的圣所和祭坛，以及在里面敬拜的人，都量一量、数一数。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一根苇子赐给我，当作量度的杖；且有话说：「起来！将神的殿和祭坛，并在殿中礼拜的人都量一量。
verses.textEnNiv: I was given a reed like a measuring rod and was told, "Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, with its worshipers.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I was given a measuring rod like a staff, and I was told, "Rise and measure the temple of God and the altar and those who worship there,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I was given a reed like a measuring rod. And the angel stood, saying, "Rise and measure the temple of God, the altar, and those who worship there.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I was given a measuring stick, and I was told, "Go and measure the Temple of God and the altar, and count the number of worshipers.
verses.textEnNasb: Then there was given to me a measuring rod like a staff; and someone said, "Get up and measure the temple of God and the altar, and those who worship in it.
verses.textEn: I was given a reed like a measuring rod and was told, "Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, with its worshipers.

verses.textZh: 但圣所外面的院子，不要量它，因为它已经给了外族人，他们要践踏圣城四十二个月。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但圣所外面的院子，不要量它，因为它已经给了外族人，他们要践踏圣城四十二个月。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是殿外的院子要留下不用量，因为这是给了外邦人的；他们要践踏圣城四十二个月。
verses.textEnNiv: But exclude the outer court; do not measure it, because it has been given to the Gentiles. They will trample on the holy city for 42 months.
verses.textEnEsv: but do not measure the court outside the temple; leave that out, for it is given over to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for forty-two months.
verses.textEnNkjv: But leave out the court which is outside the temple, and do not measure it, for it has been given to the Gentiles. And they will tread the holy city underfoot for forty-two months.
verses.textEnNlt: But do not measure the outer courtyard, for it has been turned over to the nations. They will trample the holy city for 42 months.
verses.textEnNasb: Leave out the courtyard which is outside the temple and do not measure it, because it has been given to the nations; and they will trample the holy city for forty-two months.
verses.textEn: But exclude the outer court; do not measure it, because it has been given to the Gentiles. They will trample on the holy city for 42 months.

verses.textZh: 我要赐能力给我那两个穿著麻衣的见证人，他们要传道一千二百六十天。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要赐能力给我那两个穿著麻衣的见证人，他们要传道一千二百六十天。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使我那两个见证人，穿着毛衣，传道一千二百六十天。」
verses.textEnNiv: And I will appoint my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth."
verses.textEnEsv: And I will grant authority to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred and sixty days, clothed in sackcloth."
verses.textEnNlt: And I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will be clothed in burlap and will prophesy during those 1,260 days."
verses.textEnNasb: And I will grant authority to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth."
verses.textEn: And I will appoint my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth."

verses.textZh: 他们就是站在全地之主面前的两棵橄榄树和两个灯台。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就是站在全地之主面前的两棵橄榄树和两个灯台。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就是那两棵橄榄树，两个灯台，立在世界之主面前的。
verses.textEnNiv: They are "the two olive trees" and the two lampstands, and "they stand before the Lord of the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands standing before the God of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: These two prophets are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.
verses.textEn: They are "the two olive trees" and the two lampstands, and "they stand before the Lord of the earth."

verses.textZh: 如果有人想要伤害他们，就有火从他们口中出来，吞灭他们的仇敌。凡是想要伤害他们的，都必这样被杀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人想要伤害他们，就有火从他们口中出来，吞灭他们的仇敌。凡是想要伤害他们的，都必这样被杀。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人想要害他们，就有火从他们口中出来，烧灭仇敌。凡想要害他们的都必这样被杀。
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone tries to harm them, fire comes from their mouths and devours their enemies. This is how anyone who wants to harm them must die.
verses.textEnEsv: And if anyone would harm them, fire pours from their mouth and consumes their foes. If anyone would harm them, this is how he is doomed to be killed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if anyone wants to harm them, fire proceeds from their mouth and devours their enemies. And if anyone wants to harm them, he must be killed in this manner.
verses.textEnNlt: If anyone tries to harm them, fire flashes from their mouths and consumes their enemies. This is how anyone who tries to harm them must die.
verses.textEnNasb: And if anyone wants to harm them, fire flows out of their mouth and devours their enemies; and so if anyone wants to harm them, he must be killed in this way.
verses.textEn: If anyone tries to harm them, fire comes from their mouths and devours their enemies. This is how anyone who wants to harm them must die.

verses.textZh: 他们有权柄在他们传道的日子叫天闭塞不下雨，又有权柄掌管众水，使水变成血，并且有权柄可以随时随意用各样灾难击打全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们有权柄在他们传道的日子叫天闭塞不下雨，又有权柄掌管众水，使水变成血，并且有权柄可以随时随意用各样灾难击打全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 这二人有权柄，在他们传道的日子叫天闭塞不下雨；又有权柄叫水变为血，并且能随时随意用各样的灾殃攻击世界。
verses.textEnNiv: They have power to shut up the heavens so that it will not rain during the time they are prophesying; and they have power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they want.
verses.textEnEsv: They have the power to shut the sky, that no rain may fall during the days of their prophesying, and they have power over the waters to turn them into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague, as often as they desire.
verses.textEnNkjv: These have power to shut heaven, so that no rain falls in the days of their prophecy; and they have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to strike the earth with all plagues, as often as they desire.
verses.textEnNlt: They have power to shut the sky so that no rain will fall for as long as they prophesy. And they have the power to turn the rivers and oceans into blood, and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish.
verses.textEnNasb: These have the power to shut up the sky, so that rain will not fall during the days of their prophesying; and they have power over the waters to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.
verses.textEn: They have power to shut up the heavens so that it will not rain during the time they are prophesying; and they have power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they want.

verses.textZh: 他们作完了见证的时候，那从无底坑上来的兽要跟他们作战，胜过他们，把他们杀死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们作完了见证的时候，那从无底坑上来的兽要跟他们作战，胜过他们，把他们杀死。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们作完见证的时候，那从无底坑里上来的兽必与他们交战，并且得胜，把他们杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now when they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up from the Abyss will attack them, and overpower and kill them.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they have finished their testimony, the beast that rises from the bottomless pit will make war on them and conquer them and kill them,
verses.textEnNkjv: When they finish their testimony, the beast that ascends out of the bottomless pit will make war against them, overcome them, and kill them.
verses.textEnNlt: When they complete their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the bottomless pit will declare war against them, and he will conquer them and kill them.
verses.textEnNasb: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them and kill them.
verses.textEn: Now when they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up from the Abyss will attack them, and overpower and kill them.

verses.textZh: 他们的尸首要倒在大城的街道上。这城按着寓意叫所多玛，又叫埃及，就是他们的主被钉十字架的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的尸首要倒在大城的街道上。这城按着寓意叫所多玛，又叫埃及，就是他们的主被钉十字架的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的尸首就倒在大城里的街上；这城按着灵意叫所多玛，又叫埃及，就是他们的主钉十字架之处。
verses.textEnNiv: Their bodies will lie in the public square of the great city—which is figuratively called Sodom and Egypt—where also their Lord was crucified.
verses.textEnEsv: and their dead bodies will lie in the street of the great city that symbolically is called Sodom and Egypt, where their Lord was crucified.
verses.textEnNkjv: And their dead bodies willlie in the street of the great city which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
verses.textEnNlt: And their bodies will lie in the main street of Jerusalem, the city that is figuratively called "Sodom" and "Egypt," the city where their Lord was crucified.
verses.textEnNasb: And their dead bodies will lie on the street of the great city which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.
verses.textEn: Their bodies will lie in the public square of the great city—which is figuratively called Sodom and Egypt—where also their Lord was crucified.

verses.textZh: 从各民族、各支派、各方言和各邦国中，都有人观看他们的尸首三天半，又不许人把尸首安放在坟墓里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从各民族、各支派、各方言和各邦国中，都有人观看他们的尸首三天半，又不许人把尸首安放在坟墓里。
verses.textZhCuv: 从各民、各族、各方、各国中，有人观看他们的尸首三天半，又不许把尸首放在坟墓里。
verses.textEnNiv: For three and a half days some from every people, tribe, language and nation will gaze on their bodies and refuse them burial.
verses.textEnEsv: For three and a half days some from the peoples and tribes and languages and nations will gaze at their dead bodies and refuse to let them be placed in a tomb,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then those from the peoples, tribes, tongues, and nations will see their dead bodies three-and-a-half days, and not allow their dead bodies to be put into graves.
verses.textEnNlt: And for three and a half days, all peoples, tribes, languages, and nations will stare at their bodies. No one will be allowed to bury them.
verses.textEnNasb: Those from the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.
verses.textEn: For three and a half days some from every people, tribe, language and nation will gaze on their bodies and refuse them burial.

verses.textZh: 住在地上的人为了他们的缘故，就欢喜快乐，彼此送礼，因为这两位先知曾经使他们受痛苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在地上的人为了他们的缘故，就欢喜快乐，彼此送礼，因为这两位先知曾经使他们受痛苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 住在地上的人就为他们欢喜快乐，互相馈送礼物，因这两位先知曾叫住在地上的人受痛苦。
verses.textEnNiv: The inhabitants of the earth will gloat over them and will celebrate by sending each other gifts, because these two prophets had tormented those who live on the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: and those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them and make merry and exchange presents, because these two prophets had been a torment to those who dwell on the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, make merry, and send gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: All the people who belong to this world will gloat over them and give presents to each other to celebrate the death of the two prophets who had tormented them.
verses.textEnNasb: And those who live on the earth will rejoice over them and celebrate; and they will send gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who live on the earth.
verses.textEn: The inhabitants of the earth will gloat over them and will celebrate by sending each other gifts, because these two prophets had tormented those who live on the earth.

verses.textZh: 过了三天半，有生命的气息从神那里来，进入他们里面，他们就站立起来，看见他们的人都非常惧怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了三天半，有生命的气息从神那里来，进入他们里面，他们就站立起来，看见他们的人都非常惧怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了这三天半，有生气从神那里进入他们里面，他们就站起来；看见他们的人甚是害怕。
verses.textEnNiv: But after the three and a half days the breath of life from God entered them, and they stood on their feet, and terror struck those who saw them.
verses.textEnEsv: But after the three and a half days a breath of life from God entered them, and they stood up on their feet, and great fear fell on those who saw them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now after the three-and-a-half days the breath of life from God entered them, and they stood on their feet, and great fear fell on those who saw them.
verses.textEnNlt: But after three and a half days, God breathed life into them, and they stood up! Terror struck all who were staring at them.
verses.textEnNasb: And after the three and a half days, the breath of life from God came into them, and they stood on their feet; and great fear fell upon those who were watching them.
verses.textEn: But after the three and a half days the breath of life from God entered them, and they stood on their feet, and terror struck those who saw them.

verses.textZh: 他们听见从天上来的大声音，对他们说："上这里来！"他们就驾着云上了天，他们的仇敌也看见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们听见从天上来的大声音，对他们说："上这里来！"他们就驾着云上了天，他们的仇敌也看见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 两位先知听见有大声音从天上来，对他们说：「上到这里来。」他们就驾着云上了天，他们的仇敌也看见了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, "Come up here." And they went up to heaven in a cloud, while their enemies looked on.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, "Come up here!" And they went up to heaven in a cloud, and their enemies watched them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, "Come up here." And they ascended to heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then a loud voice from heaven called to the two prophets, "Come up here!" And they rose to heaven in a cloud as their enemies watched.
verses.textEnNasb: And they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, "Come up here." And they went up into heaven in the cloud, and their enemies watched them.
verses.textEn: Then they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, "Come up here." And they went up to heaven in a cloud, while their enemies looked on.

verses.textZh: 就在那时，大地震发生了，那座城倒塌了十分之一，因着地震而死的有七千人，其余的人都很害怕，就把荣耀归给天上的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在那时，大地震发生了，那座城倒塌了十分之一，因着地震而死的有七千人，其余的人都很害怕，就把荣耀归给天上的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 正在那时候，地大震动，城就倒塌了十分之一，因地震而死的有七千人；其余的都恐惧，归荣耀给天上的神。
verses.textEnNiv: At that very hour there was a severe earthquake and a tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the survivors were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: And at that hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the same hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. In the earthquake seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were afraid and gave glory to the God of heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: At the same time there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people died in that earthquake, and everyone else was terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: And at that time there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell; seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
verses.textEn: At that very hour there was a severe earthquake and a tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the survivors were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

verses.textZh: 第二样灾祸过去了。看哪，第三样灾祸快要到了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二样灾祸过去了。看哪，第三样灾祸快要到了！
verses.textZhCuv: 第二样灾祸过去，第三样灾祸快到了。
verses.textEnNiv: The second woe has passed; the third woe is coming soon.
verses.textEnEsv: The second woe has passed; behold, the third woe is soon to come.
verses.textEnNkjv: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe is coming quickly.
verses.textEnNlt: The second terror is past, but look, the third terror is coming quickly.
verses.textEnNasb: The second woe has passed; behold, the third woe is coming quickly.
verses.textEn: The second woe has passed; the third woe is coming soon.

verses.textZh: 第七位天使吹号，天上就有大声音说： "世上的国成了我们的主 和他所立的基督的国， 他要作王，直到永永远远！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 第七位天使吹号，天上就有大声音说： "世上的国成了我们的主 和他所立的基督的国， 他要作王，直到永永远远！"
verses.textZhCuv: 第七位天使吹号，天上就有大声音说： 世上的国成了我主和主基督的国； 他要作王，直到永永远远。
verses.textEnNiv: The seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and there were loud voices in heaven, which said: "The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Messiah, and he will reign for ever and ever."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the seventh angel blew his trumpet, and there were loud voices in heaven, saying, "The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ, and he shall reign forever and ever."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the seventh angel sounded: And there were loud voices in heaven, saying, "The kingdoms of this world have become thekingdoms of our Lord and of His Christ, and He shall reign forever and ever!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the seventh angel blew his trumpet, and there were loud voices shouting in heaven: "The world has now become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ, and he will reign forever and ever."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the seventh angel sounded; and there were loud voices in heaven, saying, "The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ; and He will reign forever and ever."
verses.textEn: The seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and there were loud voices in heaven, which said: "The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Messiah, and he will reign for ever and ever."

verses.textZh: 那在神面前，坐在自己座位上的二十四位长老，都面伏在地上敬拜神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那在神面前，坐在自己座位上的二十四位长老，都面伏在地上敬拜神，
verses.textZhCuv: 在神面前，坐在自己位上的二十四位长老，就面伏于地，敬拜神，
verses.textEnNiv: And the twenty-four elders, who were seated on their thrones before God, fell on their faces and worshiped God,
verses.textEnEsv: And the twenty-four elders who sit on their thrones before God fell on their faces and worshiped God,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the twenty-four elders who sat before God on their thrones fell on their faces and worshiped God,
verses.textEnNlt: The twenty-four elders sitting on their thrones before God fell with their faces to the ground and worshiped him.
verses.textEnNasb: And the twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God, fell on their faces and worshiped God,
verses.textEn: And the twenty-four elders, who were seated on their thrones before God, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

verses.textZh: 说： "主啊！全能的神，昔在今在的， 我们感谢你！ 因为你执掌了大权， 作王了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 说： "主啊！全能的神，昔在今在的， 我们感谢你！ 因为你执掌了大权， 作王了！
verses.textZhCuv: 说： 昔在、今在的主神－ 全能者啊，我们感谢你！ 因你执掌大权作王了。
verses.textEnNiv: saying: "We give thanks to you, Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and have begun to reign.
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "We give thanks to you, Lord God Almighty, who is and who was, for you have taken your great power and begun to reign.
verses.textEnNkjv: saying: "We give You thanks, O Lord God Almighty, The One who is and who was and who is to come, Because You have taken Your great power and reigned.
verses.textEnNlt: And they said, "We give thanks to you, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who always was, for now you have assumed your great power and have begun to reign.
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "We give You thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the One who is and who was, because You have taken Your great power and have begun to reign.
verses.textEn: saying: "We give thanks to you, Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and have begun to reign.

verses.textZh: 列国忿怒了！ 你的震怒也临到了！ 时候已经到了！ 死人要受审判！ 你的众仆人、先知、圣徒， 和所有老幼贵贱、敬畏你名的人， 都要得赏赐！ 你也要毁灭那些败坏全地的人！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国忿怒了！ 你的震怒也临到了！ 时候已经到了！ 死人要受审判！ 你的众仆人、先知、圣徒， 和所有老幼贵贱、敬畏你名的人， 都要得赏赐！ 你也要毁灭那些败坏全地的人！"
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦发怒，你的忿怒也临到了； 审判死人的时候也到了。 你的仆人众先知和众圣徒， 凡敬畏你名的人， 连大带小得赏赐的时候也到了。 你败坏那些败坏世界之人的时候也就到了。
verses.textEnNiv: The nations were angry, and your wrath has come. The time has come for judging the dead, and for rewarding your servants the prophets and your people who revere your name, both great and small— and for destroying those who destroy the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: The nations raged, but your wrath came, and the time for the dead to be judged, and for rewarding your servants, the prophets and saints, and those who fear your name, both small and great, and for destroying the destroyers of the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: The nations were angry, and Your wrath has come, And the time of the dead, that they should be judged, And that You should reward Your servants the prophets and the saints, And those who fear Your name, small and great, And should destroy those who destroy the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: The nations were filled with wrath, but now the time of your wrath has come. It is time to judge the dead and reward your servants the prophets, as well as your holy people, and all who fear your name, from the least to the greatest. It is time to destroy all who have caused destruction on the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: And the nations were enraged, and Your wrath came, and the time came for the dead to be judged, and the time to reward Your bond-servants the prophets and the saints and those who fear Your name, the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth."
verses.textEn: The nations were angry, and your wrath has come. The time has come for judging the dead, and for rewarding your servants the prophets and your people who revere your name, both great and small— and for destroying those who destroy the earth."

verses.textZh: 于是，在天上神的圣所开了，他的约柜就在他的圣所中显现出来。随即有闪电、响声、雷轰、地震、大冰雹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，在天上神的圣所开了，他的约柜就在他的圣所中显现出来。随即有闪电、响声、雷轰、地震、大冰雹。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，神天上的殿开了，在他殿中现出他的约柜。随后有闪电、声音、雷轰、地震、大雹。
verses.textEnNiv: Then God’s temple in heaven was opened, and within his temple was seen the ark of his covenant. And there came flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, an earthquake and a severe hailstorm.
verses.textEnEsv: Then God’s temple in heaven was opened, and the ark of his covenant was seen within his temple. There were flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, an earthquake, and heavy hail.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the temple of God was opened in heaven, and the ark of His covenant was seen in His temple. And there were lightnings, noises, thunderings, an earthquake, and great hail.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, in heaven, the Temple of God was opened and the Ark of his covenant could be seen inside the Temple. Lightning flashed, thunder crashed and roared, and there was an earthquake and a terrible hailstorm.
verses.textEnNasb: And the temple of God which is in heaven was opened; and the ark of His covenant appeared in His temple, and there were flashes of lightning and sounds and peals of thunder, and an earthquake, and a great hailstorm.
verses.textEn: Then God’s temple in heaven was opened, and within his temple was seen the ark of his covenant. And there came flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, an earthquake and a severe hailstorm.

verses.textZh: 那时，天上出现了一个奇伟的景象：有一个妇人，身披太阳，脚踏月亮，头戴十二颗星的冠冕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，天上出现了一个奇伟的景象：有一个妇人，身披太阳，脚踏月亮，头戴十二颗星的冠冕。
verses.textZhCuv: 天上现出大异象来：有一个妇人身披日头，脚踏月亮，头戴十二星的冠冕。
verses.textEnNiv: A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
verses.textEnEsv: And a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet, and on her head a garland of twelve stars.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I witnessed in heaven an event of great significance. I saw a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon beneath her feet, and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
verses.textEnNasb: A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars;
verses.textEn: A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.

verses.textZh: 她怀了孕，在生产的痛苦中疼痛呼叫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她怀了孕，在生产的痛苦中疼痛呼叫。
verses.textZhCuv: 她怀了孕，在生产的艰难中疼痛呼叫。
verses.textEnNiv: She was pregnant and cried out in pain as she was about to give birth.
verses.textEnEsv: She was pregnant and was crying out in birth pains and the agony of giving birth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then being with child, she cried out in labor and in pain to give birth.
verses.textEnNlt: She was pregnant, and she cried out because of her labor pains and the agony of giving birth.
verses.textEnNasb: and she was pregnant and she *cried out, being in labor and in pain to give birth.
verses.textEn: She was pregnant and cried out in pain as she was about to give birth.

verses.textZh: 天上又出现了另一个景象。看哪！有一条大红龙，有七头十角，七头上戴着七个皇冠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天上又出现了另一个景象。看哪！有一条大红龙，有七头十角，七头上戴着七个皇冠。
verses.textZhCuv: 天上又现出异象来：有一条大红龙，七头十角；七头上戴着七个冠冕。
verses.textEnNiv: Then another sign appeared in heaven: an enormous red dragon with seven heads and ten horns and seven crowns on its heads.
verses.textEnEsv: And another sign appeared in heaven: behold, a great red dragon, with seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven diadems.
verses.textEnNkjv: And another sign appeared in heaven: behold, a great, fiery red dragon having seven heads and ten horns, and seven diadems on his heads.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I witnessed in heaven another significant event. I saw a large red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, with seven crowns on his heads.
verses.textEnNasb: Then another sign appeared in heaven: and behold, a great red dragon having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads were seven crowns.
verses.textEn: Then another sign appeared in heaven: an enormous red dragon with seven heads and ten horns and seven crowns on its heads.

verses.textZh: 牠的尾巴拖着天上三分之一的星辰，把它们摔在地上。龙站在那快要生产的妇人面前，等她生产了，就要吞吃她的孩子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠的尾巴拖着天上三分之一的星辰，把它们摔在地上。龙站在那快要生产的妇人面前，等她生产了，就要吞吃她的孩子。
verses.textZhCuv: 它的尾巴拖拉着天上星辰的三分之一，摔在地上。龙就站在那将要生产的妇人面前，等她生产之后，要吞吃她的孩子。
verses.textEnNiv: Its tail swept a third of the stars out of the sky and flung them to the earth. The dragon stood in front of the woman who was about to give birth, so that it might devour her child the moment he was born.
verses.textEnEsv: His tail swept down a third of the stars of heaven and cast them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she bore her child he might devour it.
verses.textEnNkjv: His tail drew a third of the stars of heaven and threw them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was ready to give birth, to devour her Child as soon as it was born.
verses.textEnNlt: His tail swept away one-third of the stars in the sky, and he threw them to the earth. He stood in front of the woman as she was about to give birth, ready to devour her baby as soon as it was born.
verses.textEnNasb: And his tail *swept away a third of the stars of heaven and hurled them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her Child.
verses.textEn: Its tail swept a third of the stars out of the sky and flung them to the earth. The dragon stood in front of the woman who was about to give birth, so that it might devour her child the moment he was born.

verses.textZh: 她生了一个男孩子，就是将来要用铁杖治理列国的。她的孩子被提取到神和他宝座那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她生了一个男孩子，就是将来要用铁杖治理列国的。她的孩子被提取到神和他宝座那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人生了一个男孩子，是将来要用铁杖辖管 万国的；她的孩子被提到神宝座那里去了。
verses.textEnNiv: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who "will rule all the nations with an iron scepter." And her child was snatched up to God and to his throne.
verses.textEnEsv: She gave birth to a male child, one who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron, but her child was caught up to God and to his throne,
verses.textEnNkjv: She bore a male Child who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron. And her Child was caught up to God and His throne.
verses.textEnNlt: She gave birth to a son who was to rule all nations with an iron rod. And her child was snatched away from the dragon and was caught up to God and to his throne.
verses.textEnNasb: And she gave birth to a Son, a male, who is going to rule all the nations with a rod of iron; and her Child was caught up to God and to His throne.
verses.textEn: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who "will rule all the nations with an iron scepter." And her child was snatched up to God and to his throne.

verses.textZh: 妇人就逃到旷野去了，那里有神为她预备的地方。她在那里得供养一千二百六十天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇人就逃到旷野去了，那里有神为她预备的地方。她在那里得供养一千二百六十天。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人就逃到旷野，在那里有神给她预备的地方，使她被养活一千二百六十天。
verses.textEnNiv: The woman fled into the wilderness to a place prepared for her by God, where she might be taken care of for 1,260 days.
verses.textEnEsv: and the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, in which she is to be nourished for 1,260 days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that they should feed her there one thousand two hundred and sixty days.
verses.textEnNlt: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where God had prepared a place to care for her for 1,260 days.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the woman fled into the wilderness where she *had a place prepared by God, so that there she would be nourished for 1,260 days.
verses.textEn: The woman fled into the wilderness to a place prepared for her by God, where she might be taken care of for 1,260 days.

verses.textZh: 天上发生了战争：米迦勒和他的天使与龙作战。龙和牠的天使也起来应战，
verses.textZhCnvs: 天上发生了战争：米迦勒和他的天使与龙作战。龙和牠的天使也起来应战，
verses.textZhCuv: 在天上就有了争战。米迦勒同他的使者与龙争战，龙也同它的使者去争战，
verses.textEnNiv: Then war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.
verses.textEnEsv: Now war arose in heaven, Michael and his angels fighting against the dragon. And the dragon and his angels fought back,
verses.textEnNkjv: And war broke out in heaven: Michael and his angels fought with the dragon; and the dragon and his angels fought,
verses.textEnNlt: Then there was war in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon and his angels.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was war in heaven, Michael and his angels waging war with the dragon. The dragon and his angels waged war,
verses.textEn: Then war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.

verses.textZh: 龙却抵挡不住，天上再也没有牠们的地方了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 龙却抵挡不住，天上再也没有牠们的地方了。
verses.textZhCuv: 并没有得胜，天上再没有它们的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: But he was not strong enough, and they lost their place in heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: but he was defeated, and there was no longer any place for them in heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: but they did not prevail, nor was a place found for them in heaven any longer.
verses.textEnNlt: And the dragon lost the battle, and he and his angels were forced out of heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: and they did not prevail, and there was no longer a place found for them in heaven.
verses.textEn: But he was not strong enough, and they lost their place in heaven.

verses.textZh: 于是那大龙被摔了下来。牠就是那古蛇，名叫魔鬼，又叫撒但，是迷惑普天下的人的。牠被摔在地上，牠的天使也跟牠一同被摔了下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是那大龙被摔了下来。牠就是那古蛇，名叫魔鬼，又叫撒但，是迷惑普天下的人的。牠被摔在地上，牠的天使也跟牠一同被摔了下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 大龙就是那古蛇，名叫魔鬼，又叫撒但，是迷惑普天下的。它被摔在地上，它的使者也一同被摔下去。
verses.textEnNiv: The great dragon was hurled down—that ancient serpent called the devil, or Satan, who leads the whole world astray. He was hurled to the earth, and his angels with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And the great dragon was thrown down, that ancient serpent, who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world— he was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the great dragon was cast out, that serpent of old, called the Devil and Satan, who deceives the whole world; he was cast to the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.
verses.textEnNlt: This great dragon—the ancient serpent called the devil, or Satan, the one deceiving the whole world—was thrown down to the earth with all his angels.
verses.textEnNasb: And the great dragon was thrown down, the serpent of old who is called the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole world; he was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.
verses.textEn: The great dragon was hurled down—that ancient serpent called the devil, or Satan, who leads the whole world astray. He was hurled to the earth, and his angels with him.

verses.textZh: 我又听见天上有大声音说： "我们神的救恩、能力、国度 和他所立的基督的权柄， 现在都已经来到了！ 因为那昼夜在我们神面前 控告我们弟兄的控告者， 已经被摔下来了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又听见天上有大声音说： "我们神的救恩、能力、国度 和他所立的基督的权柄， 现在都已经来到了！ 因为那昼夜在我们神面前 控告我们弟兄的控告者， 已经被摔下来了！
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见在天上有大声音说：「我神的救恩、能力、国度，并他基督的权柄，现在都来到了！因为那在我们神面前昼夜控告我们弟兄的，已经被摔下去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I heard a loud voice in heaven say: "Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Messiah. For the accuser of our brothers and sisters, who accuses them before our God day and night, has been hurled down.
verses.textEnEsv: And I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, "Now the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God and the authority of his Christ have come, for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them day and night before our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, "Now salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of His Christ have come, for the accuser of our brethren, who accused them before our God day and night, has been cast down.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I heard a loud voice shouting across the heavens, "It has come at last— salvation and power and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ. For the accuser of our brothers and sisters has been thrown down to earth— the one who accuses them before our God day and night.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, "Now the salvation, and the power, and the kingdom of our God and the authority of His Christ have come, for the accuser of our brothers and sisters has been thrown down, the one who accuses them before our God day and night.
verses.textEn: Then I heard a loud voice in heaven say: "Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Messiah. For the accuser of our brothers and sisters, who accuses them before our God day and night, has been hurled down.

verses.textZh: 弟兄胜过牠，是因着羊羔的血， 也因着自己所见证的道， 他们虽然至死， 也不爱惜自己的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄胜过牠，是因着羊羔的血， 也因着自己所见证的道， 他们虽然至死， 也不爱惜自己的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄胜过它，是因羔羊的血和自己所见证的道。他们虽至于死，也不爱惜性命。
verses.textEnNiv: They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony; they did not love their lives so much as to shrink from death.
verses.textEnEsv: And they have conquered him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony, for they loved not their lives even unto death.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony, and they did not love their lives to the death.
verses.textEnNlt: And they have defeated him by the blood of the Lamb and by their testimony. And they did not love their lives so much that they were afraid to die.
verses.textEnNasb: And they overcame him because of the blood of the Lamb and because of the word of their testimony, and they did not love their life even when faced with death.
verses.textEn: They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony; they did not love their lives so much as to shrink from death.

verses.textZh: 所以，众天和住在其中的， 你们都欢乐吧！ 可是地和海有祸了！ 因为魔鬼知道自己的时日无多， 就大大发怒下到你们那里去了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，众天和住在其中的， 你们都欢乐吧！ 可是地和海有祸了！ 因为魔鬼知道自己的时日无多， 就大大发怒下到你们那里去了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，诸天和住在其中的，你们都快乐吧！只是地与海有祸了！因为魔鬼知道自己的时候不多，就气忿忿地下到你们那里去了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore rejoice, you heavens and you who dwell in them! But woe to the earth and the sea, because the devil has gone down to you! He is filled with fury, because he knows that his time is short."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, rejoice, O heavens and you who dwell in them! But woe to you, O earth and sea, for the devil has come down to you in great wrath, because he knows that his time is short!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore rejoice, O heavens, and you who dwell in them! Woe to the inhabitants of the earth and the sea! For the devil has come down to you, having great wrath, because he knows that he has a short time."
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, rejoice, O heavens! And you who live in the heavens, rejoice! But terror will come on the earth and the sea, for the devil has come down to you in great anger, knowing that he has little time."
