verses.textEnNasb: For this reason, rejoice, you heavens and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and the sea, because the devil has come down to you with great wrath, knowing that he has only a short time."
verses.textEn: Therefore rejoice, you heavens and you who dwell in them! But woe to the earth and the sea, because the devil has gone down to you! He is filled with fury, because he knows that his time is short."

verses.textZh: 龙见自己被摔在地上，就迫害那生了男孩子的妇人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 龙见自己被摔在地上，就迫害那生了男孩子的妇人。
verses.textZhCuv: 龙见自己被摔在地上，就逼迫那生男孩子的妇人。
verses.textEnNiv: When the dragon saw that he had been hurled to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the dragon saw that he had been thrown down to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the dragon saw that he had been cast to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male Child.
verses.textEnNlt: When the dragon realized that he had been thrown down to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.
verses.textEnNasb: And when the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male Child.
verses.textEn: When the dragon saw that he had been hurled to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.

verses.textZh: 于是有大鹰的两个翅膀赐给了那妇人，使她可以飞到旷野，到自己的地方，在那里得供养一年两年半年，离开那蛇的面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是有大鹰的两个翅膀赐给了那妇人，使她可以飞到旷野，到自己的地方，在那里得供养一年两年半年，离开那蛇的面。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是有大鹰的两个翅膀赐给妇人，叫她能飞到旷野，到自己的地方，躲避那蛇；她在那里被养活一载二载半载。
verses.textEnNiv: The woman was given the two wings of a great eagle, so that she might fly to the place prepared for her in the wilderness, where she would be taken care of for a time, times and half a time, out of the serpent’s reach.
verses.textEnEsv: But the woman was given the two wings of the great eagle so that she might fly from the serpent into the wilderness, to the place where she is to be nourished for a time, and times, and half a time.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the woman was given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, where she is nourished for a time and times and half a time, from the presence of the serpent.
verses.textEnNlt: But she was given two wings like those of a great eagle so she could fly to the place prepared for her in the wilderness. There she would be cared for and protected from the dragon for a time, times, and half a time.
verses.textEnNasb: But the two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, so that she could fly into the wilderness to her place, where she *was nourished for a time, times, and half a time, away from the presence of the serpent.
verses.textEn: The woman was given the two wings of a great eagle, so that she might fly to the place prepared for her in the wilderness, where she would be taken care of for a time, times and half a time, out of the serpent’s reach.

verses.textZh: 蛇在妇人后面，从口中吐出水来，好象江河一样，要把妇人冲去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 蛇在妇人后面，从口中吐出水来，好象江河一样，要把妇人冲去。
verses.textZhCuv: 蛇就在妇人身后，从口中吐出水来，像河一样，要将妇人冲去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then from his mouth the serpent spewed water like a river, to overtake the woman and sweep her away with the torrent.
verses.textEnEsv: The serpent poured water like a river out of his mouth after the woman, to sweep her away with a flood.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the serpent spewed water out of his mouth like a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away by the flood.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the dragon tried to drown the woman with a flood of water that flowed from his mouth.
verses.textEnNasb: And the serpent hurled water like a river out of his mouth after the woman, so that he might cause her to be swept away with the flood.
verses.textEn: Then from his mouth the serpent spewed water like a river, to overtake the woman and sweep her away with the torrent.

verses.textZh: 地却帮助了那妇人，张开口，把从龙口中吐出来的河水吞了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地却帮助了那妇人，张开口，把从龙口中吐出来的河水吞了。
verses.textZhCuv: 地却帮助妇人，开口吞了从龙口吐出来的水 。
verses.textEnNiv: But the earth helped the woman by opening its mouth and swallowing the river that the dragon had spewed out of his mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: But the earth came to the help of the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river that the dragon had poured from his mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the flood which the dragon had spewed out of his mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: But the earth helped her by opening its mouth and swallowing the river that gushed out from the mouth of the dragon.
verses.textEnNasb: But the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and drank up the river which the dragon had hurled out of his mouth.
verses.textEn: But the earth helped the woman by opening its mouth and swallowing the river that the dragon had spewed out of his mouth.

verses.textZh: 龙就向妇人发怒，去和她其余的子孙作战，就是和那遵守神命令坚持耶稣见证的人作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 龙就向妇人发怒，去和她其余的子孙作战，就是和那遵守神命令坚持耶稣见证的人作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 龙向妇人发怒，去与她其余的儿女争战，这儿女就是那守神诫命、为耶稣作见证的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the dragon was enraged at the woman and went off to wage war against the rest of her offspring—those who keep God’s commands and hold fast their testimony about Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the dragon became furious with the woman and went off to make war on the rest of her offspring, on those who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus. And he stood on the sand of the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the dragon was enraged with the woman, and he went to make war with the rest of her offspring, who keep the commandments of God and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: And the dragon was angry at the woman and declared war against the rest of her children—all who keep God’s commandments and maintain their testimony for Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: So the dragon was enraged with the woman, and went off to make war with the rest of her children, who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus.
verses.textEn: Then the dragon was enraged at the woman and went off to wage war against the rest of her offspring—those who keep God’s commands and hold fast their testimony about Jesus.

verses.textZh: 那时，龙站在海边的沙上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，龙站在海边的沙上。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时龙就站在海边的沙上。
verses.textEnNiv: The dragon stood on the shore of the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: And he stood on the sand of the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I stood on the sand of the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the dragon took his stand on the shore beside the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: And the dragon stood on the sand of the seashore.
verses.textEn: The dragon stood on the shore of the sea.

verses.textZh: 我又看见一只兽从海里上来，有十角七头，十角上戴着十个皇冠，七头上有亵渎的名号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见一只兽从海里上来，有十角七头，十角上戴着十个皇冠，七头上有亵渎的名号。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见一个兽从海中上来，有十角七头，在十角上戴着十个冠冕，七头上有亵渎的名号。
verses.textEnNiv: The dragon stood on the shore of the sea. And I saw a beast coming out of the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads, with ten crowns on its horns, and on each head a blasphemous name.
verses.textEnEsv: And I saw a beast rising out of the sea, with ten horns and seven heads, with ten diadems on its horns and blasphemous names on its heads.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I stood on the sand of the sea. And I saw a beast rising up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his horns ten crowns, and on his heads a blasphemous name.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I saw a beast rising up out of the sea. It had seven heads and ten horns, with ten crowns on its horns. And written on each head were names that blasphemed God.
verses.textEnNasb: And the dragon stood on the sand of the seashore. Then I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads, and on his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads were blasphemous names.
verses.textEn: The dragon stood on the shore of the sea. And I saw a beast coming out of the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads, with ten crowns on its horns, and on each head a blasphemous name.

verses.textZh: 我所看见的兽，样子好象豹，脚像熊的脚，口像狮子的口。龙把自己的能力、王位和大权柄，都交给了牠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我所看见的兽，样子好象豹，脚像熊的脚，口像狮子的口。龙把自己的能力、王位和大权柄，都交给了牠。
verses.textZhCuv: 我所看见的兽，形状像豹，脚像熊的脚，口像狮子的口。那龙将自己的能力、座位，和大权柄都给了它。
verses.textEnNiv: The beast I saw resembled a leopard, but had feet like those of a bear and a mouth like that of a lion. The dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.
verses.textEnEsv: And the beast that I saw was like a leopard; its feet were like a bear’s, and its mouth was like a lion’s mouth. And to it the dragon gave his power and his throne and great authority.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the beast which I saw was like a leopard, his feet were like thefeetof a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.
verses.textEnNlt: This beast looked like a leopard, but it had the feet of a bear and the mouth of a lion! And the dragon gave the beast his own power and throne and great authority.
verses.textEnNasb: And the beast that I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. And the dragon gave him his power and his throne, and great authority.
verses.textEn: The beast I saw resembled a leopard, but had feet like those of a bear and a mouth like that of a lion. The dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.

verses.textZh: 兽的七头中有一个似乎受了致命伤，但那致命伤却医好了。全地的人都很惊奇，跟从那兽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 兽的七头中有一个似乎受了致命伤，但那致命伤却医好了。全地的人都很惊奇，跟从那兽。
verses.textZhCuv: 我看见兽的七头中，有一个似乎受了死伤，那死伤却医好了。全地的人都希奇跟从那兽，
verses.textEnNiv: One of the heads of the beast seemed to have had a fatal wound, but the fatal wound had been healed. The whole world was filled with wonder and followed the beast.
verses.textEnEsv: One of its heads seemed to have a mortal wound, but its mortal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled as they followed the beast.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I saw one of his heads as if it had been mortally wounded, and his deadly wound was healed. And all the world marveled and followed the beast.
verses.textEnNlt: I saw that one of the heads of the beast seemed wounded beyond recovery—but the fatal wound was healed! The whole world marveled at this miracle and gave allegiance to the beast.
verses.textEnNasb: I saw one of his heads as if it had been fatally wounded, and his fatal wound was healed. And the whole earth was amazed and followed after the beast;
verses.textEn: One of the heads of the beast seemed to have had a fatal wound, but the fatal wound had been healed. The whole world was filled with wonder and followed the beast.

verses.textZh: 因为龙把权柄交给了兽，大家就拜龙，也拜兽，说："有谁可以跟这兽相比？有谁能与牠作战呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为龙把权柄交给了兽，大家就拜龙，也拜兽，说："有谁可以跟这兽相比？有谁能与牠作战呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 又拜那龙－因为它将自己的权柄给了兽，也拜兽，说：「谁能比这兽，谁能与它交战呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: People worshiped the dragon because he had given authority to the beast, and they also worshiped the beast and asked, "Who is like the beast? Who can wage war against it?"
verses.textEnEsv: And they worshiped the dragon, for he had given his authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, "Who is like the beast, and who can fight against it?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So they worshiped the dragon who gave authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying, "Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?"
verses.textEnNlt: They worshiped the dragon for giving the beast such power, and they also worshiped the beast. "Who is as great as the beast?" they exclaimed. "Who is able to fight against him?"
verses.textEnNasb: they worshiped the dragon because he gave his authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying, "Who is like the beast, and who is able to wage war with him?"
verses.textEn: People worshiped the dragon because he had given authority to the beast, and they also worshiped the beast and asked, "Who is like the beast? Who can wage war against it?"

verses.textZh: 龙又给了那兽一张说夸大和亵渎话的嘴巴，也给了牠权柄可以任意而行四十二个月。
verses.textZhCnvs: 龙又给了那兽一张说夸大和亵渎话的嘴巴，也给了牠权柄可以任意而行四十二个月。
verses.textZhCuv: 又赐给它说夸大亵渎话的口，又有权柄赐给它，可以任意而行四十二个月。
verses.textEnNiv: The beast was given a mouth to utter proud words and blasphemies and to exercise its authority for forty-two months.
verses.textEnEsv: And the beast was given a mouth uttering haughty and blasphemous words, and it was allowed to exercise authority for forty-two months.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he was given a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies, and he was given authority to continue for forty-two months.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the beast was allowed to speak great blasphemies against God. And he was given authority to do whatever he wanted for forty-two months.
verses.textEnNasb: A mouth was given to him speaking arrogant words and blasphemies, and authority to act for forty-two months was given to him.
verses.textEn: The beast was given a mouth to utter proud words and blasphemies and to exercise its authority for forty-two months.

verses.textZh: 兽就开口向神说亵渎的话，亵渎他的名和他的帐幕，以及那些住在天上的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 兽就开口向神说亵渎的话，亵渎他的名和他的帐幕，以及那些住在天上的。
verses.textZhCuv: 兽就开口向神说亵渎的话，亵渎神的名并他的帐幕，以及那些住在天上的。
verses.textEnNiv: It opened its mouth to blaspheme God, and to slander his name and his dwelling place and those who live in heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: It opened its mouth to utter blasphemies against God, blaspheming his name and his dwelling, that is, those who dwell in heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme His name, His tabernacle, and those who dwell in heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: And he spoke terrible words of blasphemy against God, slandering his name and his dwelling—that is, those who dwell in heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: And he opened his mouth in blasphemies against God, to blaspheme His name and His tabernacle, that is, those who dwell in heaven.
verses.textEn: It opened its mouth to blaspheme God, and to slander his name and his dwelling place and those who live in heaven.

verses.textZh: 牠得了允许能跟圣徒作战，并且能胜过他们；又有权柄给了牠，可以管辖各支派、各民族、各方言、各邦国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠得了允许能跟圣徒作战，并且能胜过他们；又有权柄给了牠，可以管辖各支派、各民族、各方言、各邦国。
verses.textZhCuv: 又任凭它与圣徒争战，并且得胜；也把权柄赐给它，制伏各族、各民、各方、各国。
verses.textEnNiv: It was given power to wage war against God’s holy people and to conquer them. And it was given authority over every tribe, people, language and nation.
verses.textEnEsv: Also it was allowed to make war on the saints and to conquer them. And authority was given it over every tribe and people and language and nation,
verses.textEnNkjv: It was granted to him to make war with the saints and to overcome them. And authority was given him over every tribe, tongue, and nation.
verses.textEnNlt: And the beast was allowed to wage war against God’s holy people and to conquer them. And he was given authority to rule over every tribe and people and language and nation.
verses.textEnNasb: It was also given to him to make war with the saints and to overcome them, and authority was given to him over every tribe, people, language, and nation.
verses.textEn: It was given power to wage war against God’s holy people and to conquer them. And it was given authority over every tribe, people, language and nation.

verses.textZh: 所有住在地上的人，名字没有记在创世以来被杀的羊羔之生命册上的，都要拜牠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有住在地上的人，名字没有记在创世以来被杀的羊羔之生命册上的，都要拜牠。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡住在地上、名字从创世以来没有记在被杀之羔羊生命册上的人，都要拜它。
verses.textEnNiv: All inhabitants of the earth will worship the beast—all whose names have not been written in the Lamb’s book of life, the Lamb who was slain from the creation of the world.
verses.textEnEsv: and all who dwell on earth will worship it, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who was slain.
verses.textEnNkjv: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, whose names have not been written in the Book of Life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.
verses.textEnNlt: And all the people who belong to this world worshiped the beast. They are the ones whose names were not written in the Book of Life that belongs to the Lamb who was slaughtered before the world was made.
verses.textEnNasb: All who live on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written since the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been slaughtered.
verses.textEn: All inhabitants of the earth will worship the beast—all whose names have not been written in the Lamb’s book of life, the Lamb who was slain from the creation of the world.

verses.textZh: 凡有耳的，就应当听！
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡有耳的，就应当听！
verses.textZhCuv: 凡有耳的，就应当听！
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever has ears, let them hear.
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone has an ear, let him hear:
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone with ears to hear should listen and understand.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.
verses.textEn: Whoever has ears, let them hear.

verses.textZh: 如果人应该被俘掳， 就必被俘掳； 如果人应该被刀杀， 就必被刀杀。 在这里圣徒要有忍耐和信心！
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果人应该被俘掳， 就必被俘掳； 如果人应该被刀杀， 就必被刀杀。 在这里圣徒要有忍耐和信心！
verses.textZhCuv: 掳掠人的，必被掳掠； 用刀杀人的，必被刀杀。 圣徒的忍耐和信心就是在此。
verses.textEnNiv: "If anyone is to go into captivity, into captivity they will go. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, with the sword they will be killed." This calls for patient endurance and faithfulness on the part of God’s people.
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone is to be taken captive, to captivity he goes; if anyone is to be slain with the sword, with the sword must he be slain. Here is a call for the endurance and faith of the saints.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who leads into captivity shall go into captivity; he who kills with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who is destined for prison will be taken to prison. Anyone destined to die by the sword will die by the sword. This means that God’s holy people must endure persecution patiently and remain faithful.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone is destined for captivity, to captivity he goes; if anyone kills with the sword, with the sword he must be killed. Here is the perseverance and the faith of the saints.
verses.textEn: "If anyone is to go into captivity, into captivity they will go. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, with the sword they will be killed." This calls for patient endurance and faithfulness on the part of God’s people.

verses.textZh: 我又看见另一只兽从地里上来。牠有两个角，好象羊羔，说话好象龙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见另一只兽从地里上来。牠有两个角，好象羊羔，说话好象龙。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见另有一个兽从地中上来，有两角如同羊羔，说话好像龙。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I saw a second beast, coming out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb, but it spoke like a dragon.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I saw another beast rising out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I saw another beast coming up out of the earth, and he had two horns like a lamb and spoke like a dragon.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I saw another beast come up out of the earth. He had two horns like those of a lamb, but he spoke with the voice of a dragon.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I saw another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spoke as a dragon.
verses.textEn: Then I saw a second beast, coming out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb, but it spoke like a dragon.

verses.textZh: 牠在头一只兽面前，行使头一只兽的一切权柄。牠使全地和住在地上的人，都拜那受过致命伤而医好了的头一只兽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠在头一只兽面前，行使头一只兽的一切权柄。牠使全地和住在地上的人，都拜那受过致命伤而医好了的头一只兽。
verses.textZhCuv: 它在头一个兽面前，施行头一个兽所有的权柄，并且叫地和住在地上的人拜那死伤医好的头一个兽。
verses.textEnNiv: It exercised all the authority of the first beast on its behalf, and made the earth and its inhabitants worship the first beast, whose fatal wound had been healed.
verses.textEnEsv: It exercises all the authority of the first beast in its presence, and makes the earth and its inhabitants worship the first beast, whose mortal wound was healed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence, and causes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
verses.textEnNlt: He exercised all the authority of the first beast. And he required all the earth and its people to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound had been healed.
verses.textEnNasb: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. And he makes the earth and those who live on it worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.
verses.textEn: It exercised all the authority of the first beast on its behalf, and made the earth and its inhabitants worship the first beast, whose fatal wound had been healed.

verses.textZh: 牠又行大奇事，甚至在人面前叫火从天上降在地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠又行大奇事，甚至在人面前叫火从天上降在地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又行大奇事，甚至在人面前，叫火从天降在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: And it performed great signs, even causing fire to come down from heaven to the earth in full view of the people.
verses.textEnEsv: It performs great signs, even making fire come down from heaven to earth in front of people,
verses.textEnNkjv: He performs great signs, so that he even makes fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men.
verses.textEnNlt: He did astounding miracles, even making fire flash down to earth from the sky while everyone was watching.
verses.textEnNasb: He performs great signs, so that he even makes fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the presence of people.
verses.textEn: And it performed great signs, even causing fire to come down from heaven to the earth in full view of the people.

verses.textZh: 牠得了能力，在头一只兽面前能行奇事，迷惑了住在地上的人，吩咐住在地上的人，要为那受过刀伤而还活着的兽做个像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠得了能力，在头一只兽面前能行奇事，迷惑了住在地上的人，吩咐住在地上的人，要为那受过刀伤而还活着的兽做个像。
verses.textZhCuv: 它因赐给它权柄在兽面前能行奇事，就迷惑住在地上的人，说：「要给那受刀伤还活着的兽作个像。」
verses.textEnNiv: Because of the signs it was given power to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived the inhabitants of the earth. It ordered them to set up an image in honor of the beast who was wounded by the sword and yet lived.
verses.textEnEsv: and by the signs that it is allowed to work in the presence of the beast it deceives those who dwell on earth, telling them to make an image for the beast that was wounded by the sword and yet lived.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he deceives those who dwell on the earth by those signs which he was granted to do in the sight of the beast, telling those who dwell on the earth to make an image to the beast who was wounded by the sword and lived.
verses.textEnNlt: And with all the miracles he was allowed to perform on behalf of the first beast, he deceived all the people who belong to this world. He ordered the people to make a great statue of the first beast, who was fatally wounded and then came back to life.
verses.textEnNasb: And he deceives those who live on the earth because of the signs which it was given him to perform in the presence of the beast, telling those who live on the earth to make an image to the beast who *had the wound of the sword and has come to life.
verses.textEn: Because of the signs it was given power to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived the inhabitants of the earth. It ordered them to set up an image in honor of the beast who was wounded by the sword and yet lived.

verses.textZh: 又有能力赐给牠，可以把气息给兽像，使兽像能够说话，并且能够杀害那些不拜兽像的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有能力赐给牠，可以把气息给兽像，使兽像能够说话，并且能够杀害那些不拜兽像的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有权柄赐给它，叫兽像有生气，并且能说话，又叫所有不拜兽像的人都被杀害。
verses.textEnNiv: The second beast was given power to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship the image to be killed.
verses.textEnEsv: And it was allowed to give breath to the image of the beast, so that the image of the beast might even speak and might cause those who would not worship the image of the beast to be slain.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was granted power to give breath to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak and cause as many as would not worship the image of the beast to be killed.
verses.textEnNlt: He was then permitted to give life to this statue so that it could speak. Then the statue of the beast commanded that anyone refusing to worship it must die.
verses.textEnNasb: And it was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast, so that the image of the beast would even speak and cause all who do not worship the image of the beast to be killed.
verses.textEn: The second beast was given power to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship the image to be killed.

verses.textZh: 那从地里上来的兽，又要所有的人，无论大小贫富，自由的和作奴隶的，都在右手或额上，给自己作个记号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那从地里上来的兽，又要所有的人，无论大小贫富，自由的和作奴隶的，都在右手或额上，给自己作个记号。
verses.textZhCuv: 它又叫众人，无论大小、贫富、自主的、为奴的，都在右手上或是在额上受一个印记。
verses.textEnNiv: It also forced all people, great and small, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hands or on their foreheads,
verses.textEnEsv: Also it causes all, both small and great, both rich and poor, both free and slave, to be marked on the right hand or the forehead,
verses.textEnNkjv: He causes all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their foreheads,
verses.textEnNlt: He required everyone—small and great, rich and poor, free and slave—to be given a mark on the right hand or on the forehead.
verses.textEnNasb: And he causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slaves, to be given a mark on their right hands or on their foreheads,
verses.textEn: It also forced all people, great and small, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hands or on their foreheads,

verses.textZh: 这记号就是兽的名字或兽名的数字，除了那有记号的，谁也不能买，谁也不能卖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这记号就是兽的名字或兽名的数字，除了那有记号的，谁也不能买，谁也不能卖。
verses.textZhCuv: 除了那受印记、有了兽名或有兽名数目的，都不得做买卖。
verses.textEnNiv: so that they could not buy or sell unless they had the mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of its name.
verses.textEnEsv: so that no one can buy or sell unless he has the mark, that is, the name of the beast or the number of its name.
verses.textEnNkjv: and that no one may buy or sell except one who has the mark or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.
verses.textEnNlt: And no one could buy or sell anything without that mark, which was either the name of the beast or the number representing his name.
verses.textEnNasb: and he decrees that no one will be able to buy or to sell, except the one who has the mark, either the name of the beast or the number of his name.
verses.textEn: so that they could not buy or sell unless they had the mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of its name.

verses.textZh: 在这里要有智慧。有悟性的人，就让他计算兽的数字，因为这是人的数字，它的数字是六百六十六。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这里要有智慧。有悟性的人，就让他计算兽的数字，因为这是人的数字，它的数字是六百六十六。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这里有智慧：凡有聪明的，可以算计兽的数目；因为这是人的数目，它的数目是六百六十六。
verses.textEnNiv: This calls for wisdom. Let the person who has insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. That number is 666.
verses.textEnEsv: This calls for wisdom: let the one who has understanding calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and his number is 666.
verses.textEnNkjv: Here is wisdom. Let him who has understanding calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man: His number is 666.
verses.textEnNlt: Wisdom is needed here. Let the one with understanding solve the meaning of the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is 666.
verses.textEnNasb: Here is wisdom. Let him who has understanding calculate the number of the beast, for the number is that of a man; and his number is six hundred and sixty-six.
verses.textEn: This calls for wisdom. Let the person who has insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. That number is 666.

verses.textZh: 我又观看，见羊羔站在锡安山上，跟他在一起的还有十四万四千人。他们的额上都写着他的名和他父的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又观看，见羊羔站在锡安山上，跟他在一起的还有十四万四千人。他们的额上都写着他的名和他父的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又观看，见羔羊站在锡安山，同他又有十四万四千人，都有他的名和他父的名写在额上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I looked, and there before me was the Lamb, standing on Mount Zion, and with him 144,000 who had his name and his Father’s name written on their foreheads.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I looked, and behold, on Mount Zion stood the Lamb, and with him 144,000 who had his name and his Father’s name written on their foreheads.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I looked, and behold, a Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with Him one hundred and forty-four thousand, having His Father’s name written on their foreheads.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him were 144,000 who had his name and his Father’s name written on their foreheads.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I looked, and behold, the Lamb was standing on Mount Zion, and with Him 144,000 who had His name and the name of His Father written on their foreheads.
verses.textEn: Then I looked, and there before me was the Lamb, standing on Mount Zion, and with him 144,000 who had his name and his Father’s name written on their foreheads.

verses.textZh: 我听见有声音从天上来，好象众水的声音，好象大雷的声音；我所听见的声音，又像琴师弹奏的琴声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见有声音从天上来，好象众水的声音，好象大雷的声音；我所听见的声音，又像琴师弹奏的琴声。
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见从天上有声音，像众水的声音和大雷的声音，并且我所听见的好像弹琴的所弹的琴声。
verses.textEnNiv: And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of rushing waters and like a loud peal of thunder. The sound I heard was like that of harpists playing their harps.
verses.textEnEsv: And I heard a voice from heaven like the roar of many waters and like the sound of loud thunder. The voice I heard was like the sound of harpists playing on their harps,
verses.textEnNkjv: And I heard a voice from heaven, like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of loud thunder. And I heard the sound of harpists playing their harps.
verses.textEnNlt: And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of mighty ocean waves or the rolling of loud thunder. It was like the sound of many harpists playing together.
verses.textEnNasb: And I heard a voice from heaven, like the sound of many waters and like the sound of loud thunder, and the voice which I heard was like the sound of harpists playing on their harps.
verses.textEn: And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of rushing waters and like a loud peal of thunder. The sound I heard was like that of harpists playing their harps.

verses.textZh: 他们在宝座前，在四个活物和众长老面前唱新歌；除了从地上买来的那十四万四千人以外，没有人能学这歌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在宝座前，在四个活物和众长老面前唱新歌；除了从地上买来的那十四万四千人以外，没有人能学这歌。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在宝座前，并在四活物和众长老前唱歌，仿佛是新歌；除了从地上买来的那十四万四千人以外，没有人能学这歌。
verses.textEnNiv: And they sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: and they were singing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and before the elders. No one could learn that song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: They sang as it were a new song before the throne, before the four living creatures, and the elders; and no one could learn that song except the hundred and forty-four thousand who were redeemed from the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: This great choir sang a wonderful new song in front of the throne of God and before the four living beings and the twenty-four elders. No one could learn this song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: And they *sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders; and no one was able to learn the song except the 144,000 who had been purchased from the earth.
verses.textEn: And they sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.

verses.textZh: 这些人没有跟妇女在一起而使自己玷污，他们原是童身的。羊羔无论到哪里去，他们都跟随他。这些人是从世人中买来的，作初熟的果子归给神和羊羔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人没有跟妇女在一起而使自己玷污，他们原是童身的。羊羔无论到哪里去，他们都跟随他。这些人是从世人中买来的，作初熟的果子归给神和羊羔。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人未曾沾染妇女，他们原是童身。羔羊无论往哪里去，他们都跟随他。他们是从人间买来的，作初熟的果子归与神和羔羊。
verses.textEnNiv: These are those who did not defile themselves with women, for they remained virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever he goes. They were purchased from among mankind and offered as firstfruits to God and the Lamb.
verses.textEnEsv: It is these who have not defiled themselves with women, for they are virgins. It is these who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These have been redeemed from mankind as firstfruits for God and the Lamb,
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the ones who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever He goes. These were redeemed from among men, being firstfruits to God and to the Lamb.
verses.textEnNlt: They have kept themselves as pure as virgins, following the Lamb wherever he goes. They have been purchased from among the people on the earth as a special offering to God and to the Lamb.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the ones who have not defiled themselves with women, for they are celibate. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever He goes. These have been purchased from mankind as first fruits to God and to the Lamb.
verses.textEn: These are those who did not defile themselves with women, for they remained virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever he goes. They were purchased from among mankind and offered as firstfruits to God and the Lamb.

verses.textZh: 在他们口中找不着谎言；他们是没有瑕疵的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他们口中找不着谎言；他们是没有瑕疵的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他们口中察不出谎言来；他们是没有瑕疵的。
verses.textEnNiv: No lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.
verses.textEnEsv: and in their mouth no lie was found, for they are blameless.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in their mouth was found no deceit, for they are without fault before the throne of God.
verses.textEnNlt: They have told no lies; they are without blame.
verses.textEnNasb: And no lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.
verses.textEn: No lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.

verses.textZh: 我又看见另一位天使在高空飞翔，有永远的福音要传给住在地上的人，就是各邦国、各支派、各方言、各民族的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见另一位天使在高空飞翔，有永远的福音要传给住在地上的人，就是各邦国、各支派、各方言、各民族的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见另有一位天使飞在空中，有永远的福音要传给住在地上的人，就是各国、各族、各方、各民。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I saw another angel flying in midair, and he had the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who live on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language and people.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I saw another angel flying directly overhead, with an eternal gospel to proclaim to those who dwell on earth, to every nation and tribe and language and people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I saw another angel flying in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach to those who dwell on the earth— to every nation, tribe, tongue, and people—
verses.textEnNlt: And I saw another angel flying through the sky, carrying the eternal Good News to proclaim to the people who belong to this world—to every nation, tribe, language, and people.
verses.textEnNasb: And I saw another angel flying in midheaven with an eternal gospel to preach to those who live on the earth, and to every nation, tribe, language, and people;
verses.textEn: Then I saw another angel flying in midair, and he had the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who live on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language and people.

verses.textZh: 他大声说："应当敬畏神，把荣耀归给他！因为他审判的时候到了，应当敬拜创造天、地、海和众水泉源的那一位！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他大声说："应当敬畏神，把荣耀归给他！因为他审判的时候到了，应当敬拜创造天、地、海和众水泉源的那一位！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他大声说：「应当敬畏神，将荣耀归给他！因他施行审判的时候已经到了。应当敬拜那创造天地海和众水泉源的。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said in a loud voice, "Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heavens, the earth, the sea and the springs of water."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said with a loud voice, "Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment has come, and worship him who made heaven and earth, the sea and the springs of water."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying with a loud voice, "Fear God and give glory to Him, for the hour of His judgment has come; and worship Him who made heaven and earth, the sea and springs of water."
verses.textEnNlt: "Fear God," he shouted. "Give glory to him. For the time has come when he will sit as judge. Worship him who made the heavens, the earth, the sea, and all the springs of water."
verses.textEnNasb: and he said with a loud voice, "Fear God and give Him glory, because the hour of His judgment has come; worship Him who made the heaven and the earth, and sea and springs of waters."
verses.textEn: He said in a loud voice, "Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heavens, the earth, the sea and the springs of water."

verses.textZh: 又有第二位天使接着说："倾倒了！大巴比伦倾倒了！它曾经叫列国喝它淫乱烈怒的酒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有第二位天使接着说："倾倒了！大巴比伦倾倒了！它曾经叫列国喝它淫乱烈怒的酒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又有第二位天使接着说：「叫万民喝邪淫、大怒之酒的巴比伦大城倾倒了！倾倒了！」
verses.textEnNiv: A second angel followed and said, " ‘Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the Great,’ which made all the nations drink the maddening wine of her adulteries."
verses.textEnEsv: Another angel, a second, followed, saying, "Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, she who made all nations drink the wine of the passion of her sexual immorality."
verses.textEnNkjv: And another angel followed, saying, "Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she has made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication."
verses.textEnNlt: Then another angel followed him through the sky, shouting, "Babylon is fallen—that great city is fallen—because she made all the nations of the world drink the wine of her passionate immorality."
verses.textEnNasb: And another angel, a second one, followed, saying, " Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, she who has made all the nations drink of the wine of the passion of her sexual immorality."
verses.textEn: A second angel followed and said, " ‘Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the Great,’ which made all the nations drink the maddening wine of her adulteries."

verses.textZh: 又有第三位天使接着他们大声说："如果有人拜兽和兽像，又在自己的额上或手上受了记号，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有第三位天使接着他们大声说："如果有人拜兽和兽像，又在自己的额上或手上受了记号，
verses.textZhCuv: 又有第三位天使接着他们，大声说：「若有人拜兽和兽像，在额上或在手上受了印记，
verses.textEnNiv: A third angel followed them and said in a loud voice: "If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives its mark on their forehead or on their hand,
verses.textEnEsv: And another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a loud voice, "If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, "If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives his mark on his forehead or on his hand,
verses.textEnNlt: Then a third angel followed them, shouting, "Anyone who worships the beast and his statue or who accepts his mark on the forehead or on the hand
verses.textEnNasb: Then another angel, a third one, followed them, saying with a loud voice, "If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,
verses.textEn: A third angel followed them and said in a loud voice: "If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives its mark on their forehead or on their hand,

verses.textZh: 他就必定喝神烈怒的酒：这酒是斟在神震怒的杯中，纯一不杂的。他必定在众天使和羊羔面前，在火与硫磺之中受痛苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就必定喝神烈怒的酒：这酒是斟在神震怒的杯中，纯一不杂的。他必定在众天使和羊羔面前，在火与硫磺之中受痛苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人也必喝神大怒的酒；此酒斟在神忿怒的杯中纯一不杂。他要在圣天使和羔羊面前，在火与硫磺之中受痛苦。
verses.textEnNiv: they, too, will drink the wine of God’s fury, which has been poured full strength into the cup of his wrath. They will be tormented with burning sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb.
verses.textEnEsv: he also will drink the wine of God’s wrath, poured full strength into the cup of his anger, and he will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.
verses.textEnNkjv: he himself shall also drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out full strength into the cup of His indignation. He shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.
verses.textEnNlt: must drink the wine of God’s anger. It has been poured full strength into God’s cup of wrath. And they will be tormented with fire and burning sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and the Lamb.
verses.textEnNasb: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is mixed in full strength in the cup of His anger; and he will be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.
verses.textEn: they, too, will drink the wine of God’s fury, which has been poured full strength into the cup of his wrath. They will be tormented with burning sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb.

verses.textZh: 他们受痛苦的烟往上冒，直到永永远远。那些拜兽和兽像的，以及接受牠名字的记号的人，日夜得不到安息。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们受痛苦的烟往上冒，直到永永远远。那些拜兽和兽像的，以及接受牠名字的记号的人，日夜得不到安息。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他受痛苦的烟往上冒，直到永永远远。那些拜兽和兽像，受它名之印记的，昼夜不得安宁。」
verses.textEnNiv: And the smoke of their torment will rise for ever and ever. There will be no rest day or night for those who worship the beast and its image, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name."
verses.textEnEsv: And the smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever, and they have no rest, day or night, these worshipers of the beast and its image, and whoever receives the mark of its name."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the smoke of their torment ascends forever and ever; and they have no rest day or night, who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name."
verses.textEnNlt: The smoke of their torment will rise forever and ever, and they will have no relief day or night, for they have worshiped the beast and his statue and have accepted the mark of his name."
verses.textEnNasb: And the smoke of their torment ascends forever and ever; they have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name."
verses.textEn: And the smoke of their torment will rise for ever and ever. There will be no rest day or night for those who worship the beast and its image, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name."

verses.textZh: 在这里，那些遵守神的命令和耶稣的信仰的圣徒，要有忍耐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这里，那些遵守神的命令和耶稣的信仰的圣徒，要有忍耐。
verses.textZhCuv: 圣徒的忍耐就在此；他们是守神诫命和耶稣真道的。
verses.textEnNiv: This calls for patient endurance on the part of the people of God who keep his commands and remain faithful to Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: Here is a call for the endurance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and their faith in Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Here is the patience of the saints; here are those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: This means that God’s holy people must endure persecution patiently, obeying his commands and maintaining their faith in Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: Here is the perseverance of the saints who keep the commandments of God and their faith in Jesus.
verses.textEn: This calls for patient endurance on the part of the people of God who keep his commands and remain faithful to Jesus.

verses.textZh: 我听见从天上有声音说："你要写下来！从今以后，那在主里死去的人有福了！"圣灵说："是的，他们脱离自己的劳苦，得享安息了，他们的作为也随着他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见从天上有声音说："你要写下来！从今以后，那在主里死去的人有福了！"圣灵说："是的，他们脱离自己的劳苦，得享安息了，他们的作为也随着他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见从天上有声音说：「你要写下：从今以后，在主里面而死的人有福了！」圣灵说：「是的，他们息了自己的劳苦，做工的果效也随着他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, "Write this: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on." "Yes," says the Spirit, "they will rest from their labor, for their deeds will follow them."
verses.textEnEsv: And I heard a voice from heaven saying, "Write this: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on." "Blessed indeed," says the Spirit, "that they may rest from their labors, for their deeds follow them!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I heard a voice from heaven saying to me, "Write: ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’ " "Yes," says the Spirit, "that they may rest from their labors, and their works follow them."
verses.textEnNlt: And I heard a voice from heaven saying, "Write this down: Blessed are those who die in the Lord from now on. Yes, says the Spirit, they are blessed indeed, for they will rest from their hard work; for their good deeds follow them!"
verses.textEnNasb: And I heard a voice from heaven, saying, "Write: ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on!’ " "Yes," says the Spirit, "so that they may rest from their labors, for their deeds follow with them."
verses.textEn: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, "Write this: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on." "Yes," says the Spirit, "they will rest from their labor, for their deeds will follow them."

verses.textZh: 我又观看，见有一片白云，云上坐着一位好象人子的，头上戴着金冠，手里拿着锋利的镰刀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又观看，见有一片白云，云上坐着一位好象人子的，头上戴着金冠，手里拿着锋利的镰刀。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又观看，见有一片白云，云上坐着一位好像人子，头上戴着金冠冕，手里拿着快镰刀。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked, and there before me was a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was one like a son of man with a crown of gold on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I looked, and behold, a white cloud, and seated on the cloud one like a son of man, with a golden crown on his head, and a sharp sickle in his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I looked, and behold, a white cloud, and on the cloud sat One like the Son of Man, having on His head a golden crown, and in His hand a sharp sickle.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I saw a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was someone like the Son of Man. He had a gold crown on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I looked, and behold, a white cloud, and sitting on the cloud was one like a son of man, with a golden crown on His head and a sharp sickle in His hand.
verses.textEn: I looked, and there before me was a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was one like a son of man with a crown of gold on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.

verses.textZh: 有另一位天使从圣所出来，对那坐在云上的大声呼喊："伸出你的镰刀来收割吧！因为收割的时候已经到了，地上的庄稼已经熟透了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有另一位天使从圣所出来，对那坐在云上的大声呼喊："伸出你的镰刀来收割吧！因为收割的时候已经到了，地上的庄稼已经熟透了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又有一位天使从殿中出来，向那坐在云上的大声喊着说：「伸出你的镰刀来收割；因为收割的时候已经到了，地上的庄稼已经熟透了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then another angel came out of the temple and called in a loud voice to him who was sitting on the cloud, "Take your sickle and reap, because the time to reap has come, for the harvest of the earth is ripe."
verses.textEnEsv: And another angel came out of the temple, calling with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, "Put in your sickle, and reap, for the hour to reap has come, for the harvest of the earth is fully ripe."
verses.textEnNkjv: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to Him who sat on the cloud, "Thrust in Your sickle and reap, for the time has come for You to reap, for the harvest of the earth is ripe."
verses.textEnNlt: Then another angel came from the Temple and shouted to the one sitting on the cloud, "Swing the sickle, for the time of harvest has come; the crop on earth is ripe."
verses.textEnNasb: And another angel came out of the temple, calling out with a loud voice to Him who sat on the cloud, " Put in Your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come, because the harvest of the earth is ripe."
verses.textEn: Then another angel came out of the temple and called in a loud voice to him who was sitting on the cloud, "Take your sickle and reap, because the time to reap has come, for the harvest of the earth is ripe."

verses.textZh: 于是那坐在云上的向地上挥动镰刀，地上的庄稼就被收割了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是那坐在云上的向地上挥动镰刀，地上的庄稼就被收割了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那坐在云上的，就把镰刀扔在地上，地上的庄稼就被收割了。
verses.textEnNiv: So he who was seated on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.
verses.textEnEsv: So he who sat on the cloud swung his sickle across the earth, and the earth was reaped.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He who sat on the cloud thrust in His sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.
verses.textEnNlt: So the one sitting on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the whole earth was harvested.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He who sat on the cloud swung His sickle over the earth, and the earth was reaped.
verses.textEn: So he who was seated on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.

verses.textZh: 又有另一位天使从天上的圣所出来，他也拿着一把锋利的镰刀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有另一位天使从天上的圣所出来，他也拿着一把锋利的镰刀。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有一位天使从天上的殿中出来，他也拿着快镰刀。
verses.textEnNiv: Another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.
verses.textEnEsv: Then another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.
verses.textEnNlt: After that, another angel came from the Temple in heaven, and he also had a sharp sickle.
verses.textEnNasb: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, and he also had a sharp sickle.
verses.textEn: Another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.

verses.textZh: 接着，又有一位天使从祭坛那里出来，是有权柄掌管火的；他向那拿着锋利镰刀的天使大声说："伸出你锋利的镰刀来，收取地上葡萄树累累的果子吧！因为葡萄已经熟透了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着，又有一位天使从祭坛那里出来，是有权柄掌管火的；他向那拿着锋利镰刀的天使大声说："伸出你锋利的镰刀来，收取地上葡萄树累累的果子吧！因为葡萄已经熟透了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又有一位天使从祭坛中出来，是有权柄管火的，向拿着快镰刀的大声喊着说：「伸出快镰刀来，收取地上葡萄树的果子，因为葡萄熟透了！」
verses.textEnNiv: Still another angel, who had charge of the fire, came from the altar and called in a loud voice to him who had the sharp sickle, "Take your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the earth’s vine, because its grapes are ripe."
verses.textEnEsv: And another angel came out from the altar, the angel who has authority over the fire, and he called with a loud voice to the one who had the sharp sickle, "Put in your sickle and gather the clusters from the vine of the earth, for its grapes are ripe."
verses.textEnNkjv: And another angel came out from the altar, who had power over fire, and he cried with a loud cry to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, "Thrust in your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for her grapes are fully ripe."
verses.textEnNlt: Then another angel, who had power to destroy with fire, came from the altar. He shouted to the angel with the sharp sickle, "Swing your sickle now to gather the clusters of grapes from the vines of the earth, for they are ripe for judgment."
verses.textEnNasb: Then another angel, the one who has power over fire, came out from the altar; and he called with a loud voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, " Put in your sharp sickle and gather the clusters from the vine of the earth, because her grapes are ripe."
verses.textEn: Still another angel, who had charge of the fire, came from the altar and called in a loud voice to him who had the sharp sickle, "Take your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the earth’s vine, because its grapes are ripe."

verses.textZh: 于是，那天使向地上挥动镰刀，收取了地上的葡萄，把葡萄扔在神烈怒的大压酒池里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，那天使向地上挥动镰刀，收取了地上的葡萄，把葡萄扔在神烈怒的大压酒池里。
verses.textZhCuv: 那天使就把镰刀扔在地上，收取了地上的葡萄，丢在神忿怒的大酒榨中。
verses.textEnNiv: The angel swung his sickle on the earth, gathered its grapes and threw them into the great winepress of God’s wrath.
verses.textEnEsv: So the angel swung his sickle across the earth and gathered the grape harvest of the earth and threw it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the angel thrust his sickle into the earth and gathered the vine of the earth, and threw it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.
verses.textEnNlt: So the angel swung his sickle over the earth and loaded the grapes into the great winepress of God’s wrath.
verses.textEnNasb: So the angel swung his sickle to the earth and gathered the clusters from the vine of the earth, and threw them into the great wine press of the wrath of God.
verses.textEn: The angel swung his sickle on the earth, gathered its grapes and threw them into the great winepress of God’s wrath.

verses.textZh: 那压酒池在城外被踹踏，就有血从压酒池流出来，涨到马的嚼环那么高，流到三百公里 那么远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那压酒池在城外被踹踏，就有血从压酒池流出来，涨到马的嚼环那么高，流到三百公里 那么远。
verses.textZhCuv: 那酒榨踹在城外，就有血从酒榨里流出来，高到马的嚼环，远有六百里。
verses.textEnNiv: They were trampled in the winepress outside the city, and blood flowed out of the press, rising as high as the horses’ bridles for a distance of 1,600 stadia.
verses.textEnEsv: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and blood flowed from the winepress, as high as a horse’s bridle, for 1,600 stadia.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the winepress was trampled outside the city, and blood came out of the winepress, up to the horses’ bridles, for one thousand six hundred furlongs.
verses.textEnNlt: The grapes were trampled in the winepress outside the city, and blood flowed from the winepress in a stream about 180 miles long and as high as a horse’s bridle.
verses.textEnNasb: And the wine press was trampled outside the city, and blood came out from the wine press, up to the horses’ bridles, for a distance of 1,600 stadia.
verses.textEn: They were trampled in the winepress outside the city, and blood flowed out of the press, rising as high as the horses’ bridles for a distance of 1,600 stadia.

verses.textZh: 我看见天上有另一个景象，又大又奇。有七位天使掌管着末后的七灾，因为神的烈怒在这七灾中发尽了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见天上有另一个景象，又大又奇。有七位天使掌管着末后的七灾，因为神的烈怒在这七灾中发尽了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见在天上有异象，大而且奇，就是七位天使掌管末了的七灾，因为神的大怒在这七灾中发尽了。
verses.textEnNiv: I saw in heaven another great and marvelous sign: seven angels with the seven last plagues—last, because with them God’s wrath is completed.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I saw another sign in heaven, great and amazing, seven angels with seven plagues, which are the last, for with them the wrath of God is finished.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvelous: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them the wrath of God is complete.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I saw in heaven another marvelous event of great significance. Seven angels were holding the seven last plagues, which would bring God’s wrath to completion.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvelous, seven angels who had seven plagues, which are the last, because in them the wrath of God is finished.
verses.textEn: I saw in heaven another great and marvelous sign: seven angels with the seven last plagues—last, because with them God’s wrath is completed.

verses.textZh: 我又看见好象有一个搀杂着火的玻璃海；也看见那些胜过了兽、兽像，以及兽名的数字的人。他们都站在玻璃海上，拿着神的琴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见好象有一个搀杂着火的玻璃海；也看见那些胜过了兽、兽像，以及兽名的数字的人。他们都站在玻璃海上，拿着神的琴。
verses.textZhCuv: 我看见仿佛有玻璃海，其中有火搀杂。又看见那些胜了兽和兽的像并它名字数目的人，都站在玻璃海上，拿着神的琴，
verses.textEnNiv: And I saw what looked like a sea of glass glowing with fire and, standing beside the sea, those who had been victorious over the beast and its image and over the number of its name. They held harps given them by God
verses.textEnEsv: And I saw what appeared to be a sea of glass mingled with fire—and also those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name, standing beside the sea of glass with harps of God in their hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I saw something like a sea of glass mingled with fire, and those who have the victory over the beast, over his image and over his mark and over the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.
verses.textEnNlt: I saw before me what seemed to be a glass sea mixed with fire. And on it stood all the people who had been victorious over the beast and his statue and the number representing his name. They were all holding harps that God had given them.
verses.textEnNasb: And I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who were victorious over the beast and his image and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, holding harps of God.
verses.textEn: And I saw what looked like a sea of glass glowing with fire and, standing beside the sea, those who had been victorious over the beast and its image and over the number of its name. They held harps given them by God

verses.textZh: 他们唱着神仆人摩西的歌和羊羔的歌，说： "主啊！全能的神， 你的作为又伟大又奇妙！ 万国的王啊， 你的道路又公义又真实！
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们唱着神仆人摩西的歌和羊羔的歌，说： "主啊！全能的神， 你的作为又伟大又奇妙！ 万国的王啊， 你的道路又公义又真实！
verses.textZhCuv: 唱神仆人摩西的歌和羔羊的歌，说： 主神－全能者啊， 你的作为大哉！奇哉！ 万世 之王啊， 你的道途义哉！诚哉！
verses.textEnNiv: and sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: "Great and marvelous are your deeds, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are your ways, King of the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: And they sing the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, "Great and amazing are your deeds, O Lord God the Almighty! Just and true are your ways, O King of the nations!
verses.textEnNkjv: They sing the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying: "Great and marvelous are Your works, Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the saints!
verses.textEnNlt: And they were singing the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb: "Great and marvelous are your works, O Lord God, the Almighty. Just and true are your ways, O King of the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: And they *sang the song of Moses, the bond-servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, "Great and marvelous are Your works, Lord God, the Almighty; Righteous and true are Your ways, King of the nations!
verses.textEn: and sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: "Great and marvelous are your deeds, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are your ways, King of the nations.

verses.textZh: 主啊！谁敢不敬畏你， 不荣耀你的名呢？ 因为只有你是神圣的， 万国都要来， 在你面前下拜， 因为你公义的作为已经显明出来了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！谁敢不敬畏你， 不荣耀你的名呢？ 因为只有你是神圣的， 万国都要来， 在你面前下拜， 因为你公义的作为已经显明出来了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，谁敢不敬畏你， 不将荣耀归与你的名呢？ 因为独有你是圣的。 万民都要来在你面前敬拜， 因你公义的作为已经显出来了。
verses.textEnNiv: Who will not fear you, Lord, and bring glory to your name? For you alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before you, for your righteous acts have been revealed."
verses.textEnEsv: Who will not fear, O Lord, and glorify your name? For you alone are holy. All nations will come and worship you, for your righteous acts have been revealed."
verses.textEnNkjv: Who shall not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. For all nations shall come and worship before You, For Your judgments have been manifested."
verses.textEnNlt: Who will not fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before you, for your righteous deeds have been revealed."
verses.textEnNasb: "Who will not fear You, Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy; For all the nations will come and worship before You, For Your righteous acts have been revealed."
verses.textEn: Who will not fear you, Lord, and bring glory to your name? For you alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before you, for your righteous acts have been revealed."

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，我观看，见天上安放约柜 的帐幕的圣所开了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，我观看，见天上安放约柜 的帐幕的圣所开了。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，我看见在天上那存法柜的殿开了。
verses.textEnNiv: After this I looked, and I saw in heaven the temple—that is, the tabernacle of the covenant law—and it was opened.
verses.textEnEsv: After this I looked, and the sanctuary of the tent of witness in heaven was opened,
verses.textEnNkjv: After these things I looked, and behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I looked and saw that the Temple in heaven, God’s Tabernacle, was thrown wide open.
verses.textEnNasb: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of testimony in heaven was opened,
verses.textEn: After this I looked, and I saw in heaven the temple—that is, the tabernacle of the covenant law—and it was opened.

verses.textZh: 那掌管着末后七灾的七位天使，从圣所出来，穿著清洁明亮的细麻衣，胸间束着金带。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那掌管着末后七灾的七位天使，从圣所出来，穿著清洁明亮的细麻衣，胸间束着金带。
verses.textZhCuv: 那掌管七灾的七位天使从殿中出来，穿着洁白光明的细麻衣 ，胸间束着金带。
verses.textEnNiv: Out of the temple came the seven angels with the seven plagues. They were dressed in clean, shining linen and wore golden sashes around their chests.
verses.textEnEsv: and out of the sanctuary came the seven angels with the seven plagues, clothed in pure, bright linen, with golden sashes around their chests.
verses.textEnNkjv: And out of the temple came the seven angels having the seven plagues, clothed in pure bright linen, and having their chests girded with golden bands.
verses.textEnNlt: The seven angels who were holding the seven plagues came out of the Temple. They were clothed in spotless white linen with gold sashes across their chests.
verses.textEnNasb: and the seven angels who had the seven plagues came out of the temple, clothed in linen, clean and bright, and their chests wrapped with golden sashes.
verses.textEn: Out of the temple came the seven angels with the seven plagues. They were dressed in clean, shining linen and wore golden sashes around their chests.

verses.textZh: 四个活物中有一个，把盛满了活到永永远远之神的烈怒的七个金碗，交给了那七位天使。
verses.textZhCnvs: 四个活物中有一个，把盛满了活到永永远远之神的烈怒的七个金碗，交给了那七位天使。
verses.textZhCuv: 四活物中有一个把盛满了活到永永远远之神大怒的七个金碗给了那七位天使。
verses.textEnNiv: Then one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls filled with the wrath of God, who lives for ever and ever.
verses.textEnEsv: And one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God who lives forever and ever,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God who lives forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: Then one of the four living beings handed each of the seven angels a gold bowl filled with the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
verses.textEnNasb: And one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
verses.textEn: Then one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls filled with the wrath of God, who lives for ever and ever.

verses.textZh: 因着神的荣耀和大能，圣所中充满了烟，在那七位天使降完七灾以前，没有人能进入圣所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着神的荣耀和大能，圣所中充满了烟，在那七位天使降完七灾以前，没有人能进入圣所。
verses.textZhCuv: 因神的荣耀和能力，殿中充满了烟。于是没有人能以进殿，直等到那七位天使所降的七灾完毕了。
verses.textEnNiv: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
verses.textEnEsv: and the sanctuary was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one could enter the sanctuary until the seven plagues of the seven angels were finished.
verses.textEnNkjv: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power, and no one was able to enter the temple till the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
verses.textEnNlt: The Temple was filled with smoke from God’s glory and power. No one could enter the Temple until the seven angels had completed pouring out the seven plagues.
verses.textEnNasb: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power; and no one was able to enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were finished.
verses.textEn: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.

verses.textZh: 我听见有大声音从圣所里发出来，向那七位天使说："你们去，把神烈怒的七碗倒在地上！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见有大声音从圣所里发出来，向那七位天使说："你们去，把神烈怒的七碗倒在地上！"
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见有大声音从殿中出来，向那七位天使说：「你们去，把盛神大怒的七碗倒在地上。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, "Go, pour out the seven bowls of God’s wrath on the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple telling the seven angels, "Go and pour out on the earth the seven bowls of the wrath of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, "Go and pour out the bowls of the wrath of God on the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: Then I heard a mighty voice from the Temple say to the seven angels, "Go your ways and pour out on the earth the seven bowls containing God’s wrath."
verses.textEnNasb: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple, saying to the seven angels, "Go and pour out on the earth the seven bowls of the wrath of God."
verses.textEn: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, "Go, pour out the seven bowls of God’s wrath on the earth."

verses.textZh: 第一位天使去了，把碗倒在地上，就有恶性的毒疮，生在那些有兽的记号和拜兽像的人身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一位天使去了，把碗倒在地上，就有恶性的毒疮，生在那些有兽的记号和拜兽像的人身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 第一位天使便去，把碗倒在地上，就有恶而且毒的疮生在那些有兽印记、拜兽像的人身上。
verses.textEnNiv: The first angel went and poured out his bowl on the land, and ugly, festering sores broke out on the people who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.
verses.textEnEsv: So the first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth, and harmful and painful sores came upon the people who bore the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the first went and poured out his bowl upon the earth, and a foul and loathsome sore came upon the men who had the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image.
verses.textEnNlt: So the first angel left the Temple and poured out his bowl on the earth, and horrible, malignant sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and who worshiped his statue.
verses.textEnNasb: So the first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth; and a harmful and painful sore afflicted the people who had the mark of the beast and who worshiped his image.
verses.textEn: The first angel went and poured out his bowl on the land, and ugly, festering sores broke out on the people who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.

verses.textZh: 第二位天使把碗倒在海里，海水就变成好象死人的血，海里的一切生物都死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二位天使把碗倒在海里，海水就变成好象死人的血，海里的一切生物都死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二位天使把碗倒在海里，海就变成血，好像死人的血，海中的活物都死了。
verses.textEnNiv: The second angel poured out his bowl on the sea, and it turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
verses.textEnEsv: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became like the blood of a corpse, and every living thing died that was in the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the second angel poured out his bowl on the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man; and every living creature in the sea died.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the second angel poured out his bowl on the sea, and it became like the blood of a corpse. And everything in the sea died.
verses.textEnNasb: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood like that of a dead man; and every living thing in the sea died.
verses.textEn: The second angel poured out his bowl on the sea, and it turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.

verses.textZh: 第三位天使把碗倒在江河和众水的泉源里，水就变成了血。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三位天使把碗倒在江河和众水的泉源里，水就变成了血。
verses.textZhCuv: 第三位天使把碗倒在江河与众水的泉源里，水就变成血了。
verses.textEnNiv: The third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
verses.textEnEsv: The third angel poured out his bowl into the rivers and the springs of water, and they became blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and springs, and they became blood.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the third angel poured out his bowl into the rivers and the springs of waters; and they became blood.
verses.textEn: The third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

verses.textZh: 我听见掌管众水的天使说： "今在昔在的圣者啊！ 你这样审判是公义的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见掌管众水的天使说： "今在昔在的圣者啊！ 你这样审判是公义的，
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见掌管众水的天使说： 昔在、今在的圣者啊， 你这样判断是公义的；
verses.textEnNiv: Then I heard the angel in charge of the waters say: "You are just in these judgments, O Holy One, you who are and who were;
verses.textEnEsv: And I heard the angel in charge of the waters say, "Just are you, O Holy One, who is and who was, for you brought these judgments.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I heard the angel of the waters saying: "You are righteous, O Lord, The One who is and who was and who is to be, Because You have judged these things.
verses.textEnNlt: And I heard the angel who had authority over all water saying, "You are just, O Holy One, who is and who always was, because you have sent these judgments.
verses.textEnNasb: And I heard the angel of the waters saying, "Righteous are You, the One who is and who was, O Holy One, because You judged these things;
verses.textEn: Then I heard the angel in charge of the waters say: "You are just in these judgments, O Holy One, you who are and who were;

verses.textZh: 因为他们曾流圣徒和先知的血， 现在你给他们血喝， 这是他们该受的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们曾流圣徒和先知的血， 现在你给他们血喝， 这是他们该受的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们曾流圣徒与先知的血， 现在你给他们血喝； 这是他们所该受的。
verses.textEnNiv: for they have shed the blood of your holy people and your prophets, and you have given them blood to drink as they deserve."
verses.textEnEsv: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. It is what they deserve!"
verses.textEnNkjv: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, And You have given them blood to drink. For it is their just due."
verses.textEnNlt: Since they shed the blood of your holy people and your prophets, you have given them blood to drink. It is their just reward."
verses.textEnNasb: for they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and You have given them blood to drink. They deserve it."
verses.textEn: for they have shed the blood of your holy people and your prophets, and you have given them blood to drink as they deserve."

verses.textZh: 我又听见祭坛中有声音说： "是的，主啊！全能的神， 你的审判真实、公义！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又听见祭坛中有声音说： "是的，主啊！全能的神， 你的审判真实、公义！"
verses.textZhCuv: 我又听见祭坛中有声音说： 是的，主神－全能者啊， 你的判断义哉！诚哉！
verses.textEnNiv: And I heard the altar respond: "Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are your judgments."
verses.textEnEsv: And I heard the altar saying, "Yes, Lord God the Almighty, true and just are your judgments!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And I heard another from the altar saying, "Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are Your judgments."
verses.textEnNlt: And I heard a voice from the altar, saying, "Yes, O Lord God, the Almighty, your judgments are true and just."
verses.textEnNasb: And I heard the altar saying, "Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are Your judgments."
verses.textEn: And I heard the altar respond: "Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are your judgments."

verses.textZh: 第四位天使把碗倒在太阳上，太阳就得了能力，可以用火烤人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第四位天使把碗倒在太阳上，太阳就得了能力，可以用火烤人。
verses.textZhCuv: 第四位天使把碗倒在日头上，叫日头能用火烤人。
verses.textEnNiv: The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and the sun was allowed to scorch people with fire.
verses.textEnEsv: The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was allowed to scorch people with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and power was given to him to scorch men with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, causing it to scorch everyone with its fire.
verses.textEnNasb: And the fourth angel poured out his bowl upon the sun, and it was given power to scorch people with fire.
verses.textEn: The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and the sun was allowed to scorch people with fire.

verses.textZh: 人被高热烧烤，就亵渎那有权柄掌管这些灾难的神的名，并不悔改，把荣耀归给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人被高热烧烤，就亵渎那有权柄掌管这些灾难的神的名，并不悔改，把荣耀归给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 人被大热所烤，就亵渎那有权掌管这些灾的神之名，并不悔改将荣耀归给神。
verses.textEnNiv: They were seared by the intense heat and they cursed the name of God, who had control over these plagues, but they refused to repent and glorify him.
verses.textEnEsv: They were scorched by the fierce heat, and they cursed the name of God who had power over these plagues. They did not repent and give him glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: And men were scorched with great heat, and they blasphemed the name of God who has power over these plagues; and they did not repent and give Him glory.
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone was burned by this blast of heat, and they cursed the name of God, who had control over all these plagues. They did not repent of their sins and turn to God and give him glory.
verses.textEnNasb: And the people were scorched with fierce heat; and they blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues, and they did not repent so as to give Him glory.
verses.textEn: They were seared by the intense heat and they cursed the name of God, who had control over these plagues, but they refused to repent and glorify him.

verses.textZh: 第五位天使把碗倒在兽的座位上，兽的国就黑暗了。人因为痛苦就咬自己的舌头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第五位天使把碗倒在兽的座位上，兽的国就黑暗了。人因为痛苦就咬自己的舌头。
verses.textZhCuv: 第五位天使把碗倒在兽的座位上，兽的国就黑暗了。人因疼痛就咬自己的舌头；
verses.textEnNiv: The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness. People gnawed their tongues in agony
verses.textEnEsv: The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness. People gnawed their tongues in anguish
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom became full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues because of the pain.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was plunged into darkness. His subjects ground their teeth in anguish,
verses.textEnNasb: And the fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom became darkened; and they gnawed their tongues because of pain,
verses.textEn: The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness. People gnawed their tongues in agony

verses.textZh: 他们又因为所受的痛苦和所生的疮，亵渎天上的神，并不为自己所作的悔改。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又因为所受的痛苦和所生的疮，亵渎天上的神，并不为自己所作的悔改。
verses.textZhCuv: 又因所受的疼痛，和生的疮，就亵渎天上的神，并不悔改所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: and cursed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, but they refused to repent of what they had done.
verses.textEnEsv: and cursed the God of heaven for their pain and sores. They did not repent of their deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: They blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and did not repent of their deeds.
verses.textEnNlt: and they cursed the God of heaven for their pains and sores. But they did not repent of their evil deeds and turn to God.
verses.textEnNasb: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pain and their sores; and they did not repent of their deeds.
verses.textEn: and cursed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, but they refused to repent of what they had done.

verses.textZh: 第六位天使把碗倒在幼发拉底大河上，河水就干了，为了要给那些从东方来的王预备道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第六位天使把碗倒在幼发拉底大河上，河水就干了，为了要给那些从东方来的王预备道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 第六位天使把碗倒在幼发拉底大河上，河水就干了，要给那从日出之地所来的众王预备道路。
verses.textEnNiv: The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up to prepare the way for the kings from the East.
verses.textEnEsv: The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up, to prepare the way for the kings from the east.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up, so that the way of the kings from the east might be prepared.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it dried up so that the kings from the east could march their armies toward the west without hindrance.
verses.textEnNasb: The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates; and its water was dried up, so that the way would be prepared for the kings from the east.
verses.textEn: The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up to prepare the way for the kings from the East.

verses.textZh: 我看见三个污灵，好象青蛙从龙口、兽口和假先知的口中出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见三个污灵，好象青蛙从龙口、兽口和假先知的口中出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见三个污秽的灵，好像青蛙，从龙口、兽口并假先知的口中出来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I saw three impure spirits that looked like frogs; they came out of the mouth of the dragon, out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
verses.textEnEsv: And I saw, coming out of the mouth of the dragon and out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits like frogs.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs coming out of the mouth of the dragon, out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
verses.textEnNlt: And I saw three evil spirits that looked like frogs leap from the mouths of the dragon, the beast, and the false prophet.
verses.textEnNasb: And I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits like frogs;
verses.textEn: Then I saw three impure spirits that looked like frogs; they came out of the mouth of the dragon, out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet.

verses.textZh: 他们原是鬼魔的灵，施行奇事；牠们到普天下的众王那里去，叫他们在全能神的大日聚集作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们原是鬼魔的灵，施行奇事；牠们到普天下的众王那里去，叫他们在全能神的大日聚集作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们本是鬼魔的灵，施行奇事，出去到普天下众王那里，叫他们在神全能者的大日聚集争战。
verses.textEnNiv: They are demonic spirits that perform signs, and they go out to the kings of the whole world, to gather them for the battle on the great day of God Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: For they are demonic spirits, performing signs, who go abroad to the kings of the whole world, to assemble them for battle on the great day of God the Almighty.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.
verses.textEnNlt: They are demonic spirits who work miracles and go out to all the rulers of the world to gather them for battle against the Lord on that great judgment day of God the Almighty.
verses.textEnNasb: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the entire world, to gather them together for the war of the great day of God, the Almighty.
verses.textEn: They are demonic spirits that perform signs, and they go out to the kings of the whole world, to gather them for the battle on the great day of God Almighty.

verses.textZh: <red>污灵就把众王聚集在一个地方，希伯来话叫哈米吉多顿。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>污灵就把众王聚集在一个地方，希伯来话叫哈米吉多顿。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>看哪，我来像贼一样。那警醒、看守衣服、免得赤身而行、叫人见他羞耻的有福了！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Look, I come like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake and remains clothed, so as not to go naked and be shamefully exposed.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: ("Behold, I am coming like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake, keeping his garments on, that he may not go about naked and be seen exposed!")
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I am coming as a thief. Blessed is he who watches, and keeps his garments, lest he walk naked and they see his shame."
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, I will come as unexpectedly as a thief! Blessed are all who are watching for me, who keep their clothing ready so they will not have to walk around naked and ashamed."
verses.textEnNasb: ("Behold, I am coming like a thief. Blessed is the one who stays awake and keeps his clothes, so that he will not walk about naked and people will not see his shame.")
verses.textEn: <red>“Look, I come like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake and remains clothed, so as not to go naked and be shamefully exposed.”</red>

verses.textZh: 第七位天使把碗倒在空中，就有大声音从圣所的宝座上发出来，说："成了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 第七位天使把碗倒在空中，就有大声音从圣所的宝座上发出来，说："成了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 那三个鬼魔便叫众王聚集在一处，希伯来话叫作哈米吉多顿。
