verses.textEnNiv: Then they gathered the kings together to the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.
verses.textEnEsv: And they assembled them at the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they gathered them together to the place called in Hebrew, Armageddon.
verses.textEnNlt: And the demonic spirits gathered all the rulers and their armies to a place with the Hebrew name Armageddon.
verses.textEnNasb: And they gathered them together to the place which in Hebrew is called Har-Magedon.
verses.textEn: Then they gathered the kings together to the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.

verses.textZh: 于是有闪电、响声、雷轰和大地震，自从地上有人以来，没发生过这么大的地震，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是有闪电、响声、雷轰和大地震，自从地上有人以来，没发生过这么大的地震，
verses.textZhCuv: 第七位天使把碗倒在空中，就有大声音从殿中的宝座上出来，说：「成了！」
verses.textEnNiv: The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and out of the temple came a loud voice from the throne, saying, "It is done!"
verses.textEnEsv: The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and a loud voice came out of the temple, from the throne, saying, "It is done!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and a loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, "It is done!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air. And a mighty shout came from the throne in the Temple, saying, "It is finished!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the seventh angel poured out his bowl upon the air, and a loud voice came out of the temple from the throne, saying, "It is done."
verses.textEn: The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and out of the temple came a loud voice from the throne, saying, "It is done!"

verses.textZh: 那大城裂为三段，列国的城也都倒塌了。神也想起巴比伦大城来，要把自己烈怒的酒杯递给它。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那大城裂为三段，列国的城也都倒塌了。神也想起巴比伦大城来，要把自己烈怒的酒杯递给它。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有闪电、声音、雷轰、大地震，自从地上有人以来，没有这样大、这样厉害的地震。
verses.textEnNiv: Then there came flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder and a severe earthquake. No earthquake like it has ever occurred since mankind has been on earth, so tremendous was the quake.
verses.textEnEsv: And there were flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, and a great earthquake such as there had never been since man was on the earth, so great was that earthquake.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there were noises and thunderings and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such a mighty and great earthquake as had not occurred since men were on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the thunder crashed and rolled, and lightning flashed. And a great earthquake struck—the worst since people were placed on the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: And there were flashes of lightning and sounds and peals of thunder; and there was a great earthquake, such as there had not been since mankind came to be upon the earth, so great an earthquake was it, and so mighty.
verses.textEn: Then there came flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder and a severe earthquake. No earthquake like it has ever occurred since mankind has been on earth, so tremendous was the quake.

verses.textZh: 各海岛都逃避了，众山也不见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 各海岛都逃避了，众山也不见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那大城裂为三段，列国的城也都倒塌了；神也想起巴比伦大城来，要把那盛自己烈怒的酒杯递给他。
verses.textEnNiv: The great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. God remembered Babylon the Great and gave her the cup filled with the wine of the fury of his wrath.
verses.textEnEsv: The great city was split into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell, and God remembered Babylon the great, to make her drain the cup of the wine of the fury of his wrath.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. And great Babylon was remembered before God, to give her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of His wrath.
verses.textEnNlt: The great city of Babylon split into three sections, and the cities of many nations fell into heaps of rubble. So God remembered all of Babylon’s sins, and he made her drink the cup that was filled with the wine of his fierce wrath.
verses.textEnNasb: The great city was split into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give her the cup of the wine of His fierce wrath.
verses.textEn: The great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. God remembered Babylon the Great and gave her the cup filled with the wine of the fury of his wrath.

verses.textZh: 有大冰雹从天上落在人的身上，每块重约四十公斤。由于这冰雹的灾，人就亵渎神，因为这灾太严重了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有大冰雹从天上落在人的身上，每块重约四十公斤。由于这冰雹的灾，人就亵渎神，因为这灾太严重了。
verses.textZhCuv: 各海岛都逃避了，众山也不见了。
verses.textEnNiv: Every island fled away and the mountains could not be found.
verses.textEnEsv: And every island fled away, and no mountains were to be found.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
verses.textEnNlt: And every island disappeared, and all the mountains were leveled.
verses.textEnNasb: And every island fled, and no mountains were found.
verses.textEn: Every island fled away and the mountains could not be found.

verses.textZh: 又有大雹子从天落在人身上，每一个约重一他连得 。为这雹子的灾极大，人就亵渎神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有大雹子从天落在人身上，每一个约重一他连得 。为这雹子的灾极大，人就亵渎神。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有大雹子从天落在人身上，每一个约重一他连得 。为这雹子的灾极大，人就亵渎神。
verses.textEnNiv: From the sky huge hailstones, each weighing about a hundred pounds, fell on people. And they cursed God on account of the plague of hail, because the plague was so terrible.
verses.textEnEsv: And great hailstones, about one hundred pounds each, fell from heaven on people; and they cursed God for the plague of the hail, because the plague was so severe.
verses.textEnNkjv: And great hail from heaven fell upon men, eachhailstone about the weight of a talent. Men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, since that plague was exceedingly great.
verses.textEnNlt: There was a terrible hailstorm, and hailstones weighing as much as seventy-five pounds fell from the sky onto the people below. They cursed God because of the terrible plague of the hailstorm.
verses.textEnNasb: And huge hailstones, weighing about a talent each, *came down from heaven upon people; and people blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, because the hailstone plague *was extremely severe.
verses.textEn: From the sky huge hailstones, each weighing about a hundred pounds, fell on people. And they cursed God on account of the plague of hail, because the plague was so terrible.

verses.textZh: 拿着七碗的七位天使中，有一位来跟我讲话，说："你来，我要把那坐在众水之上的大淫妇所要受的审判指示你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿着七碗的七位天使中，有一位来跟我讲话，说："你来，我要把那坐在众水之上的大淫妇所要受的审判指示你。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿着七碗的七位天使中，有一位前来对我说：「你到这里来，我将坐在众水上的大淫妇所要受的刑罚指给你看。
verses.textEnNiv: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and said to me, "Come, I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits by many waters.
verses.textEnEsv: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and said to me, "Come, I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who is seated on many waters,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and talked with me, saying to me, "Come, I will show you the judgment of the great harlot who sits on many waters,
verses.textEnNlt: One of the seven angels who had poured out the seven bowls came over and spoke to me. "Come with me," he said, "and I will show you the judgment that is going to come on the great prostitute, who rules over many waters.
verses.textEnNasb: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, "Come here, I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,
verses.textEn: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and said to me, "Come, I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits by many waters.

verses.textZh: 地上的众王都跟她行过淫，住在地上的人也都喝她淫乱的酒醉了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 地上的众王都跟她行过淫，住在地上的人也都喝她淫乱的酒醉了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 地上的君王与她行淫，住在地上的人喝醉了她淫乱的酒。」
verses.textEnNiv: With her the kings of the earth committed adultery, and the inhabitants of the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her adulteries."
verses.textEnEsv: with whom the kings of the earth have committed sexual immorality, and with the wine of whose sexual immorality the dwellers on earth have become drunk."
verses.textEnNkjv: with whom the kings of the earth committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth were made drunk with the wine of her fornication."
verses.textEnNlt: The kings of the world have committed adultery with her, and the people who belong to this world have been made drunk by the wine of her immorality."
verses.textEnNasb: with whom the kings of the earth committed acts of sexual immorality, and those who live on the earth became drunk with the wine of her sexual immorality."
verses.textEn: With her the kings of the earth committed adultery, and the inhabitants of the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her adulteries."

verses.textZh: 我在灵里被天使带到旷野去，看见一个妇人，骑着朱红色的兽，这兽布满了亵渎的名号，有七头十角。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在灵里被天使带到旷野去，看见一个妇人，骑着朱红色的兽，这兽布满了亵渎的名号，有七头十角。
verses.textZhCuv: 我被圣灵感动，天使带我到旷野去，我就看见一个女人骑在朱红色的兽上；那兽有七头十角，遍体有亵渎的名号。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. There I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names and had seven heads and ten horns.
verses.textEnEsv: And he carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness, and I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was full of blasphemous names, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he carried me away in the Spirit into the wilderness. And I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast whichwas full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
verses.textEnNlt: So the angel took me in the Spirit into the wilderness. There I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that had seven heads and ten horns, and blasphemies against God were written all over it.
verses.textEnNasb: And he carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness; and I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.
verses.textEn: Then the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. There I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names and had seven heads and ten horns.

verses.textZh: 那妇人穿著紫色和朱红色的衣服，佩戴着金子、宝石和珍珠的装饰，手里拿着金杯，盛满了可憎的物，和她淫乱的污秽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那妇人穿著紫色和朱红色的衣服，佩戴着金子、宝石和珍珠的装饰，手里拿着金杯，盛满了可憎的物，和她淫乱的污秽。
verses.textZhCuv: 那女人穿着紫色和朱红色的衣服，用金子、宝石、珍珠为妆饰；手拿金杯，杯中盛满了可憎之物，就是她淫乱的污秽。
verses.textEnNiv: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and was glittering with gold, precious stones and pearls. She held a golden cup in her hand, filled with abominable things and the filth of her adulteries.
verses.textEnEsv: The woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and jewels and pearls, holding in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of her sexual immorality.
verses.textEnNkjv: The woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the filthiness of her fornication.
verses.textEnNlt: The woman wore purple and scarlet clothing and beautiful jewelry made of gold and precious gems and pearls. In her hand she held a gold goblet full of obscenities and the impurities of her immorality.
verses.textEnNasb: The woman was clothed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold, precious stones, and pearls, holding in her hand a gold cup full of abominations and of the unclean things of her sexual immorality,
verses.textEn: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and was glittering with gold, precious stones and pearls. She held a golden cup in her hand, filled with abominable things and the filth of her adulteries.

verses.textZh: 她额上写着一个名号："奥秘，大巴比伦，地上的淫妇和可憎的物之母。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她额上写着一个名号："奥秘，大巴比伦，地上的淫妇和可憎的物之母。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在她额上有名写着说：「奥秘哉！大巴比伦，作世上的淫妇和一切可憎之物的母。」
verses.textEnNiv: The name written on her forehead was a mystery: babylon the great the mother of prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: And on her forehead was written a name of mystery: "Babylon the great, mother of prostitutes and of earth’s abominations."
verses.textEnNkjv: And on her forehead a name was written: MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
verses.textEnNlt: A mysterious name was written on her forehead: "Babylon the Great, Mother of All Prostitutes and Obscenities in the World."
verses.textEnNasb: and on her forehead a name was written, a mystery: "BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH."
verses.textEn: The name written on her forehead was a mystery: babylon the great the mother of prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth.

verses.textZh: 我又看见那妇人喝圣徒的血，和那为耶稣作见证的人的血，喝醉了。 我看见了她，就大大惊奇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见那妇人喝圣徒的血，和那为耶稣作见证的人的血，喝醉了。 我看见了她，就大大惊奇。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见那女人喝醉了圣徒的血和为耶稣作见证之人的血。 我看见她，就大大地希奇。
verses.textEnNiv: I saw that the woman was drunk with the blood of God’s holy people, the blood of those who bore testimony to Jesus. When I saw her, I was greatly astonished.
verses.textEnEsv: And I saw the woman, drunk with the blood of the saints, the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I marveled greatly.
verses.textEnNkjv: I saw the woman, drunk with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. And when I saw her, I marveled with great amazement.
verses.textEnNlt: I could see that she was drunk—drunk with the blood of God’s holy people who were witnesses for Jesus. I stared at her in complete amazement.
verses.textEnNasb: And I saw the woman drunk with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the witnesses of Jesus. When I saw her, I wondered greatly.
verses.textEn: I saw that the woman was drunk with the blood of God’s holy people, the blood of those who bore testimony to Jesus. When I saw her, I was greatly astonished.

verses.textZh: 天使对我说："你为甚么惊奇呢？我要把这妇人的奥秘，和驮着她的那七头十角的兽的奥秘告诉你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天使对我说："你为甚么惊奇呢？我要把这妇人的奥秘，和驮着她的那七头十角的兽的奥秘告诉你。
verses.textZhCuv: 天使对我说：「你为什么希奇呢？我要将这女人和驮着她的那七头十角兽的奥秘告诉你。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel said to me: "Why are you astonished? I will explain to you the mystery of the woman and of the beast she rides, which has the seven heads and ten horns.
verses.textEnEsv: But the angel said to me, "Why do you marvel? I will tell you the mystery of the woman, and of the beast with seven heads and ten horns that carries her.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the angel said to me, "Why did you marvel? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.
verses.textEnNlt: "Why are you so amazed?" the angel asked. "I will tell you the mystery of this woman and of the beast with seven heads and ten horns on which she sits.
verses.textEnNasb: And the angel said to me, "Why do you wonder? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.
verses.textEn: Then the angel said to me: "Why are you astonished? I will explain to you the mystery of the woman and of the beast she rides, which has the seven heads and ten horns.

verses.textZh: 你看见的那兽，先前在、现今不在、将来要从无底坑上来，然后走向灭亡。住在世上的人，凡是名字在创世以来没有记在生命册上的，看见了那先前在、现今不在、将来还要出现的兽，就都要惊奇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看见的那兽，先前在、现今不在、将来要从无底坑上来，然后走向灭亡。住在世上的人，凡是名字在创世以来没有记在生命册上的，看见了那先前在、现今不在、将来还要出现的兽，就都要惊奇。
verses.textZhCuv: 你所看见的兽，先前有，如今没有，将要从无底坑里上来，又要归于沉沦。凡住在地上、名字从创世以来没有记在生命册上的，见先前有、如今没有、以后再有的兽，就必希奇。
verses.textEnNiv: The beast, which you saw, once was, now is not, and yet will come up out of the Abyss and go to its destruction. The inhabitants of the earth whose names have not been written in the book of life from the creation of the world will be astonished when they see the beast, because it once was, now is not, and yet will come.
verses.textEnEsv: The beast that you saw was, and is not, and is about to rise from the bottomless pit and go to destruction. And the dwellers on earth whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel to see the beast, because it was and is not and is to come.
verses.textEnNkjv: The beast that you saw was, and is not, and will ascend out of the bottomless pit and go to perdition. And those who dwell on the earth will marvel, whose names are not written in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world, when they see the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.
verses.textEnNlt: The beast you saw was once alive but isn’t now. And yet he will soon come up out of the bottomless pit and go to eternal destruction. And the people who belong to this world, whose names were not written in the Book of Life before the world was made, will be amazed at the reappearance of this beast who had died.
verses.textEnNasb: "The beast that you saw was, and is not, and is about to come up out of the abyss and go to destruction. And those who live on the earth, whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, will wonder when they see the beast, that he was, and is not, and will come.
verses.textEn: The beast, which you saw, once was, now is not, and yet will come up out of the Abyss and go to its destruction. The inhabitants of the earth whose names have not been written in the book of life from the creation of the world will be astonished when they see the beast, because it once was, now is not, and yet will come.

verses.textZh: 在这里需要有智慧的心。七头就是那妇人所坐的七座山，
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这里需要有智慧的心。七头就是那妇人所坐的七座山，
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧的心在此可以思想。那七头就是女人所坐的七座山，
verses.textEnNiv: "This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven hills on which the woman sits.
verses.textEnEsv: This calls for a mind with wisdom: the seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman is seated;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Here is the mind which has wisdom: The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
verses.textEnNlt: "This calls for a mind with understanding: The seven heads of the beast represent the seven hills where the woman rules. They also represent seven kings.
verses.textEnNasb: Here is the mind which has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains upon which the woman sits,
verses.textEn: "This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven hills on which the woman sits.

verses.textZh: 也就是七位王：五位已经倒了，一位还在，另一位还没有来到；他来的时候，必须存留一会儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也就是七位王：五位已经倒了，一位还在，另一位还没有来到；他来的时候，必须存留一会儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 又是七位王；五位已经倾倒了，一位还在，一位还没有来到；他来的时候，必须暂时存留。
verses.textEnNiv: They are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, the other has not yet come; but when he does come, he must remain for only a little while.
verses.textEnEsv: they are also seven kings, five of whom have fallen, one is, the other has not yet come, and when he does come he must remain only a little while.
verses.textEnNkjv: There are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come. And when he comes, he must continue a short time.
verses.textEnNlt: Five kings have already fallen, the sixth now reigns, and the seventh is yet to come, but his reign will be brief.
verses.textEnNasb: and they are seven kings; five have fallen, one is, the other has not yet come; and when he comes, he must remain a little while.
verses.textEn: They are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, the other has not yet come; but when he does come, he must remain for only a little while.

verses.textZh: 那先前在、现今不在的兽，就是第八位。他也是出于那七位中的一位的，并且正在走向灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那先前在、现今不在的兽，就是第八位。他也是出于那七位中的一位的，并且正在走向灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 那先前有如今没有的兽，就是第八位；他也和那七位同列，并且归于沉沦。
verses.textEnNiv: The beast who once was, and now is not, is an eighth king. He belongs to the seven and is going to his destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the beast that was and is not, it is an eighth but it belongs to the seven, and it goes to destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also the eighth, and is of the seven, and is going to perdition.
verses.textEnNlt: "The scarlet beast that was, but is no longer, is the eighth king. He is like the other seven, and he, too, is headed for destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: The beast which was, and is not, is himself also an eighth and is one of the seven, and he goes to destruction.
verses.textEn: The beast who once was, and now is not, is an eighth king. He belongs to the seven and is going to his destruction.

verses.textZh: 你看见的那十角，就是十王，他们还没有取得王权；但要跟兽一同得着权柄，作王一个时期。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看见的那十角，就是十王，他们还没有取得王权；但要跟兽一同得着权柄，作王一个时期。
verses.textZhCuv: 你所看见的那十角就是十王；他们还没有得国，但他们一时之间要和兽同得权柄，与王一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but who for one hour will receive authority as kings along with the beast.
verses.textEnEsv: And the ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have not yet received royal power, but they are to receive authority as kings for one hour, together with the beast.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The ten horns which you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority for one hour as kings with the beast.
verses.textEnNlt: The ten horns of the beast are ten kings who have not yet risen to power. They will be appointed to their kingdoms for one brief moment to reign with the beast.
verses.textEnNasb: The ten horns which you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but they receive authority as kings with the beast for one hour.
verses.textEn: "The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but who for one hour will receive authority as kings along with the beast.

verses.textZh: 他们同心合意，把自己的权力权柄交给那兽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们同心合意，把自己的权力权柄交给那兽。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们同心合意将自己的能力、权柄给那兽。
verses.textEnNiv: They have one purpose and will give their power and authority to the beast.
verses.textEnEsv: These are of one mind, and they hand over their power and authority to the beast.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are of one mind, and they will give their power and authority to the beast.
verses.textEnNlt: They will all agree to give him their power and authority.
verses.textEnNasb: These have one purpose, and they give their power and authority to the beast.
verses.textEn: They have one purpose and will give their power and authority to the beast.

verses.textZh: 他们要跟羊羔作战，羊羔必胜过他们，因为他是万主之主，万王之王。那些与羊羔同在、蒙召、被选、有忠心的，也必胜过他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要跟羊羔作战，羊羔必胜过他们，因为他是万主之主，万王之王。那些与羊羔同在、蒙召、被选、有忠心的，也必胜过他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们与羔羊争战，羔羊必胜过他们，因为羔羊是万主之主、万王之王。同着羔羊的，就是蒙召、被选、有忠心的，也必得胜。」
verses.textEnNiv: They will wage war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will triumph over them because he is Lord of lords and King of kings—and with him will be his called, chosen and faithful followers."
verses.textEnEsv: They will make war on the Lamb, and the Lamb will conquer them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings, and those with him are called and chosen and faithful."
verses.textEnNkjv: These will make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those whoare with Him are called, chosen, and faithful."
verses.textEnNlt: Together they will go to war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will defeat them because he is Lord of all lords and King of all kings. And his called and chosen and faithful ones will be with him."
verses.textEnNasb: These will wage war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them because He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with Him are the called and chosen and faithful."
verses.textEn: They will wage war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will triumph over them because he is Lord of lords and King of kings—and with him will be his called, chosen and faithful followers."

verses.textZh: 天使又对我说："你所看见那淫妇坐着的众水，就是多种民族、群众、邦国，方言的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天使又对我说："你所看见那淫妇坐着的众水，就是多种民族、群众、邦国，方言的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 天使又对我说：「你所看见那淫妇坐的众水，就是多民、多人、多国、多方。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel said to me, "The waters you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations and languages.
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel said to me, "The waters that you saw, where the prostitute is seated, are peoples and multitudes and nations and languages.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to me, "The waters which you saw, where the harlot sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and tongues.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel said to me, "The waters where the prostitute is ruling represent masses of people of every nation and language.
verses.textEnNasb: And he *said to me, "The waters which you saw where the prostitute sits are peoples and multitudes, and nations and languages.
verses.textEn: Then the angel said to me, "The waters you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations and languages.

verses.textZh: 你看见的十角和那兽，都要恨那淫妇，使她荒凉赤身，又要吃她的肉，用火把她烧掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看见的十角和那兽，都要恨那淫妇，使她荒凉赤身，又要吃她的肉，用火把她烧掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 你所看见的那十角与兽必恨这淫妇，使她冷落赤身，又要吃她的肉，用火将她烧尽。
verses.textEnNiv: The beast and the ten horns you saw will hate the prostitute. They will bring her to ruin and leave her naked; they will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.
verses.textEnEsv: And the ten horns that you saw, they and the beast will hate the prostitute. They will make her desolate and naked, and devour her flesh and burn her up with fire,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the ten horns which you saw on the beast, these will hate the harlot, make her desolate and naked, eat her flesh and burn her with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: The scarlet beast and his ten horns all hate the prostitute. They will strip her naked, eat her flesh, and burn her remains with fire.
verses.textEnNasb: And the ten horns which you saw, and the beast, these will hate the prostitute and will make her desolate and naked, and will eat her flesh and will burn her up with fire.
verses.textEn: The beast and the ten horns you saw will hate the prostitute. They will bring her to ruin and leave her naked; they will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.

verses.textZh: 神要众王行他的旨意，就把意念放在他们心中，叫他们同心把自己的国献给那兽，直到神的话都实现为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神要众王行他的旨意，就把意念放在他们心中，叫他们同心把自己的国献给那兽，直到神的话都实现为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神使诸王同心合意，遵行他的旨意，把自己的国给那兽，直等到神的话都应验了。
verses.textEnNiv: For God has put it into their hearts to accomplish his purpose by agreeing to hand over to the beast their royal authority, until God’s words are fulfilled.
verses.textEnEsv: for God has put it into their hearts to carry out his purpose by being of one mind and handing over their royal power to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
verses.textEnNkjv: For God has put it into their hearts to fulfill His purpose, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
verses.textEnNlt: For God has put a plan into their minds, a plan that will carry out his purposes. They will agree to give their authority to the scarlet beast, and so the words of God will be fulfilled.
verses.textEnNasb: For God has put it in their hearts to execute His purpose by having a common purpose, and by giving their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God will be fulfilled.
verses.textEn: For God has put it into their hearts to accomplish his purpose by agreeing to hand over to the beast their royal authority, until God’s words are fulfilled.

verses.textZh: 你看见的那妇人，就是有权统治地上的众王的那座大城。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看见的那妇人，就是有权统治地上的众王的那座大城。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你所看见的那女人就是管辖地上众王的大城。」
verses.textEnNiv: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: And the woman that you saw is the great city that has dominion over the kings of the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the woman whom you saw is that great city which reigns over the kings of the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: And this woman you saw in your vision represents the great city that rules over the kings of the world."
verses.textEnNasb: The woman whom you saw is the great city, which reigns over the kings of the earth."
verses.textEn: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth."

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，我看见有另一位掌大权柄的天使，从天上降下来，他的荣光照亮了大地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，我看见有另一位掌大权柄的天使，从天上降下来，他的荣光照亮了大地。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，我看见另有一位有大权柄的天使从天降下，地就因他的荣耀发光。
verses.textEnNiv: After this I saw another angel coming down from heaven. He had great authority, and the earth was illuminated by his splendor.
verses.textEnEsv: After this I saw another angel coming down from heaven, having great authority, and the earth was made bright with his glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: After these things I saw another angel coming down from heaven, having great authority, and the earth was illuminated with his glory.
verses.textEnNlt: After all this I saw another angel come down from heaven with great authority, and the earth grew bright with his splendor.
verses.textEnNasb: After these things I saw another angel coming down from heaven, having great authority, and the earth was illuminated from his glory.
verses.textEn: After this I saw another angel coming down from heaven. He had great authority, and the earth was illuminated by his splendor.

verses.textZh: 他用强有力的声音呼喊说： "倾倒了！大巴比伦倾倒了！ 成了鬼魔的住处， 各样污灵的监狱， 一切污秽可憎之雀鸟的牢笼，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用强有力的声音呼喊说： "倾倒了！大巴比伦倾倒了！ 成了鬼魔的住处， 各样污灵的监狱， 一切污秽可憎之雀鸟的牢笼，
verses.textZhCuv: 他大声喊着说： 巴比伦大城倾倒了！倾倒了！ 成了鬼魔的住处 和各样污秽之灵的巢穴 ， 并各样污秽可憎之雀鸟的巢穴。
verses.textEnNiv: With a mighty voice he shouted: " ‘Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the Great!’ She has become a dwelling for demons and a haunt for every impure spirit, a haunt for every unclean bird, a haunt for every unclean and detestable animal.
verses.textEnEsv: And he called out with a mighty voice, "Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a dwelling place for demons, a haunt for every unclean spirit, a haunt for every unclean bird, a haunt for every unclean and detestable beast.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he cried mightily with a loud voice, saying, "Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and has become a dwelling place of demons, a prison for every foul spirit, and a cage for every unclean and hated bird!
verses.textEnNlt: He gave a mighty shout: "Babylon is fallen—that great city is fallen! She has become a home for demons. She is a hideout for every foul spirit, a hideout for every foul vulture and every foul and dreadful animal.
verses.textEnNasb: And he cried out with a mighty voice, saying, " Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a dwelling place of demons and a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hateful bird.
verses.textEn: With a mighty voice he shouted: " ‘Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the Great!’ She has become a dwelling for demons and a haunt for every impure spirit, a haunt for every unclean bird, a haunt for every unclean and detestable animal.

verses.textZh: 因为各国都喝她淫乱烈怒的酒醉了； 地上的君王与她行淫， 世上的商人因她奢华挥霍就发了财。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为各国都喝她淫乱烈怒的酒醉了； 地上的君王与她行淫， 世上的商人因她奢华挥霍就发了财。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为列国都被她邪淫大怒的酒倾倒了。 地上的君王与她行淫； 地上的客商因她奢华太过就发了财。
verses.textEnNiv: For all the nations have drunk the maddening wine of her adulteries. The kings of the earth committed adultery with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from her excessive luxuries."
verses.textEnEsv: For all nations have drunk the wine of the passion of her sexual immorality, and the kings of the earth have committed immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth have grown rich from the power of her luxurious living."
verses.textEnNkjv: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth have become rich through the abundance of her luxury."
verses.textEnNlt: For all the nations have fallen because of the wine of her passionate immorality. The kings of the world have committed adultery with her. Because of her desires for extravagant luxury, the merchants of the world have grown rich."
verses.textEnNasb: For all the nations have fallen because of the wine of the passion of her sexual immorality, and the kings of the earth have committed acts of sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth have become rich from the excessive wealth of her luxury."
verses.textEn: For all the nations have drunk the maddening wine of her adulteries. The kings of the earth committed adultery with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from her excessive luxuries."

verses.textZh: 我听见另一个声音从天上来，说： "从那城出来吧，我的子民！ 免得在她的罪上有分， 受她所受的灾难；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见另一个声音从天上来，说： "从那城出来吧，我的子民！ 免得在她的罪上有分， 受她所受的灾难；
verses.textZhCuv: 我又听见从天上有声音说： 我的民哪，你们要从那城出来， 免得与她一同有罪，受她所受的灾殃；
verses.textEnNiv: Then I heard another voice from heaven say: " ‘Come out of her, my people,’ so that you will not share in her sins, so that you will not receive any of her plagues;
verses.textEnEsv: Then I heard another voice from heaven saying, "Come out of her, my people, lest you take part in her sins, lest you share in her plagues;
verses.textEnNkjv: And I heard another voice from heaven saying, "Come out of her, my people, lest you share in her sins, and lest you receive of her plagues.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I heard another voice calling from heaven, "Come away from her, my people. Do not take part in her sins, or you will be punished with her.
verses.textEnNasb: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, "Come out of her, my people, so that you will not participate in her sins and receive any of her plagues;
verses.textEn: Then I heard another voice from heaven say: " ‘Come out of her, my people,’ so that you will not share in her sins, so that you will not receive any of her plagues;

verses.textZh: 因为她的罪恶滔天，神已经想起她的不义来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为她的罪恶滔天，神已经想起她的不义来。
verses.textZhCuv: 因她的罪恶滔天； 她的不义，神已经想起来了。
verses.textEnNiv: for her sins are piled up to heaven, and God has remembered her crimes.
verses.textEnEsv: for her sins are heaped high as heaven, and God has remembered her iniquities.
verses.textEnNkjv: For her sins have reached to heaven, and God has remembered her iniquities.
verses.textEnNlt: For her sins are piled as high as heaven, and God remembers her evil deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: for her sins have piled up as high as heaven, and God has remembered her offenses.
verses.textEn: for her sins are piled up to heaven, and God has remembered her crimes.

verses.textZh: 她怎样待人，你们也要怎样待她； 照着她所作的，加倍报应她； 用她调酒的杯，加倍调给她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她怎样待人，你们也要怎样待她； 照着她所作的，加倍报应她； 用她调酒的杯，加倍调给她。
verses.textZhCuv: 她怎样待人，也要怎样待她， 按她所行的加倍地报应她； 用她调酒的杯加倍地调给她喝。
verses.textEnNiv: Give back to her as she has given; pay her back double for what she has done. Pour her a double portion from her own cup.
verses.textEnEsv: Pay her back as she herself has paid back others, and repay her double for her deeds; mix a double portion for her in the cup she mixed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Render to her just as she rendered to you, and repay her double according to her works; in the cup which she has mixed, mix double for her.
verses.textEnNlt: Do to her as she has done to others. Double her penalty for all her evil deeds. She brewed a cup of terror for others, so brew twice as much for her.
verses.textEnNasb: Pay her back even as she has paid, and give back to her double according to her deeds; in the cup which she has mixed, mix twice as much for her.
verses.textEn: Give back to her as she has given; pay her back double for what she has done. Pour her a double portion from her own cup.

verses.textZh: 她怎样炫耀自己，怎样奢华挥霍， 你们也要怎样给她痛苦悲哀。 因为她心里常常说： ‘我坐著作女王， 我不是寡妇， 决不会看见悲哀。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 她怎样炫耀自己，怎样奢华挥霍， 你们也要怎样给她痛苦悲哀。 因为她心里常常说： ‘我坐著作女王， 我不是寡妇， 决不会看见悲哀。’
verses.textZhCuv: 她怎样荣耀自己，怎样奢华， 也当叫她照样痛苦悲哀， 因她心里说： 我坐了皇后的位， 并不是寡妇， 决不至于悲哀。
verses.textEnNiv: Give her as much torment and grief as the glory and luxury she gave herself. In her heart she boasts, ‘I sit enthroned as queen. I am not a widow; I will never mourn.’
verses.textEnEsv: As she glorified herself and lived in luxury, so give her a like measure of torment and mourning, since in her heart she says, ‘I sit as a queen, I am no widow, and mourning I shall never see.’
verses.textEnNkjv: In the measure that she glorified herself and lived luxuriously, in the same measure give her torment and sorrow; for she says in her heart, ‘I sit as queen, and am no widow, and will not see sorrow.’
verses.textEnNlt: She glorified herself and lived in luxury, so match it now with torment and sorrow. She boasted in her heart, ‘I am queen on my throne. I am no helpless widow, and I have no reason to mourn.’
verses.textEnNasb: To the extent that she glorified herself and lived luxuriously, to the same extent give her torment and mourning; for she says in her heart, ‘I sit as a queen and I am not a widow, and will never see mourning.’
verses.textEn: Give her as much torment and grief as the glory and luxury she gave herself. In her heart she boasts, ‘I sit enthroned as queen. I am not a widow; I will never mourn.’

verses.textZh: 因此，在一日之内她的灾难必然来到， 就是死亡、悲哀和饥荒； 她还要在火中被烧掉， 因为审判她的主神是大有能力的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，在一日之内她的灾难必然来到， 就是死亡、悲哀和饥荒； 她还要在火中被烧掉， 因为审判她的主神是大有能力的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以在一天之内， 她的灾殃要一齐来到， 就是死亡、悲哀、饥荒。 她又要被火烧尽了， 因为审判她的主神大有能力。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore in one day her plagues will overtake her: death, mourning and famine. She will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judges her.
verses.textEnEsv: For this reason her plagues will come in a single day, death and mourning and famine, and she will be burned up with fire; for mighty is the Lord God who has judged her."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore her plagues will come in one day—death and mourning and famine. And she will be utterly burned with fire, for strong is the Lord God who judges her.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, these plagues will overtake her in a single day— death and mourning and famine. She will be completely consumed by fire, for the Lord God who judges her is mighty."
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason in one day her plagues will come, plague and mourning and famine, and she will be burned up with fire; for the Lord God who judges her is strong.
verses.textEn: Therefore in one day her plagues will overtake her: death, mourning and famine. She will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judges her.

verses.textZh: "地上的众王，就是跟她一同行邪淫、骄奢无度的，看见焚烧她的烟的时候，就必为她痛哭捶胸。
verses.textZhCnvs: "地上的众王，就是跟她一同行邪淫、骄奢无度的，看见焚烧她的烟的时候，就必为她痛哭捶胸。
verses.textZhCuv: 地上的君王，素来与她行淫、一同奢华的，看见烧她的烟，就必为她哭泣哀号。
verses.textEnNiv: "When the kings of the earth who committed adultery with her and shared her luxury see the smoke of her burning, they will weep and mourn over her.
verses.textEnEsv: And the kings of the earth, who committed sexual immorality and lived in luxury with her, will weep and wail over her when they see the smoke of her burning.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The kings of the earth who committed fornication and lived luxuriously with her will weep and lament for her, when they see the smoke of her burning,
verses.textEnNlt: And the kings of the world who committed adultery with her and enjoyed her great luxury will mourn for her as they see the smoke rising from her charred remains.
verses.textEnNasb: "And the kings of the earth, who committed acts of sexual immorality and lived luxuriously with her, will weep and mourn over her when they see the smoke of her burning,
verses.textEn: "When the kings of the earth who committed adultery with her and shared her luxury see the smoke of her burning, they will weep and mourn over her.

verses.textZh: 他们因为害怕她所受的痛苦，就远远地站着，说： ‘有祸了！有祸了！这大城， 巴比伦，这坚固的城啊！ 一时之间你的审判就来到了！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们因为害怕她所受的痛苦，就远远地站着，说： ‘有祸了！有祸了！这大城， 巴比伦，这坚固的城啊！ 一时之间你的审判就来到了！’
verses.textZhCuv: 因怕她的痛苦，就远远地站着说：哀哉！哀哉！ 巴比伦大城，坚固的城啊， 一时之间你的刑罚就来到了。
verses.textEnNiv: Terrified at her torment, they will stand far off and cry: " ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, you mighty city of Babylon! In one hour your doom has come!’
verses.textEnEsv: They will stand far off, in fear of her torment, and say, "Alas! Alas! You great city, you mighty city, Babylon! For in a single hour your judgment has come."
verses.textEnNkjv: standing at a distance for fear of her torment, saying, ‘Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! For in one hour your judgment has come.’
verses.textEnNlt: They will stand at a distance, terrified by her great torment. They will cry out, "How terrible, how terrible for you, O Babylon, you great city! In a single moment God’s judgment came on you."
verses.textEnNasb: standing at a distance because of the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For in one hour your judgment has come.’
verses.textEn: Terrified at her torment, they will stand far off and cry: " ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, you mighty city of Babylon! In one hour your doom has come!’

verses.textZh: "地上的商人也为她悲哀痛哭，因为没有人再买他们的货物：
verses.textZhCnvs: "地上的商人也为她悲哀痛哭，因为没有人再买他们的货物：
verses.textZhCuv: 地上的客商也都为她哭泣悲哀，因为没有人再买他们的货物了；
verses.textEnNiv: "The merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her because no one buys their cargoes anymore—
verses.textEnEsv: And the merchants of the earth weep and mourn for her, since no one buys their cargo anymore,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And the merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise anymore:
verses.textEnNlt: The merchants of the world will weep and mourn for her, for there is no one left to buy their goods.
verses.textEnNasb: "And the merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, because no one buys their cargo any more—
verses.textEn: "The merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her because no one buys their cargoes anymore—

verses.textZh: 就是金、银、宝石、珍珠；细麻布、紫色布、丝绸、朱红色布；各样香木，各样象牙制品，各样极贵重的木器、铜器、铁器、大理石制品；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是金、银、宝石、珍珠；细麻布、紫色布、丝绸、朱红色布；各样香木，各样象牙制品，各样极贵重的木器、铜器、铁器、大理石制品；
verses.textZhCuv: 这货物就是金、银、宝石、珍珠、细麻布、紫色料、绸子、朱红色料、各样香木、各样象牙的器皿、各样极宝贵的木头，和铜、铁、汉白玉的器皿，
verses.textEnNiv: cargoes of gold, silver, precious stones and pearls; fine linen, purple, silk and scarlet cloth; every sort of citron wood, and articles of every kind made of ivory, costly wood, bronze, iron and marble;
verses.textEnEsv: cargo of gold, silver, jewels, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, silk, scarlet cloth, all kinds of scented wood, all kinds of articles of ivory, all kinds of articles of costly wood, bronze, iron and marble,
verses.textEnNkjv: merchandise of gold and silver, precious stones and pearls, fine linen and purple, silk and scarlet, every kind of citron wood, every kind of object of ivory, every kind of object of most precious wood, bronze, iron, and marble;
verses.textEnNlt: She bought great quantities of gold, silver, jewels, and pearls; fine linen, purple, silk, and scarlet cloth; things made of fragrant thyine wood, ivory goods, and objects made of expensive wood; and bronze, iron, and marble.
verses.textEnNasb: cargo of gold, silver, precious stones, and pearls; fine linen, purple, silk, and scarlet; every kind of citron wood, every article of ivory, and every article made from very valuable wood, bronze, iron, and marble;
verses.textEn: cargoes of gold, silver, precious stones and pearls; fine linen, purple, silk and scarlet cloth; every sort of citron wood, and articles of every kind made of ivory, costly wood, bronze, iron and marble;

verses.textZh: 肉桂、荳蔻、香料、香膏、乳香；酒、油、面粉、麦子；牛、羊、马、车、奴仆、人口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 肉桂、荳蔻、香料、香膏、乳香；酒、油、面粉、麦子；牛、羊、马、车、奴仆、人口。
verses.textZhCuv: 并肉桂、豆蔻、香料、香膏、乳香、酒、油、细面、麦子、牛、羊、车、马，和奴仆、人口。
verses.textEnNiv: cargoes of cinnamon and spice, of incense, myrrh and frankincense, of wine and olive oil, of fine flour and wheat; cattle and sheep; horses and carriages; and human beings sold as slaves.
verses.textEnEsv: cinnamon, spice, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle and sheep, horses and chariots, and slaves, that is, human souls.
verses.textEnNkjv: and cinnamon and incense, fragrant oil and frankincense, wine and oil, fine flour and wheat, cattle and sheep, horses and chariots, and bodies and souls of men.
verses.textEnNlt: She also bought cinnamon, spice, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, wagons, and bodies—that is, human slaves.
verses.textEnNasb: cinnamon, spice, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, and cargo of horses, carriages, slaves, and human lives.
verses.textEn: cargoes of cinnamon and spice, of incense, myrrh and frankincense, of wine and olive oil, of fine flour and wheat; cattle and sheep; horses and carriages; and human beings sold as slaves.

verses.textZh: 你所贪恋的果子离开你了！一切珍馐美味、华丽的美物，都从你那里消失，再也找不到了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所贪恋的果子离开你了！一切珍馐美味、华丽的美物，都从你那里消失，再也找不到了！
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦哪，你所贪爱的果子离开了你； 你一切的珍馐美味 和华美的物件也从你中间毁灭， 决不能再见了。
verses.textEnNiv: "They will say, ‘The fruit you longed for is gone from you. All your luxury and splendor have vanished, never to be recovered.’
verses.textEnEsv: "The fruit for which your soul longed has gone from you, and all your delicacies and your splendors are lost to you, never to be found again!"
verses.textEnNkjv: The fruit that your soul longed for has gone from you, and all the things which are rich and splendid have gone from you, and you shall find them no more at all.
verses.textEnNlt: "The fancy things you loved so much are gone," they cry. "All your luxuries and splendor are gone forever, never to be yours again."
verses.textEnNasb: The fruit you long for has left you, and all things that were luxurious and splendid have passed away from you and people will no longer find them.
verses.textEn: "They will say, ‘The fruit you longed for is gone from you. All your luxury and splendor have vanished, never to be recovered.’

verses.textZh: 贩卖这些货物，借着她发了财的商人，因为害怕她受的痛苦，就远远地站着，痛哭悲哀，
verses.textZhCnvs: 贩卖这些货物，借着她发了财的商人，因为害怕她受的痛苦，就远远地站着，痛哭悲哀，
verses.textZhCuv: 贩卖这些货物、藉着她发了财的客商，因怕她的痛苦，就远远地站着哭泣悲哀，说：
verses.textEnNiv: The merchants who sold these things and gained their wealth from her will stand far off, terrified at her torment. They will weep and mourn
verses.textEnEsv: The merchants of these wares, who gained wealth from her, will stand far off, in fear of her torment, weeping and mourning aloud,
verses.textEnNkjv: The merchants of these things, who became rich by her, will stand at a distance for fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,
verses.textEnNlt: The merchants who became wealthy by selling her these things will stand at a distance, terrified by her great torment. They will weep and cry out,
verses.textEnNasb: The merchants of these things, who became rich from her, will stand at a distance because of the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,
verses.textEn: The merchants who sold these things and gained their wealth from her will stand far off, terrified at her torment. They will weep and mourn

verses.textZh: 说： ‘有祸了！有祸了！这大城啊！ 就是一向穿著细麻布、 紫色、朱红色的衣服， 佩戴着金子、 宝石和珍珠装饰的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 说： ‘有祸了！有祸了！这大城啊！ 就是一向穿著细麻布、 紫色、朱红色的衣服， 佩戴着金子、 宝石和珍珠装饰的，
verses.textZhCuv: 哀哉！哀哉！这大城啊， 素常穿着细麻、 紫色、朱红色的衣服， 又用金子、宝石，和珍珠为妆饰。
verses.textEnNiv: and cry out: " ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, dressed in fine linen, purple and scarlet, and glittering with gold, precious stones and pearls!
verses.textEnEsv: "Alas, alas, for the great city that was clothed in fine linen, in purple and scarlet, adorned with gold, with jewels, and with pearls!
verses.textEnNkjv: and saying, ‘Alas, alas, that great city that was clothed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls!
verses.textEnNlt: "How terrible, how terrible for that great city! She was clothed in finest purple and scarlet linens, decked out with gold and precious stones and pearls!
verses.textEnNasb: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was clothed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold, precious stones, and pearls;
verses.textEn: and cry out: " ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, dressed in fine linen, purple and scarlet, and glittering with gold, precious stones and pearls!

verses.textZh: 一时之间，这么大的财富竟荡然无存！’ "所有船长、旅客、水手，以及凡是靠海谋生的，都远远地站着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一时之间，这么大的财富竟荡然无存！’ "所有船长、旅客、水手，以及凡是靠海谋生的，都远远地站着。
verses.textZhCuv: 一时之间，这么大的富厚就归于无有了。 凡船主和坐船往各处去的，并众水手，连所有靠海为业的，都远远地站着，
verses.textEnNiv: In one hour such great wealth has been brought to ruin!’ "Every sea captain, and all who travel by ship, the sailors, and all who earn their living from the sea, will stand far off.
verses.textEnEsv: For in a single hour all this wealth has been laid waste." And all shipmasters and seafaring men, sailors and all whose trade is on the sea, stood far off
verses.textEnNkjv: For in one hour such great riches came to nothing.’ Every shipmaster, all who travel by ship, sailors, and as many as trade on the sea, stood at a distance
verses.textEnNlt: In a single moment all the wealth of the city is gone!" And all the captains of the merchant ships and their passengers and sailors and crews will stand at a distance.
verses.textEnNasb: for in one hour such great wealth has been laid waste!’ And every shipmaster and every passenger and sailor, and all who make their living by the sea, stood at a distance,
verses.textEn: In one hour such great wealth has been brought to ruin!’ "Every sea captain, and all who travel by ship, the sailors, and all who earn their living from the sea, will stand far off.

verses.textZh: 他们看见了焚烧她的烟，就喊叫说：‘有哪一座城能与这大城相比呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们看见了焚烧她的烟，就喊叫说：‘有哪一座城能与这大城相比呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 看见烧她的烟，就喊着说：「有何城能比这大城呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: When they see the smoke of her burning, they will exclaim, ‘Was there ever a city like this great city?’
verses.textEnEsv: and cried out as they saw the smoke of her burning, "What city was like the great city?"
verses.textEnNkjv: and cried out when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like this great city?’
verses.textEnNlt: They will cry out as they watch the smoke ascend, and they will say, "Where is there another city as great as this?"
verses.textEnNasb: and were crying out as they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What city is like the great city?’
verses.textEn: When they see the smoke of her burning, they will exclaim, ‘Was there ever a city like this great city?’

verses.textZh: 他们又把尘土撒在自己头上，痛哭悲哀，喊着说： ‘有祸了！有祸了！这大城啊！ 凡是有船航行海上的， 都因这城的财宝发了财； 一时之间她竟成了荒场！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又把尘土撒在自己头上，痛哭悲哀，喊着说： ‘有祸了！有祸了！这大城啊！ 凡是有船航行海上的， 都因这城的财宝发了财； 一时之间她竟成了荒场！’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又把尘土撒在头上，哭泣悲哀，喊着说： 哀哉！哀哉！这大城啊。 凡有船在海中的，都因她的珍宝成了富足！ 她在一时之间就成了荒场！
verses.textEnNiv: They will throw dust on their heads, and with weeping and mourning cry out: " ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, where all who had ships on the sea became rich through her wealth! In one hour she has been brought to ruin!’
verses.textEnEsv: And they threw dust on their heads as they wept and mourned, crying out, "Alas, alas, for the great city where all who had ships at sea grew rich by her wealth! For in a single hour she has been laid waste.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They threw dust on their heads and cried out, weeping and wailing, and saying, ‘Alas, alas, that great city, in which all who had ships on the sea became rich by her wealth! For in one hour she is made desolate.’
verses.textEnNlt: And they will weep and throw dust on their heads to show their grief. And they will cry out, "How terrible, how terrible for that great city! The shipowners became wealthy by transporting her great wealth on the seas. In a single moment it is all gone."
verses.textEnNasb: And they threw dust on their heads and were crying out, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had ships at sea became rich from her prosperity, for in one hour she has been laid waste!’
verses.textEn: They will throw dust on their heads, and with weeping and mourning cry out: " ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, where all who had ships on the sea became rich through her wealth! In one hour she has been brought to ruin!’

verses.textZh: 天哪，你要因她欢喜！ 众圣徒、众使徒、众先知啊， 你们也要因她欢喜！ 因为神已经在她身上为你们伸了冤。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 天哪，你要因她欢喜！ 众圣徒、众使徒、众先知啊， 你们也要因她欢喜！ 因为神已经在她身上为你们伸了冤。"
verses.textZhCuv: 天哪，众圣徒、众使徒、众先知啊， 你们都要因她欢喜， 因为神已经在她身上伸了你们的冤。
verses.textEnNiv: "Rejoice over her, you heavens! Rejoice, you people of God! Rejoice, apostles and prophets! For God has judged her with the judgment she imposed on you."
verses.textEnEsv: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, for God has given judgment for you against her!"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you holy apostles and prophets, for God has avenged you on her!"
verses.textEnNlt: Rejoice over her fate, O heaven and people of God and apostles and prophets! For at last God has judged her for your sakes.
verses.textEnNasb: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced judgment for you against her."
verses.textEn: "Rejoice over her, you heavens! Rejoice, you people of God! Rejoice, apostles and prophets! For God has judged her with the judgment she imposed on you."

verses.textZh: 有一位大力的天使，把一块好象大磨石一样的石头，举起来拋在海里，说： "巴比伦大城也必这样被猛力地拋下去， 决不能再找到了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一位大力的天使，把一块好象大磨石一样的石头，举起来拋在海里，说： "巴比伦大城也必这样被猛力地拋下去， 决不能再找到了！
verses.textZhCuv: 有一位大力的天使举起一块石头，好像大磨石，扔在海里，说： 巴比伦大城也必这样猛力地被扔下去， 决不能再见了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then a mighty angel picked up a boulder the size of a large millstone and threw it into the sea, and said: "With such violence the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to be found again.
verses.textEnEsv: Then a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and threw it into the sea, saying, "So will Babylon the great city be thrown down with violence, and will be found no more;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and threw it into the sea, saying, "Thus with violence the great city Babylon shall be thrown down, and shall not be found anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: Then a mighty angel picked up a boulder the size of a huge millstone. He threw it into the ocean and shouted, "Just like this, the great city Babylon will be thrown down with violence and will never be found again.
verses.textEnNasb: Then a strong angel picked up a stone like a great millstone and threw it into the sea, saying, "So will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down with violence, and will never be found again.
verses.textEn: Then a mighty angel picked up a boulder the size of a large millstone and threw it into the sea, and said: "With such violence the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to be found again.

verses.textZh: 弹琴、奏乐、 吹笛、吹号的声音， 在你中间决不能再听到了！ 各样手艺技工， 在你中间决不能再找到了！ 推磨的声音， 在你中间决不能再听到了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 弹琴、奏乐、 吹笛、吹号的声音， 在你中间决不能再听到了！ 各样手艺技工， 在你中间决不能再找到了！ 推磨的声音， 在你中间决不能再听到了！
verses.textZhCuv: 弹琴、作乐、吹笛、吹号的声音， 在你中间决不能再听见； 各行手艺人在你中间决不能再遇见； 推磨的声音在你中间决不能再听见；
verses.textEnNiv: The music of harpists and musicians, pipers and trumpeters, will never be heard in you again. No worker of any trade will ever be found in you again. The sound of a millstone will never be heard in you again.
verses.textEnEsv: and the sound of harpists and musicians, of flute players and trumpeters, will be heard in you no more, and a craftsman of any craft will be found in you no more, and the sound of the mill will be heard in you no more,
verses.textEnNkjv: The sound of harpists, musicians, flutists, and trumpeters shall not be heard in you anymore. No craftsman of any craft shall be found in you anymore, and the sound of a millstone shall not be heard in you anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: The sound of harps, singers, flutes, and trumpets will never be heard in you again. No craftsmen and no trades will ever be found in you again. The sound of the mill will never be heard in you again.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sound of harpists, musicians, flute players, and trumpeters will never be heard in you again; and no craftsman of any craft will ever be found in you again; and the sound of a mill will never be heard in you again;
verses.textEn: The music of harpists and musicians, pipers and trumpeters, will never be heard in you again. No worker of any trade will ever be found in you again. The sound of a millstone will never be heard in you again.

verses.textZh: 灯的亮光， 在你中间决不能再照耀了！ 新郎新娘的声音， 在你中间决不能再听到了！ 你的商人一向都是地上的大人物， 万国都因你的邪术受了迷惑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 灯的亮光， 在你中间决不能再照耀了！ 新郎新娘的声音， 在你中间决不能再听到了！ 你的商人一向都是地上的大人物， 万国都因你的邪术受了迷惑。
verses.textZhCuv: 灯光在你中间决不能再照耀； 新郎和新妇的声音，在你中间决不能再听见。 你的客商原来是地上的尊贵人； 万国也被你的邪术迷惑了。
verses.textEnNiv: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again. The voice of bridegroom and bride will never be heard in you again. Your merchants were the world’s important people. By your magic spell all the nations were led astray.
verses.textEnEsv: and the light of a lamp will shine in you no more, and the voice of bridegroom and bride will be heard in you no more, for your merchants were the great ones of the earth, and all nations were deceived by your sorcery.
verses.textEnNkjv: The light of a lamp shall not shine in you anymore, and the voice of bridegroom and bride shall not be heard in you anymore. For your merchants were the great men of the earth, for by your sorcery all the nations were deceived.
verses.textEnNlt: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again. The happy voices of brides and grooms will never be heard in you again. For your merchants were the greatest in the world, and you deceived the nations with your sorceries.
verses.textEnNasb: and the light of a lamp will never shine in you again; and the voice of the groom and bride will never be heard in you again; for your merchants were the powerful people of the earth, because all the nations were deceived by your witchcraft.
verses.textEn: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again. The voice of bridegroom and bride will never be heard in you again. Your merchants were the world’s important people. By your magic spell all the nations were led astray.

verses.textZh: 先知、圣徒和地上一切被杀的人的血， 都在这城里找到了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 先知、圣徒和地上一切被杀的人的血， 都在这城里找到了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 先知和圣徒，并地上一切被杀之人的血，都在这城里看见了。
verses.textEnNiv: In her was found the blood of prophets and of God’s holy people, of all who have been slaughtered on the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: And in her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: And in her was found the blood of prophets and saints, and of all who were slain on the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: In your streets flowed the blood of the prophets and of God’s holy people and the blood of people slaughtered all over the world."
verses.textEnNasb: And in her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slaughtered on the earth."
verses.textEn: In her was found the blood of prophets and of God’s holy people, of all who have been slaughtered on the earth."

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，我听见天上好象有一大群人大声说： "哈利路亚！ 救恩、荣耀、权能都属于我们的神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，我听见天上好象有一大群人大声说： "哈利路亚！ 救恩、荣耀、权能都属于我们的神，
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，我听见好像群众在天上大声说： 哈利路亚 ！ 救恩、荣耀、权能都属乎我们的神！
verses.textEnNiv: After this I heard what sounded like the roar of a great multitude in heaven shouting: "Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God,
verses.textEnEsv: After this I heard what seemed to be the loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, crying out, "Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God,
verses.textEnNkjv: After these things I heard a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, "Alleluia! Salvation and glory and honor and power belong to the Lord our God!
verses.textEnNlt: After this, I heard what sounded like a vast crowd in heaven shouting, "Praise the Lord ! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God.
verses.textEnNasb: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, "Hallelujah! Salvation, glory, and power belong to our God,
verses.textEn: After this I heard what sounded like the roar of a great multitude in heaven shouting: "Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God,

verses.textZh: 因为他的审判是真实公义的。 他审判了那大淫妇， 那以淫乱败坏了世界的； 并且为他的仆人向淫妇伸了流血的冤。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他的审判是真实公义的。 他审判了那大淫妇， 那以淫乱败坏了世界的； 并且为他的仆人向淫妇伸了流血的冤。"

verses.textZhCnvs: 他们再一次说： "哈利路亚！ 烧淫妇的烟往上冒， 直到永永远远！"

verses.textEnNiv: And again they shouted: "Hallelujah! The smoke from her goes up for ever and ever."

verses.textEn: And again they shouted: "Hallelujah! The smoke from her goes up for ever and ever."

verses.textZhCnvs: 那二十四位长老和四个活物，就俯伏敬拜那坐在宝座上的神，说： "阿们！哈利路亚！"
verses.textZhCuv: 那二十四位长老与四活物就俯伏敬拜坐宝座的神，说： 阿们！哈利路亚！
verses.textEnNiv: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God, who was seated on the throne. And they cried: "Amen, Hallelujah!"
verses.textEnEsv: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who was seated on the throne, saying, "Amen. Hallelujah!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sat on the throne, saying, "Amen! Alleluia!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the twenty-four elders and the four living beings fell down and worshiped God, who was sitting on the throne. They cried out, "Amen! Praise the Lord !"
verses.textEnNasb: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, "Amen. Hallelujah!"
verses.textEn: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God, who was seated on the throne. And they cried: "Amen, Hallelujah!"

verses.textZh: 接着有声音从宝座发出来，说： "所有神的仆人哪！ 凡是敬畏他的， 无论大小， 你们都应当赞美我们的神！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着有声音从宝座发出来，说： "所有神的仆人哪！ 凡是敬畏他的， 无论大小， 你们都应当赞美我们的神！"
verses.textZhCuv: 有声音从宝座出来说：神的众仆人哪， 凡敬畏他的，无论大小， 都要赞美我们的神！
verses.textEnNiv: Then a voice came from the throne, saying: "Praise our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, both great and small!"
verses.textEnEsv: And from the throne came a voice saying, "Praise our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, small and great."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a voice came from the throne, saying, "Praise our God, all you His servants and those who fear Him, both small and great!"
verses.textEnNlt: And from the throne came a voice that said, "Praise our God, all his servants, all who fear him, from the least to the greatest."
verses.textEnNasb: And a voice came from the throne, saying, "Give praise to our God, all you His bond-servants, you who fear Him, the small and the great."
verses.textEn: Then a voice came from the throne, saying: "Praise our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, both great and small!"

verses.textZh: 我又听见一个声音，好象一大群人的声音，像众水的声音，又像大雷的声音，说： "哈利路亚！ 因为主、我们全能的神作王了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又听见一个声音，好象一大群人的声音，像众水的声音，又像大雷的声音，说： "哈利路亚！ 因为主、我们全能的神作王了！
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见好像群众的声音，众水的声音，大雷的声音，说： 哈利路亚！ 因为主－我们的神、 全能者作王了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I heard what sounded like a great multitude, like the roar of rushing waters and like loud peals of thunder, shouting: "Hallelujah! For our Lord God Almighty reigns.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I heard what seemed to be the voice of a great multitude, like the roar of many waters and like the sound of mighty peals of thunder, crying out, "Hallelujah! For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I heard, as it were, the voice of a great multitude, as the sound of many waters and as the sound of mighty thunderings, saying, "Alleluia! For the Lord God Omnipotent reigns!
verses.textEnNlt: Then I heard again what sounded like the shout of a vast crowd or the roar of mighty ocean waves or the crash of loud thunder: "Praise the Lord ! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I heard something like the voice of a great multitude and like the sound of many waters, and like the sound of mighty peals of thunder, saying, "Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns.
verses.textEn: Then I heard what sounded like a great multitude, like the roar of rushing waters and like loud peals of thunder, shouting: "Hallelujah! For our Lord God Almighty reigns.

verses.textEnNlt: Let us be glad and rejoice, and let us give honor to him. For the time has come for the wedding feast of the Lamb, and his bride has prepared herself.

verses.textZh: 天使对我说："你要写下来：‘被邀请赴羊羔婚筵的人有福了！’"他又对我说："这都是神真实的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 天使对我说："你要写下来：‘被邀请赴羊羔婚筵的人有福了！’"他又对我说："这都是神真实的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 天使吩咐我说：「你要写上：凡被请赴羔羊之婚筵的有福了！」又对我说：「这是神真实的话。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel said to me, "Write this: Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb!" And he added, "These are the true words of God."
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel said to me, "Write this: Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb." And he said to me, "These are the true words of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to me, "Write: ‘Blessed are those who are called to the marriage supper of the Lamb!’ " And he said to me, "These are the true sayings of God."
verses.textEnNlt: And the angel said to me, "Write this: Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb." And he added, "These are true words that come from God."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he *said to me, "Write: ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.’ " And he *said to me, "These are the true words of God."
verses.textEn: Then the angel said to me, "Write this: Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb!" And he added, "These are the true words of God."

verses.textZh: 我就俯伏在天使脚前要拜他。但他对我说："千万不可以这样！我和你，以及你那些为耶稣作见证的弟兄，都是同作仆人的。你应当敬拜神！因为预言的精义，就是耶稣的见证。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就俯伏在天使脚前要拜他。但他对我说："千万不可以这样！我和你，以及你那些为耶稣作见证的弟兄，都是同作仆人的。你应当敬拜神！因为预言的精义，就是耶稣的见证。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我就俯伏在他脚前要拜他。他说：「千万不可！我和你，并你那些为耶稣作见证的弟兄同是作仆人的，你要敬拜神。」因为预言中的灵意乃是为耶稣作见证。
verses.textEnNiv: At this I fell at his feet to worship him. But he said to me, "Don’t do that! I am a fellow servant with you and with your brothers and sisters who hold to the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For it is the Spirit of prophecy who bears testimony to Jesus."
verses.textEnEsv: Then I fell down at his feet to worship him, but he said to me, "You must not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers who hold to the testimony of Jesus. Worship God." For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I fell at his feet to worship him. But he said to me, "See thatyoudo not dothat! I am your fellow servant, and of your brethren who have the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy."
verses.textEnNlt: Then I fell down at his feet to worship him, but he said, "No, don’t worship me. I am a servant of God, just like you and your brothers and sisters who testify about their faith in Jesus. Worship only God. For the essence of prophecy is to give a clear witness for Jesus. "
verses.textEnNasb: Then I fell at his feet to worship him. But he *said to me, " Do not do that; I am a fellow servant of yours and your brothers and sisters who hold the testimony of Jesus; worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy."
verses.textEn: At this I fell at his feet to worship him. But he said to me, "Don’t do that! I am a fellow servant with you and with your brothers and sisters who hold to the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For it is the Spirit of prophecy who bears testimony to Jesus."

verses.textZh: 我观看，见天开了。有一匹白马，那骑马的称为"忠信"和"真实"；他按着公义审判和作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看，见天开了。有一匹白马，那骑马的称为"忠信"和"真实"；他按着公义审判和作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 我观看，见天开了。有一匹白马，骑在马上的称为诚信真实，他审判，争战，都按着公义。
verses.textEnNiv: I saw heaven standing open and there before me was a white horse, whose rider is called Faithful and True. With justice he judges and wages war.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse! The one sitting on it is called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he judges and makes war.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse. And He who sat on him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness He judges and makes war.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I saw heaven opened, and a white horse was standing there. Its rider was named Faithful and True, for he judges fairly and wages a righteous war.
verses.textEnNasb: And I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and He who sat on it is called Faithful and True, and in righteousness He judges and wages war.
verses.textEn: I saw heaven standing open and there before me was a white horse, whose rider is called Faithful and True. With justice he judges and wages war.

verses.textZh: 他的眼睛好象火焰，头上戴着许多皇冠，他身上写着一个名字，这名字除了他自己没有人认识。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的眼睛好象火焰，头上戴着许多皇冠，他身上写着一个名字，这名字除了他自己没有人认识。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的眼睛如火焰，他头上戴着许多冠冕；又有写着的名字，除了他自己没有人知道。
verses.textEnNiv: His eyes are like blazing fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has a name written on him that no one knows but he himself.

verses.textEnNkjv: His eyes were like a flame of fire, and on His head were many crowns. He had a name written that no one knew except Himself.
verses.textEnNlt: His eyes were like flames of fire, and on his head were many crowns. A name was written on him that no one understood except himself.
verses.textEnNasb: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on His head are many crowns; and He has a name written on Him which no one knows except Himself.
verses.textEn: His eyes are like blazing fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has a name written on him that no one knows but he himself.

verses.textZh: 他身穿一件浸过血的衣服，他的名字称为"神的道"。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他身穿一件浸过血的衣服，他的名字称为"神的道"。

verses.textEnNlt: He wore a robe dipped in blood, and his title was the Word of God.
verses.textEnNasb: He is clothed with a robe dipped in blood, and His name is called The Word of God.
verses.textEn: He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and his name is the Word of God.

verses.textZhCnvs: 天上的众军，都骑着白马，穿著洁白的细麻衣，跟随着他。
verses.textZhCuv: 在天上的众军骑着白马，穿着细麻衣，又白又洁，跟随他。
verses.textEnNiv: The armies of heaven were following him, riding on white horses and dressed in fine linen, white and clean.
verses.textEnEsv: And the armies of heaven, arrayed in fine linen, white and pure, were following him on white horses.

verses.textEnNlt: The armies of heaven, dressed in the finest of pure white linen, followed him on white horses.
verses.textEnNasb: And the armies which are in heaven, clothed in fine linen, white and clean, were following Him on white horses.
verses.textEn: The armies of heaven were following him, riding on white horses and dressed in fine linen, white and clean.

verses.textZh: 有一把利剑从他口中吐出来，他要用这剑击打列国，他必用铁杖治理他们；并且还要踹全能神烈怒的压酒池。

verses.textEnNiv: Coming out of his mouth is a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations. "He will rule them with an iron scepter." He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: From his mouth comes a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and he will rule them with a rod of iron. He will tread the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now out of His mouth goes a sharp sword, that with it He should strike the nations. And He Himself will rule them with a rod of iron. He Himself treads the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.
verses.textEnNlt: From his mouth came a sharp sword to strike down the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He will release the fierce wrath of God, the Almighty, like juice flowing from a winepress.
verses.textEnNasb: From His mouth comes a sharp sword, so that with it He may strike down the nations, and He will rule them with a rod of iron; and He treads the wine press of the fierce wrath of God, the Almighty.
verses.textEn: Coming out of his mouth is a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations. "He will rule them with an iron scepter." He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God Almighty.

verses.textEnEsv: On his robe and on his thigh he has a name written, King of kings and Lord of lords.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He has on His robe and on His thigh a name written: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.

verses.textEn: On his robe and on his thigh he has this name written: king of kings and lord of lords.
