verses.textEn: so that you may eat the flesh of kings, generals, and the mighty, of horses and their riders, and the flesh of all people, free and slave, great and small."

verses.textZh: 我看见那兽和地上的众王，以及他们的众军，都集合起来，要跟那骑白马的和他的众军作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见那兽和地上的众王，以及他们的众军，都集合起来，要跟那骑白马的和他的众军作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 我看见那兽和地上的君王，并他们的众军都聚集，要与骑白马的并他的军兵争战。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered together to wage war against the rider on the horse and his army.
verses.textEnEsv: And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies gathered to make war against him who was sitting on the horse and against his army.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against Him who sat on the horse and against His army.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I saw the beast and the kings of the world and their armies gathered together to fight against the one sitting on the horse and his army.
verses.textEnNasb: And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies, assembled to make war against Him who sat on the horse, and against His army.
verses.textEn: Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered together to wage war against the rider on the horse and his army.

verses.textZh: 那兽被捉住了；连同在兽面前用奇事迷惑人，使他们接受兽的记号，并且拜兽像的那假先知，也一起被捉住了。他们两个就活活地被拋在烧着硫磺的火湖里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那兽被捉住了；连同在兽面前用奇事迷惑人，使他们接受兽的记号，并且拜兽像的那假先知，也一起被捉住了。他们两个就活活地被拋在烧着硫磺的火湖里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 那兽被擒拿；那在兽面前曾行奇事、迷惑受兽印记和拜兽像之人的假先知，也与兽同被擒拿。他们两个就活活地被扔在烧着硫磺的火湖里；
verses.textEnNiv: But the beast was captured, and with it the false prophet who had performed the signs on its behalf. With these signs he had deluded those who had received the mark of the beast and worshiped its image. The two of them were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur.
verses.textEnEsv: And the beast was captured, and with it the false prophet who in its presence had done the signs by which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped its image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the beast was captured, and with him the false prophet who worked signs in his presence, by which he deceived those who received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were cast alive into the lake of fire burning with brimstone.
verses.textEnNlt: And the beast was captured, and with him the false prophet who did mighty miracles on behalf of the beast—miracles that deceived all who had accepted the mark of the beast and who worshiped his statue. Both the beast and his false prophet were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur.
verses.textEnNasb: And the beast was seized, and with him the false prophet who performed the signs in his presence, by which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image; these two were thrown alive into the lake of fire, which burns with brimstone.
verses.textEn: But the beast was captured, and with it the false prophet who had performed the signs on its behalf. With these signs he had deluded those who had received the mark of the beast and worshiped its image. The two of them were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur.

verses.textZh: 其余的人都被那位骑白马的口中所吐出来的剑杀了。所有飞鸟都吃饱了他们的肉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其余的人都被那位骑白马的口中所吐出来的剑杀了。所有飞鸟都吃饱了他们的肉。
verses.textZhCuv: 其余的被骑白马者口中出来的剑杀了；飞鸟都吃饱了他们的肉。
verses.textEnNiv: The rest were killed with the sword coming out of the mouth of the rider on the horse, and all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.
verses.textEnEsv: And the rest were slain by the sword that came from the mouth of him who was sitting on the horse, and all the birds were gorged with their flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the rest were killed with the sword which proceeded from the mouth of Him who sat on the horse. And all the birds were filled with their flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: Their entire army was killed by the sharp sword that came from the mouth of the one riding the white horse. And the vultures all gorged themselves on the dead bodies.
verses.textEnNasb: And the rest were killed with the sword which came from the mouth of Him who sat on the horse, and all the birds were filled with their flesh.
verses.textEn: The rest were killed with the sword coming out of the mouth of the rider on the horse, and all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.

verses.textZh: 我又看见一位天使从天上降下来，手里拿着无底坑的钥匙和一条大锁炼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见一位天使从天上降下来，手里拿着无底坑的钥匙和一条大锁炼。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见一位天使从天降下，手里拿着无底坑的钥匙和一条大链子。
verses.textEnNiv: And I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key to the Abyss and holding in his hand a great chain.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven, holding in his hand the key to the bottomless pit and a great chain.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven, having the key to the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven with the key to the bottomless pit and a heavy chain in his hand.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven, holding the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
verses.textEn: And I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key to the Abyss and holding in his hand a great chain.

verses.textZh: 他捉住了那龙，那古蛇，就是魔鬼，撒但，把牠捆绑了一千年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他捉住了那龙，那古蛇，就是魔鬼，撒但，把牠捆绑了一千年。
verses.textZhCuv: 他捉住那龙，就是古蛇，又叫魔鬼，也叫撒但，把它捆绑一千年，
verses.textEnNiv: He seized the dragon, that ancient serpent, who is the devil, or Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.
verses.textEnEsv: And he seized the dragon, that ancient serpent, who is the devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years,
verses.textEnNkjv: He laid hold of the dragon, that serpent of old, who is the Devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years;
verses.textEnNlt: He seized the dragon—that old serpent, who is the devil, Satan—and bound him in chains for a thousand years.
verses.textEnNasb: And he took hold of the dragon, the serpent of old, who is the devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years;
verses.textEn: He seized the dragon, that ancient serpent, who is the devil, or Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.

verses.textZh: 天使把牠拋在无底坑里，关起来，封上印，使牠不能再迷惑列国，等到那一千年完了。以后，必须暂时释放牠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天使把牠拋在无底坑里，关起来，封上印，使牠不能再迷惑列国，等到那一千年完了。以后，必须暂时释放牠。
verses.textZhCuv: 扔在无底坑里，将无底坑关闭，用印封上，使它不得再迷惑列国。等到那一千年完了，以后必须暂时释放它。
verses.textEnNiv: He threw him into the Abyss, and locked and sealed it over him, to keep him from deceiving the nations anymore until the thousand years were ended. After that, he must be set free for a short time.
verses.textEnEsv: and threw him into the pit, and shut it and sealed it over him, so that he might not deceive the nations any longer, until the thousand years were ended. After that he must be released for a little while.
verses.textEnNkjv: and he cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal on him, so that he should deceive the nations no more till the thousand years were finished. But after these things he must be released for a little while.
verses.textEnNlt: The angel threw him into the bottomless pit, which he then shut and locked so Satan could not deceive the nations anymore until the thousand years were finished. Afterward he must be released for a little while.
verses.textEnNasb: and he threw him into the abyss and shut it and sealed it over him, so that he would not deceive the nations any longer, until the thousand years were completed; after these things he must be released for a short time.
verses.textEn: He threw him into the Abyss, and locked and sealed it over him, to keep him from deceiving the nations anymore until the thousand years were ended. After that, he must be set free for a short time.

verses.textZh: 我又看见一些宝座，有人坐在上面，他们得了审判的权柄。我也看见那些因为替耶稣作见证，并且因为神的道而被斩首的人的灵魂。他们没有拜过兽或兽像，也没有在额上或手上受过兽的记号。他们都复活了，与基督一同作王一千年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见一些宝座，有人坐在上面，他们得了审判的权柄。我也看见那些因为替耶稣作见证，并且因为神的道而被斩首的人的灵魂。他们没有拜过兽或兽像，也没有在额上或手上受过兽的记号。他们都复活了，与基督一同作王一千年。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见几个宝座，也有坐在上面的，并有审判的权柄赐给他们。我又看见那些因为给耶稣作见证，并为神之道被斩者的灵魂，和那没有拜过兽与兽像，也没有在额上和手上受过他印记之人的灵魂，他们都复活了，与基督一同作王一千年。
verses.textEnNiv: I saw thrones on which were seated those who had been given authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of their testimony about Jesus and because of the word of God. They had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their foreheads or their hands. They came to life and reigned with Christ a thousand years.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I saw thrones, and seated on them were those to whom the authority to judge was committed. Also I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their foreheads or their hands. They came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was committed to them. Then Isaw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their witness to Jesus and for the word of God, who had not worshiped the beast or his image, and had not received his mark on their foreheads or on their hands. And they lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I saw thrones, and the people sitting on them had been given the authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their testimony about Jesus and for proclaiming the word of God. They had not worshiped the beast or his statue, nor accepted his mark on their foreheads or their hands. They all came to life again, and they reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of their testimony of Jesus and because of the word of God, and those who had not worshiped the beast or his image, and had not received the mark on their foreheads and on their hands; and they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
verses.textEn: I saw thrones on which were seated those who had been given authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of their testimony about Jesus and because of the word of God. They had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their foreheads or their hands. They came to life and reigned with Christ a thousand years.

verses.textZh: 其余的死人还没有复活，等到那一千年完了。这是头一次的复活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其余的死人还没有复活，等到那一千年完了。这是头一次的复活。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是头一次的复活。（其余的死人还没有复活，直等那一千年完了。）
verses.textEnNiv: (The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were ended.) This is the first resurrection.
verses.textEnEsv: The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were ended. This is the first resurrection.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the rest of the dead did not live again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the first resurrection. (The rest of the dead did not come back to life until the thousand years had ended.)
verses.textEnNasb: The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were completed. This is the first resurrection.
verses.textEn: (The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were ended.) This is the first resurrection.

verses.textZh: 在头一次复活有分的人是有福的、圣洁的，第二次的死没有能力辖制他们。他们还要作神和基督的祭司，与他一同作王一千年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在头一次复活有分的人是有福的、圣洁的，第二次的死没有能力辖制他们。他们还要作神和基督的祭司，与他一同作王一千年。
verses.textZhCuv: 在头一次复活有分的有福了，圣洁了！第二次的死在他们身上没有权柄。他们必作神和基督的祭司，并要与基督一同作王一千年。
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection. The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with him for a thousand years.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed and holy is the one who shares in the first resurrection! Over such the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and they will reign with him for a thousand years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over such the second death has no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with Him a thousand years.
verses.textEnNlt: Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection. For them the second death holds no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with him a thousand years.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed and holy is the one who has a part in the first resurrection; over these the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with Him for a thousand years.
verses.textEn: Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection. The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with him for a thousand years.

verses.textZh: 那一千年完了，撒但就要从监牢里被释放出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一千年完了，撒但就要从监牢里被释放出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 那一千年完了，撒但必从监牢里被释放，
verses.textEnNiv: When the thousand years are over, Satan will be released from his prison
verses.textEnEsv: And when the thousand years are ended, Satan will be released from his prison
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the thousand years have expired, Satan will be released from his prison
verses.textEnNlt: When the thousand years come to an end, Satan will be let out of his prison.
verses.textEnNasb: When the thousand years are completed, Satan will be released from his prison,
verses.textEn: When the thousand years are over, Satan will be released from his prison

verses.textZh: 他要出来迷惑地上四方的列国，就是歌革和玛名，使他们聚集争战。他们的人数好象海边的沙那么多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要出来迷惑地上四方的列国，就是歌革和玛名，使他们聚集争战。他们的人数好象海边的沙那么多。
verses.textZhCuv: 出来要迷惑地上四方 的列国，就是歌革和玛各，叫他们聚集争战。他们的人数多如海沙。
verses.textEnNiv: and will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth—Gog and Magog—and to gather them for battle. In number they are like the sand on the seashore.
verses.textEnEsv: and will come out to deceive the nations that are at the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them for battle; their number is like the sand of the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: and will go out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle, whose number is as the sand of the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: He will go out to deceive the nations—called Gog and Magog—in every corner of the earth. He will gather them together for battle—a mighty army, as numberless as sand along the seashore.
verses.textEnNasb: and will come out to deceive the nations which are at the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together for the war; the number of them is like the sand of the seashore.
verses.textEn: and will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth—Gog and Magog—and to gather them for battle. In number they are like the sand on the seashore.

verses.textZh: 他们上来遍满了全地，围住了圣徒的营和那蒙爱的城，就有火从天上降下来，毁灭了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们上来遍满了全地，围住了圣徒的营和那蒙爱的城，就有火从天上降下来，毁灭了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们上来遍满了全地，围住圣徒的营与蒙爱的城，就有火从天降下，烧灭了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They marched across the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of God’s people, the city he loves. But fire came down from heaven and devoured them.
verses.textEnEsv: And they marched up over the broad plain of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city, but fire came down from heaven and consumed them,
verses.textEnNkjv: They went up on the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. And fire came down from God out of heaven and devoured them.
verses.textEnNlt: And I saw them as they went up on the broad plain of the earth and surrounded God’s people and the beloved city. But fire from heaven came down on the attacking armies and consumed them.
verses.textEnNasb: And they came up on the broad plain of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city, and fire came down from heaven and devoured them.
verses.textEn: They marched across the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of God’s people, the city he loves. But fire came down from heaven and devoured them.

verses.textZh: 那迷惑他们的魔鬼，被拋在硫磺的火湖里，就是兽和假先知所在的地方。他们必昼夜受痛苦，直到永永远远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那迷惑他们的魔鬼，被拋在硫磺的火湖里，就是兽和假先知所在的地方。他们必昼夜受痛苦，直到永永远远。
verses.textZhCuv: 那迷惑他们的魔鬼被扔在硫磺的火湖里，就是兽和假先知所在的地方。他们必昼夜受痛苦，直到永永远远。
verses.textEnNiv: And the devil, who deceived them, was thrown into the lake of burning sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet had been thrown. They will be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
verses.textEnEsv: and the devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur where the beast and the false prophet were, and they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
verses.textEnNkjv: The devil, who deceived them, was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone where the beast and the false prophet are. And they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the devil, who had deceived them, was thrown into the fiery lake of burning sulfur, joining the beast and the false prophet. There they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
verses.textEnNasb: And the devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are also; and they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
verses.textEn: And the devil, who deceived them, was thrown into the lake of burning sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet had been thrown. They will be tormented day and night for ever and ever.

verses.textZh: 我又看见一个白色的大宝座，和坐在上面的那位。天地都从他面前逃避，再也看不见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见一个白色的大宝座，和坐在上面的那位。天地都从他面前逃避，再也看不见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见一个白色的大宝座与坐在上面的；从他面前天地都逃避，再无可见之处了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I saw a great white throne and him who was seated on it. The earth and the heavens fled from his presence, and there was no place for them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I saw a great white throne and him who was seated on it. From his presence earth and sky fled away, and no place was found for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I saw a great white throne and Him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. And there was found no place for them.
verses.textEnNlt: And I saw a great white throne and the one sitting on it. The earth and sky fled from his presence, but they found no place to hide.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I saw a great white throne and Him who sat upon it, from whose presence earth and heaven fled, and no place was found for them.
verses.textEn: Then I saw a great white throne and him who was seated on it. The earth and the heavens fled from his presence, and there was no place for them.

verses.textZh: 我又看见死了的人，无论大小，都站在宝座前。案卷都展开了，还有另一卷，就是生命册，也展开了。死了的人都凭着这些案卷所记载的，照着他们所行的受审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见死了的人，无论大小，都站在宝座前。案卷都展开了，还有另一卷，就是生命册，也展开了。死了的人都凭着这些案卷所记载的，照着他们所行的受审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见死了的人，无论大小，都站在宝座前。案卷展开了，并且另有一卷展开，就是生命册。死了的人都凭着这些案卷所记载的，照他们所行的受审判。
verses.textEnNiv: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and books were opened. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged according to what they had done as recorded in the books.
verses.textEnEsv: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and books were opened. Then another book was opened, which is the book of life. And the dead were judged by what was written in the books, according to what they had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I saw the dead, small and great, standing before God, and books were opened. And another book was opened, which is theBook of Life. And the dead were judged according to their works, by the things which were written in the books.
verses.textEnNlt: I saw the dead, both great and small, standing before God’s throne. And the books were opened, including the Book of Life. And the dead were judged according to what they had done, as recorded in the books.
verses.textEnNasb: And I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and books were opened; and another book was opened, which is the book of life; and the dead were judged from the things which were written in the books, according to their deeds.
verses.textEn: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and books were opened. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged according to what they had done as recorded in the books.

verses.textZh: 于是海把其中的死人交出来，死亡和阴间也把其中的死人交出来，他们都照着各人所行的受审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是海把其中的死人交出来，死亡和阴间也把其中的死人交出来，他们都照着各人所行的受审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是海交出其中的死人；死亡和阴间也交出其中的死人；他们都照各人所行的受审判。
verses.textEnNiv: The sea gave up the dead that were in it, and death and Hades gave up the dead that were in them, and each person was judged according to what they had done.
verses.textEnEsv: And the sea gave up the dead who were in it, Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them, and they were judged, each one of them, according to what they had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sea gave up the dead who were in it, and Death and Hades delivered up the dead who were in them. And they were judged, each one according to his works.
verses.textEnNlt: The sea gave up its dead, and death and the grave gave up their dead. And all were judged according to their deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sea gave up the dead who were in it, and Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them; and they were judged, each one of them according to their deeds.
verses.textEn: The sea gave up the dead that were in it, and death and Hades gave up the dead that were in them, and each person was judged according to what they had done.

verses.textZh: 死亡和阴间也被拋在火湖里。这火湖就是第二次的死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 死亡和阴间也被拋在火湖里。这火湖就是第二次的死。
verses.textZhCuv: 死亡和阴间也被扔在火湖里；这火湖就是第二次的死。
verses.textEnNiv: Then death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. The lake of fire is the second death.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Death and Hades were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
verses.textEnNlt: Then death and the grave were thrown into the lake of fire. This lake of fire is the second death.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.
verses.textEn: Then death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. The lake of fire is the second death.

verses.textZh: 凡是名字没有记在生命册上的，他就被拋在火湖里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是名字没有记在生命册上的，他就被拋在火湖里。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人名字没记在生命册上，他就被扔在火湖里。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone whose name was not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
verses.textEnEsv: And if anyone’s name was not found written in the book of life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: And anyone not found written in the Book of Life was cast into the lake of fire.
verses.textEnNlt: And anyone whose name was not found recorded in the Book of Life was thrown into the lake of fire.
verses.textEnNasb: And if anyone’s name was not found written in the book of life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.
verses.textEn: Anyone whose name was not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.

verses.textZh: 我又看见一个新天新地，因为先前的天地都过去了，海也再没有了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见一个新天新地，因为先前的天地都过去了，海也再没有了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见一个新天新地；因为先前的天地已经过去了，海也不再有了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I saw "a new heaven and a new earth," for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and there was no longer any sea.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away. Also there was no more sea.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the old heaven and the old earth had disappeared. And the sea was also gone.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth; for the first heaven and the first earth passed away, and there is no longer any sea.
verses.textEn: Then I saw "a new heaven and a new earth," for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and there was no longer any sea.

verses.textZh: 我又看见圣城，新耶路撒冷，从天上由神那里降下来，预备好了，好象打扮整齐等候丈夫的新娘。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见圣城，新耶路撒冷，从天上由神那里降下来，预备好了，好象打扮整齐等候丈夫的新娘。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又看见圣城新耶路撒冷由神那里从天而降，预备好了，就如新妇妆饰整齐，等候丈夫。
verses.textEnNiv: I saw the Holy City, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride beautifully dressed for her husband.
verses.textEnEsv: And I saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I, John, saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
verses.textEnNlt: And I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven like a bride beautifully dressed for her husband.
verses.textEnNasb: And I saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
verses.textEn: I saw the Holy City, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride beautifully dressed for her husband.

verses.textZh: 我听见有大声音从宝座那里发出来，说："看哪！神的帐幕在人间，他要与人同住，他们要作他的子民。神要亲自与他们同在，要作他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见有大声音从宝座那里发出来，说："看哪！神的帐幕在人间，他要与人同住，他们要作他的子民。神要亲自与他们同在，要作他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见有大声音从宝座出来说：「看哪，神的帐幕在人间。他要与人同住，他们要作他的子民。神要亲自与他们同在，作他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, "Look! God’s dwelling place is now among the people, and he will dwell with them. They will be his people, and God himself will be with them and be their God.
verses.textEnEsv: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, "Behold, the dwelling place of God is with man. He will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I heard a loud voice from heaven saying, "Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and He will dwell with them, and they shall be His people. God Himself will be with them andbe their God.
verses.textEnNlt: I heard a loud shout from the throne, saying, "Look, God’s home is now among his people! He will live with them, and they will be his people. God himself will be with them.
verses.textEnNasb: And I heard a loud voice from the throne, saying, "Behold, the tabernacle of God is among the people, and He will dwell among them, and they shall be His people, and God Himself will be among them ,
verses.textEn: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, "Look! God’s dwelling place is now among the people, and he will dwell with them. They will be his people, and God himself will be with them and be their God.

verses.textZh: 他要抹去他们的一切眼泪，不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、痛苦，因为先前的事都过去了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要抹去他们的一切眼泪，不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、痛苦，因为先前的事都过去了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛，因为以前的事都过去了。」
verses.textEnNiv: ‘He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death’ or mourning or crying or pain, for the old order of things has passed away."
verses.textEnEsv: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes, and death shall be no more, neither shall there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain anymore, for the former things have passed away."
verses.textEnNkjv: And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes; there shall be no more death, nor sorrow, nor crying. There shall be no more pain, for the former things have passed away."
verses.textEnNlt: He will wipe every tear from their eyes, and there will be no more death or sorrow or crying or pain. All these things are gone forever."
verses.textEnNasb: and He will wipe away every tear from their eyes; and there will no longer be any death; there will no longer be any mourning, or crying, or pain; the first things have passed away."
verses.textEn: ‘He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death’ or mourning or crying or pain, for the old order of things has passed away."

verses.textZh: 坐在宝座上的那一位说："看哪，我把一切都更新了！"又说："你要写下来，因为这些话是可信的、真实的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 坐在宝座上的那一位说："看哪，我把一切都更新了！"又说："你要写下来，因为这些话是可信的、真实的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 坐宝座的说：「看哪，我将一切都更新了！」又说：「你要写上；因这些话是可信的，是真实的。」
verses.textEnNiv: He who was seated on the throne said, "I am making everything new!" Then he said, "Write this down, for these words are trustworthy and true."
verses.textEnEsv: And he who was seated on the throne said, "Behold, I am making all things new." Also he said, "Write this down, for these words are trustworthy and true."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He who sat on the throne said, "Behold, I make all things new." And He said to me, "Write, for these words are true and faithful."
verses.textEnNlt: And the one sitting on the throne said, "Look, I am making everything new!" And then he said to me, "Write this down, for what I tell you is trustworthy and true."
verses.textEnNasb: And He who sits on the throne said, "Behold, I am making all things new." And He *said, "Write, for these words are faithful and true."
verses.textEn: He who was seated on the throne said, "I am making everything new!" Then he said, "Write this down, for these words are trustworthy and true."

verses.textZh: 他又对我说："成了！我是阿拉法，是俄梅格；我是创始的，也是成终的。我要把生命的泉水，白白赐给口渴的人喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对我说："成了！我是阿拉法，是俄梅格；我是创始的，也是成终的。我要把生命的泉水，白白赐给口渴的人喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又对我说：「都成了！我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛；我是初，我是终。我要将生命泉的水白白赐给那口渴的人喝。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to me: "It is done. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To the thirsty I will give water without cost from the spring of the water of life.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. To the thirsty I will give from the spring of the water of life without payment.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to me, "It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give of the fountain of the water of life freely to him who thirsts.
verses.textEnNlt: And he also said, "It is finished! I am the Alpha and the Omega—the Beginning and the End. To all who are thirsty I will give freely from the springs of the water of life.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said to me, " It is done. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give water to the one who thirsts from the spring of the water of life, without cost.
verses.textEn: He said to me: "It is done. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To the thirsty I will give water without cost from the spring of the water of life.

verses.textZh: 得胜的，必要承受这些福分。我要作他的神，他要作我的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 得胜的，必要承受这些福分。我要作他的神，他要作我的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 得胜的，必承受这些为业：我要作他的神，他要作我的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who are victorious will inherit all this, and I will be their God and they will be my children.
verses.textEnEsv: The one who conquers will have this heritage, and I will be his God and he will be my son.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who overcomes shall inherit all things, and I will be his God and he shall be My son.
verses.textEnNlt: All who are victorious will inherit all these blessings, and I will be their God, and they will be my children.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who overcomes will inherit these things, and I will be his God and he will be My son.
verses.textEn: Those who are victorious will inherit all this, and I will be their God and they will be my children.

verses.textZh: 只是那些胆怯的、不信的、可憎的、杀人的、淫乱的、行邪术的、拜偶像的和所有说谎的人，他们的分是在烧着硫磺的火湖里。这就是第二次的死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是那些胆怯的、不信的、可憎的、杀人的、淫乱的、行邪术的、拜偶像的和所有说谎的人，他们的分是在烧着硫磺的火湖里。这就是第二次的死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有胆怯的、不信的、可憎的、杀人的、淫乱的、行邪术的、拜偶像的，和一切说谎话的，他们的分就在烧着硫磺的火湖里；这是第二次的死。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the cowardly, the unbelieving, the vile, the murderers, the sexually immoral, those who practice magic arts, the idolaters and all liars—they will be consigned to the fiery lake of burning sulfur. This is the second death."
verses.textEnEsv: But as for the cowardly, the faithless, the detestable, as for murderers, the sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their portion will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the cowardly, unbelieving, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars shall have their part in the lake which burns with fire and brimstone, which is the second death."
verses.textEnNlt: "But cowards, unbelievers, the corrupt, murderers, the immoral, those who practice witchcraft, idol worshipers, and all liars—their fate is in the fiery lake of burning sulfur. This is the second death."
verses.textEnNasb: But for the cowardly, and unbelieving, and abominable, and murderers, and sexually immoral persons, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, their part will be in the lake that burns with fire and brimstone, which is the second death."
verses.textEn: But the cowardly, the unbelieving, the vile, the murderers, the sexually immoral, those who practice magic arts, the idolaters and all liars—they will be consigned to the fiery lake of burning sulfur. This is the second death."

verses.textZh: 拿着七个盛满着末后七灾的碗的七位天使中，有一位走来对我说："你来！我要把新娘，就是羊羔的妻子，指示你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿着七个盛满着末后七灾的碗的七位天使中，有一位走来对我说："你来！我要把新娘，就是羊羔的妻子，指示你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拿着七个金碗、盛满末后七灾的七位天使中，有一位来对我说：「你到这里来，我要将新妇，就是羔羊的妻，指给你看。」
verses.textEnNiv: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came and said to me, "Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb."
verses.textEnEsv: Then came one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues and spoke to me, saying, "Come, I will show you the Bride, the wife of the Lamb."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls filled with the seven last plagues came to me and talked with me, saying, "Come, I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife."
verses.textEnNlt: Then one of the seven angels who held the seven bowls containing the seven last plagues came and said to me, "Come with me! I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb."
verses.textEnNasb: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls, full of the seven last plagues, came and spoke with me, saying, "Come here, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb."
verses.textEn: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came and said to me, "Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb."

verses.textZh: 我在灵里被那天使带到一座高大的山上，他把从天上由神那里降下来的圣城耶路撒冷指示我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在灵里被那天使带到一座高大的山上，他把从天上由神那里降下来的圣城耶路撒冷指示我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我被圣灵感动，天使就带我到一座高大的山，将那由神那里、从天而降的圣城耶路撒冷指示我。
verses.textEnNiv: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain great and high, and showed me the Holy City, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God.
verses.textEnEsv: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a great, high mountain, and showed me the holy city Jerusalem coming down out of heaven from God,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,
verses.textEnNlt: So he took me in the Spirit to a great, high mountain, and he showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God.
verses.textEnNasb: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,
verses.textEn: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain great and high, and showed me the Holy City, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God.

verses.textZh: 这城有神的荣耀，城的光辉好象极贵的宝石，又像晶莹的碧玉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这城有神的荣耀，城的光辉好象极贵的宝石，又像晶莹的碧玉。
verses.textZhCuv: 城中有神的荣耀；城的光辉如同极贵的宝石，好像碧玉，明如水晶。
verses.textEnNiv: It shone with the glory of God, and its brilliance was like that of a very precious jewel, like a jasper, clear as crystal.
verses.textEnEsv: having the glory of God, its radiance like a most rare jewel, like a jasper, clear as crystal.
verses.textEnNkjv: having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, clear as crystal.
verses.textEnNlt: It shone with the glory of God and sparkled like a precious stone—like jasper as clear as crystal.
verses.textEnNasb: having the glory of God. Her brilliance was like a very valuable stone, like a stone of crystal-clear jasper.
verses.textEn: It shone with the glory of God, and its brilliance was like that of a very precious jewel, like a jasper, clear as crystal.

verses.textZh: 有高大的城墙，有十二个门，门口有十二位天使，门上写着以色列十二支派的名字。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有高大的城墙，有十二个门，门口有十二位天使，门上写着以色列十二支派的名字。
verses.textZhCuv: 有高大的墙，有十二个门，门上有十二位天使，门上又写着以色列十二个支派的名字。
verses.textEnNiv: It had a great, high wall with twelve gates, and with twelve angels at the gates. On the gates were written the names of the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: It had a great, high wall, with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and on the gates the names of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel were inscribed—
verses.textEnNkjv: Also she had a great and high wall with twelve gates, and twelve angels at the gates, and names written on them, which are thenames of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:
verses.textEnNlt: The city wall was broad and high, with twelve gates guarded by twelve angels. And the names of the twelve tribes of Israel were written on the gates.
verses.textEnNasb: It had a great and high wall, with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels; and names were written on the gates, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: It had a great, high wall with twelve gates, and with twelve angels at the gates. On the gates were written the names of the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.textZh: 东边有三个门，南边有三个门，西边有三个门，北边有三个门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 东边有三个门，南边有三个门，西边有三个门，北边有三个门。
verses.textZhCuv: 东边有三门，北边有三门，南边有三门，西边有三门。
verses.textEnNiv: There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south and three on the west.
verses.textEnEsv: on the east three gates, on the north three gates, on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.
verses.textEnNkjv: three gates on the east, three gates on the north, three gates on the south, and three gates on the west.
verses.textEnNlt: There were three gates on each side—east, north, south, and west.
verses.textEnNasb: There were three gates on the east, three gates on the north, three gates on the south, and three gates on the west.
verses.textEn: There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south and three on the west.

verses.textZh: 城墙有十二座根基，根基上有羊羔的十二使徒的名字。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城墙有十二座根基，根基上有羊羔的十二使徒的名字。
verses.textZhCuv: 城墙有十二根基，根基上有羔羊十二使徒的名字。
verses.textEnNiv: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them were the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
verses.textEnEsv: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them were the twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them were the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
verses.textEnNlt: The wall of the city had twelve foundation stones, and on them were written the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
verses.textEnNasb: And the wall of the city had twelve foundation stones, and on them were the twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
verses.textEn: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them were the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

verses.textZh: 那对我说话的天使拿着一根金的芦苇，要量那城、城门和城墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那对我说话的天使拿着一根金的芦苇，要量那城、城门和城墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 对我说话的，拿着金苇子当尺，要量那城和城门城墙。
verses.textEnNiv: The angel who talked with me had a measuring rod of gold to measure the city, its gates and its walls.
verses.textEnEsv: And the one who spoke with me had a measuring rod of gold to measure the city and its gates and walls.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he who talked with me had a gold reed to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.
verses.textEnNlt: The angel who talked to me held in his hand a gold measuring stick to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who spoke with me had a gold measuring rod to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.
verses.textEn: The angel who talked with me had a measuring rod of gold to measure the city, its gates and its walls.

verses.textZh: 城是四方的，长宽都一样。天使用芦苇量那城，共有二千四百公里 ，城的长、宽、高都一样；
verses.textZhCnvs: 城是四方的，长宽都一样。天使用芦苇量那城，共有二千四百公里 ，城的长、宽、高都一样；
verses.textZhCuv: 城是四方的，长宽一样。天使用苇子量那城，共有四千里，长、宽、高都是一样；
verses.textEnNiv: The city was laid out like a square, as long as it was wide. He measured the city with the rod and found it to be 12,000 stadia in length, and as wide and high as it is long.
verses.textEnEsv: The city lies foursquare, its length the same as its width. And he measured the city with his rod, 12,000 stadia. Its length and width and height are equal.
verses.textEnNkjv: The city is laid out as a square; its length is as great as its breadth. And he measured the city with the reed: twelve thousand furlongs. Its length, breadth, and height are equal.
verses.textEnNlt: When he measured it, he found it was a square, as wide as it was long. In fact, its length and width and height were each 1,400 miles.
verses.textEnNasb: The city is laid out as a square, and its length is as great as the width; and he measured the city with the rod, twelve thousand stadia; its length, width, and height are equal.
verses.textEn: The city was laid out like a square, as long as it was wide. He measured the city with the rod and found it to be 12,000 stadia in length, and as wide and high as it is long.

verses.textZh: 又量了城墙，约有六十公尺 。天使用的标准，就是人量度的标准。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又量了城墙，约有六十公尺 。天使用的标准，就是人量度的标准。
verses.textZhCuv: 又量了城墙，按着人的尺寸，就是天使的尺寸，共有一百四十四肘。
verses.textEnNiv: The angel measured the wall using human measurement, and it was 144 cubits thick.
verses.textEnEsv: He also measured its wall, 144 cubits by human measurement, which is also an angel’s measurement.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he measured its wall: one hundred and forty-four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he measured the walls and found them to be 216 feet thick (according to the human standard used by the angel).
verses.textEnNasb: And he measured its wall, 144 cubits, by human measurements, which are also angelic measurements.
verses.textEn: The angel measured the wall using human measurement, and it was 144 cubits thick.

verses.textZh: 城墙是用碧玉做的，城是用明净像玻璃的纯金做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城墙是用碧玉做的，城是用明净像玻璃的纯金做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 墙是碧玉造的；城是精金的，如同明净的玻璃。
verses.textEnNiv: The wall was made of jasper, and the city of pure gold, as pure as glass.
verses.textEnEsv: The wall was built of jasper, while the city was pure gold, like clear glass.
verses.textEnNkjv: The construction of its wall was of jasper; and the city was pure gold, like clear glass.
verses.textEnNlt: The wall was made of jasper, and the city was pure gold, as clear as glass.
verses.textEnNasb: The material of the wall was jasper; and the city was pure gold, like clear glass.
verses.textEn: The wall was made of jasper, and the city of pure gold, as pure as glass.

verses.textZh: 城墙的根基是用各样宝石装饰的：第一座根基是碧玉，第二座是蓝宝石，第三座是玛瑙，第四座是绿宝石，
verses.textZhCnvs: 城墙的根基是用各样宝石装饰的：第一座根基是碧玉，第二座是蓝宝石，第三座是玛瑙，第四座是绿宝石，
verses.textZhCuv: 城墙的根基是用各样宝石修饰的：第一根基是碧玉；第二是蓝宝石；第三是绿玛瑙；第四是绿宝石；
verses.textEnNiv: The foundations of the city walls were decorated with every kind of precious stone. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third agate, the fourth emerald,
verses.textEnEsv: The foundations of the wall of the city were adorned with every kind of jewel. The first was jasper, the second sapphire, the third agate, the fourth emerald,
verses.textEnNkjv: The foundations of the wall of the city were adorned with all kinds of precious stones: the first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
verses.textEnNlt: The wall of the city was built on foundation stones inlaid with twelve precious stones: the first was jasper, the second sapphire, the third agate, the fourth emerald,
verses.textEnNasb: The foundation stones of the city wall were decorated with every kind of precious stone. The first foundation stone was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;
verses.textEn: The foundations of the city walls were decorated with every kind of precious stone. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third agate, the fourth emerald,

verses.textZh: 第五座是红玛瑙，第六座是红宝石，第七座是黄璧玺，第八座是水苍玉，第九座是红璧玺，第十座是翡翠，第十一座是紫玛瑙，第十二座是紫晶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第五座是红玛瑙，第六座是红宝石，第七座是黄璧玺，第八座是水苍玉，第九座是红璧玺，第十座是翡翠，第十一座是紫玛瑙，第十二座是紫晶。
verses.textZhCuv: 第五是红玛瑙；第六是红宝石；第七是黄璧玺；第八是水苍玉；第九是红璧玺；第十是翡翠；第十一是紫玛瑙；第十二是紫晶。
verses.textEnNiv: the fifth onyx, the sixth ruby, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth turquoise, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.
verses.textEnEsv: the fifth onyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, the twelfth amethyst.
verses.textEnNkjv: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.
verses.textEnNlt: the fifth onyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, the twelfth amethyst.
verses.textEnNasb: the fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, topaz; the tenth, chrysoprase; the eleventh, jacinth; the twelfth, amethyst.
verses.textEn: the fifth onyx, the sixth ruby, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth turquoise, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.

verses.textZh: 十二个门是十二颗珍珠，每一个门是用一颗珍珠做的。城里的街道是纯金的，好象透明的玻璃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 十二个门是十二颗珍珠，每一个门是用一颗珍珠做的。城里的街道是纯金的，好象透明的玻璃。
verses.textZhCuv: 十二个门是十二颗珍珠，每门是一颗珍珠。城内的街道是精金，好像明透的玻璃。
verses.textEnNiv: The twelve gates were twelve pearls, each gate made of a single pearl. The great street of the city was of gold, as pure as transparent glass.
verses.textEnEsv: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, each of the gates made of a single pearl, and the street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
verses.textEnNkjv: The twelve gates were twelve pearls: each individual gate was of one pearl. And the street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
verses.textEnNlt: The twelve gates were made of pearls—each gate from a single pearl! And the main street was pure gold, as clear as glass.
verses.textEnNasb: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; each one of the gates was a single pearl. And the street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
verses.textEn: The twelve gates were twelve pearls, each gate made of a single pearl. The great street of the city was of gold, as pure as transparent glass.

verses.textZh: 我没有看见城里有圣所，因为主全能的神和羊羔就是城的圣所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我没有看见城里有圣所，因为主全能的神和羊羔就是城的圣所。
verses.textZhCuv: 我未见城内有殿，因主神－全能者和羔羊为城的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: I did not see a temple in the city, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
verses.textEnEsv: And I saw no temple in the city, for its temple is the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
verses.textEnNlt: I saw no temple in the city, for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
verses.textEnNasb: I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
verses.textEn: I did not see a temple in the city, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.

verses.textZh: 这城不需要日月照明，因为有神的荣耀照明，而羊羔就是城的灯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这城不需要日月照明，因为有神的荣耀照明，而羊羔就是城的灯。
verses.textZhCuv: 那城内又不用日月光照；因有神的荣耀光照，又有羔羊为城的灯。
verses.textEnNiv: The city does not need the sun or the moon to shine on it, for the glory of God gives it light, and the Lamb is its lamp.
verses.textEnEsv: And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, for the glory of God gives it light, and its lamp is the Lamb.
verses.textEnNkjv: The city had no need of the sun or of the moon to shine in it, for the glory of God illuminated it. The Lamb is its light.
verses.textEnNlt: And the city has no need of sun or moon, for the glory of God illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its light.
verses.textEnNasb: And the city has no need of the sun or of the moon to shine on it, for the glory of God has illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
verses.textEn: The city does not need the sun or the moon to shine on it, for the glory of God gives it light, and the Lamb is its lamp.

verses.textZh: 列国要借着城的光行走，地上的众王要把他们的荣华带到这城来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国要借着城的光行走，地上的众王要把他们的荣华带到这城来。
verses.textZhCuv: 列国要在城的光里行走；地上的君王必将自己的荣耀归与那城。
verses.textEnNiv: The nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their splendor into it.
verses.textEnEsv: By its light will the nations walk, and the kings of the earth will bring their glory into it,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the nations of those who are saved shall walk in its light, and the kings of the earth bring their glory and honor into it.
verses.textEnNlt: The nations will walk in its light, and the kings of the world will enter the city in all their glory.
verses.textEnNasb: The nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their glory into it.
verses.textEn: The nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their splendor into it.

verses.textZh: 城门白天决不关闭。在那里并没有黑夜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城门白天决不关闭。在那里并没有黑夜。
verses.textZhCuv: 城门白昼总不关闭，在那里原没有黑夜。
verses.textEnNiv: On no day will its gates ever be shut, for there will be no night there.
verses.textEnEsv: and its gates will never be shut by day—and there will be no night there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Its gates shall not be shut at all by day (there shall be no night there).
verses.textEnNlt: Its gates will never be closed at the end of day because there is no night there.
verses.textEnNasb: In the daytime (for there will be no night there) its gates will never be closed;
verses.textEn: On no day will its gates ever be shut, for there will be no night there.

verses.textZh: 列国的荣华尊贵都被带到这城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国的荣华尊贵都被带到这城。
verses.textZhCuv: 人必将列国的荣耀、尊贵归与那城。
verses.textEnNiv: The glory and honor of the nations will be brought into it.
verses.textEnEsv: They will bring into it the glory and the honor of the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it.
verses.textEnNlt: And all the nations will bring their glory and honor into the city.
verses.textEnNasb: and they will bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it;
verses.textEn: The glory and honor of the nations will be brought into it.

verses.textZh: 所有不洁净的、行可憎的和说谎的，决不可以进入这城。只有名字记在羊羔生命册上的才可以进去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有不洁净的、行可憎的和说谎的，决不可以进入这城。只有名字记在羊羔生命册上的才可以进去。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡不洁净的，并那行可憎与虚谎之事的，总不得进那城；只有名字写在羔羊生命册上的才得进去。
verses.textEnNiv: Nothing impure will ever enter it, nor will anyone who does what is shameful or deceitful, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
verses.textEnEsv: But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who does what is detestable or false, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
verses.textEnNkjv: But there shall by no means enter it anything that defiles, or causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life.
verses.textEnNlt: Nothing evil will be allowed to enter, nor anyone who practices shameful idolatry and dishonesty—but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life.
verses.textEnNasb: and nothing unclean, and no one who practices abomination and lying, shall ever come into it, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
verses.textEn: Nothing impure will ever enter it, nor will anyone who does what is shameful or deceitful, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

verses.textZh: 天使又指示我一道明亮如水晶的生命水的河流，从神和羊羔的宝座那里流出来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 天使又指示我一道明亮如水晶的生命水的河流，从神和羊羔的宝座那里流出来，
verses.textZhCuv: 天使又指示我在城内街道当中一道生命水的河，明亮如水晶，从神和羔羊的宝座流出来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel showed me the river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb
verses.textEnEsv: Then the angel showed me the river of the water of life, bright as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb
verses.textEnNkjv: And he showed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding from the throne of God and of the Lamb.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel showed me a river with the water of life, clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb.
verses.textEnNasb: And he showed me a river of the water of life, clear as crystal, coming from the throne of God and of the Lamb,
verses.textEn: Then the angel showed me the river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb

verses.textZh: 经过城里的街道。河的两边有生命树，结十二次果子，每月都结果子；树叶可以医治列国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 经过城里的街道。河的两边有生命树，结十二次果子，每月都结果子；树叶可以医治列国。
verses.textZhCuv: 在河这边与那边有生命树，结十二样 果子，每月都结果子；树上的叶子乃为医治万民。
verses.textEnNiv: down the middle of the great street of the city. On each side of the river stood the tree of life, bearing twelve crops of fruit, yielding its fruit every month. And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: through the middle of the street of the city; also, on either side of the river, the tree of life with its twelve kinds of fruit, yielding its fruit each month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the middle of its street, and on either side of the river, was the tree of life, which bore twelve fruits, each tree yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: It flowed down the center of the main street. On each side of the river grew a tree of life, bearing twelve crops of fruit, with a fresh crop each month. The leaves were used for medicine to heal the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: in the middle of its street. On either side of the river was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruit, yielding its fruit every month; and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
verses.textEn: down the middle of the great street of the city. On each side of the river stood the tree of life, bearing twelve crops of fruit, yielding its fruit every month. And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.

verses.textZh: 所有咒诅都不再有了。城里有神和羊羔的宝座，他的仆人都要事奉他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有咒诅都不再有了。城里有神和羊羔的宝座，他的仆人都要事奉他，
verses.textZhCuv: 以后再没有咒诅；在城里有神和羔羊的宝座；他的仆人都要事奉他，
verses.textEnNiv: No longer will there be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city, and his servants will serve him.
verses.textEnEsv: No longer will there be anything accursed, but the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will worship him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there shall be no more curse, but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it, and His servants shall serve Him.
verses.textEnNlt: No longer will there be a curse upon anything. For the throne of God and of the Lamb will be there, and his servants will worship him.
verses.textEnNasb: There will no longer be any curse; and the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and His bond-servants will serve Him;
verses.textEn: No longer will there be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city, and his servants will serve him.

verses.textZh: 也要见他的面。他的名字必写在他们的额上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也要见他的面。他的名字必写在他们的额上。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要见他的面。他的名字必写在他们的额上。
verses.textEnNiv: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
verses.textEnEsv: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall see His face, and His name shallbe on their foreheads.
verses.textEnNlt: And they will see his face, and his name will be written on their foreheads.
verses.textEnNasb: they will see His face, and His name will be on their foreheads.
verses.textEn: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

verses.textZh: 不再有黑夜了，他们也不需要灯光或日光了，因为主神要光照他们。他们要作王，直到永永远远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不再有黑夜了，他们也不需要灯光或日光了，因为主神要光照他们。他们要作王，直到永永远远。
verses.textZhCuv: 不再有黑夜；他们也不用灯光、日光，因为主神要光照他们。他们要作王，直到永永远远。
verses.textEnNiv: There will be no more night. They will not need the light of a lamp or the light of the sun, for the Lord God will give them light. And they will reign for ever and ever.
verses.textEnEsv: And night will be no more. They will need no light of lamp or sun, for the Lord God will be their light, and they will reign forever and ever.
verses.textEnNkjv: There shall be no night there: They need no lamp nor light of the sun, for the Lord God gives them light. And they shall reign forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: And there will be no night there—no need for lamps or sun—for the Lord God will shine on them. And they will reign forever and ever.
verses.textEnNasb: And there will no longer be any night; and they will not have need of the light of a lamp nor the light of the sun, because the Lord God will illuminate them; and they will reign forever and ever.
verses.textEn: There will be no more night. They will not need the light of a lamp or the light of the sun, for the Lord God will give them light. And they will reign for ever and ever.

verses.textZh: 天使对我说："这些话是可信的、真实的！主，就是众先知之灵的神，差遣了他的天使，把那快要发生的事，指示他的仆人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 天使对我说："这些话是可信的、真实的！主，就是众先知之灵的神，差遣了他的天使，把那快要发生的事，指示他的仆人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 天使又对我说：「这些话是真实可信的。主就是众先知被感之灵的神，差遣他的使者，将那必要快成的事指示他仆人。」
verses.textEnNiv: The angel said to me, "These words are trustworthy and true. The Lord, the God who inspires the prophets, sent his angel to show his servants the things that must soon take place."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "These words are trustworthy and true. And the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent his angel to show his servants what must soon take place."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to me, "These words are faithful and true." And the Lord God of the holy prophets sent His angel to show His servants the things which must shortly take place.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel said to me, "Everything you have heard and seen is trustworthy and true. The Lord God, who inspires his prophets, has sent his angel to tell his servants what will happen soon. "
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to me, "These words are faithful and true"; and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent His angel to show His bond-servants the things which must soon take place.
verses.textEn: The angel said to me, "These words are trustworthy and true. The Lord, the God who inspires the prophets, sent his angel to show his servants the things that must soon take place."

verses.textZh: <red>"看哪！我必快来！那遵守这书上预言的人是有福的！"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"看哪！我必快来！那遵守这书上预言的人是有福的！"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 「<red>看哪，我必快来！凡遵守这书上预言的有福了！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Look, I am coming soon! Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy written in this scroll.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "And behold, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I am coming quickly! Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book."
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, I am coming soon! Blessed are those who obey the words of prophecy written in this book. "
verses.textEnNasb: "And behold, I am coming quickly. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book."
verses.textEn: <red>“Look, I am coming soon! Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy written in this scroll.”</red>

verses.textZh: 听见又看见了这些事的，就是我约翰。我听见又看见了之后，就俯伏在指示我这些事的天使脚前要拜他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 听见又看见了这些事的，就是我约翰。我听见又看见了之后，就俯伏在指示我这些事的天使脚前要拜他。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事是我－约翰所听见、所看见的；我既听见、看见了，就在指示我的天使脚前俯伏要拜他。
verses.textEnNiv: I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. And when I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had been showing them to me.
verses.textEnEsv: I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. And when I heard and saw them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who showed them to me,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I, John, saw and heard these things. And when I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who showed me these things.
verses.textEnNlt: I, John, am the one who heard and saw all these things. And when I heard and saw them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who showed them to me.
verses.textEnNasb: I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. And when I heard and saw them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who showed me these things.
verses.textEn: I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. And when I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had been showing them to me.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："千万不可以这样！我和你，以及你的弟兄众先知，还有那些遵守这书上的话的人，都是同作仆人的。你应当敬拜神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："千万不可以这样！我和你，以及你的弟兄众先知，还有那些遵守这书上的话的人，都是同作仆人的。你应当敬拜神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「千万不可！我与你和你的弟兄众先知，并那些守这书上言语的人，同是作仆人的。你要敬拜神。」
verses.textEnNiv: But he said to me, "Don’t do that! I am a fellow servant with you and with your fellow prophets and with all who keep the words of this scroll. Worship God!"
verses.textEnEsv: but he said to me, "You must not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to me, "See thatyoudo not dothat. For I am your fellow servant, and of your brethren the prophets, and of those who keep the words of this book. Worship God."
verses.textEnNlt: But he said, "No, don’t worship me. I am a servant of God, just like you and your brothers the prophets, as well as all who obey what is written in this book. Worship only God!"
verses.textEnNasb: And he *said to me, " Do not do that; I am a fellow servant of yours and of your brothers the prophets, and of those who keep the words of this book. Worship God!"
verses.textEn: But he said to me, "Don’t do that! I am a fellow servant with you and with your fellow prophets and with all who keep the words of this scroll. Worship God!"

verses.textZh: 他又对我说："不要封住这书上的预言，因为时候近了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对我说："不要封住这书上的预言，因为时候近了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又对我说：「不可封了这书上的预言，因为日期近了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he told me, "Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this scroll, because the time is near.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is near.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to me, "Do not seal the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he instructed me, "Do not seal up the prophetic words in this book, for the time is near.
verses.textEnNasb: And he *said to me, "Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is near.
verses.textEn: Then he told me, "Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this scroll, because the time is near.

verses.textZh: 不义的，要他仍旧不义；污秽的，要他仍旧污秽；行义的，要他仍旧行义；圣洁的，要他仍旧圣洁。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不义的，要他仍旧不义；污秽的，要他仍旧污秽；行义的，要他仍旧行义；圣洁的，要他仍旧圣洁。"
verses.textZhCuv: 不义的，叫他仍旧不义；污秽的，叫他仍旧污秽；为义的，叫他仍旧为义；圣洁的，叫他仍旧圣洁。」
verses.textEnNiv: Let the one who does wrong continue to do wrong; let the vile person continue to be vile; let the one who does right continue to do right; and let the holy person continue to be holy."
verses.textEnEsv: Let the evildoer still do evil, and the filthy still be filthy, and the righteous still do right, and the holy still be holy."
verses.textEnNkjv: He who is unjust, let him be unjust still; he who is filthy, let him be filthy still; he who is righteous, let him be righteous still; he who is holy, let him be holy still."
verses.textEnNlt: Let the one who is doing harm continue to do harm; let the one who is vile continue to be vile; let the one who is righteous continue to live righteously; let the one who is holy continue to be holy."
verses.textEnNasb: Let the one who does wrong still do wrong, and the one who is filthy still be filthy; and let the one who is righteous still practice righteousness, and the one who is holy still keep himself holy."
verses.textEn: Let the one who does wrong continue to do wrong; let the vile person continue to be vile; let the one who does right continue to do right; and let the holy person continue to be holy."

verses.textZh: <red>"看哪，我必快来！赏赐在我，我要照着各人所行的报应他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"看哪，我必快来！赏赐在我，我要照着各人所行的报应他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「看哪，我必快来！赏罚在我，要照各人所行的报应他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Look, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, and I will give to each person according to what they have done.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, I am coming soon, bringing my recompense with me, to repay each one for what he has done.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And behold, I am coming quickly, and My reward is with Me, to give to every one according to his work.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, I am coming soon, bringing my reward with me to repay all people according to their deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am coming quickly, and My reward is with Me, to reward each one as his work deserves.
verses.textEn: <red>“Look, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, and I will give to each person according to what they have done.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我是阿拉法，是俄梅格；我是首先的，也是末后的；我是创始的，也是成终的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我是阿拉法，是俄梅格；我是首先的，也是末后的；我是创始的，也是成终的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛；我是首先的，我是末后的；我是初，我是终。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end."
verses.textEnNkjv: I am the Alpha and the Omega, theBeginning and the End, the First and the Last."
verses.textEnNlt: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End."
verses.textEnNasb: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end."
verses.textEn: <red>I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那些洗净自己袍子的人是有福的！他们可以有权到生命树那里，也可以从门进到城里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那些洗净自己袍子的人是有福的！他们可以有权到生命树那里，也可以从门进到城里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那些洗净自己衣服的有福了！可得权柄能到生命树那里，也能从门进城。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Blessed are those who wash their robes, that they may have the right to the tree of life and may go through the gates into the city.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and that they may enter the city by the gates.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are those who do His commandments, that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter through the gates into the city.
verses.textEnNlt: Blessed are those who wash their robes. They will be permitted to enter through the gates of the city and eat the fruit from the tree of life.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they will have the right to the tree of life, and may enter the city by the gates.
verses.textEn: <red>“Blessed are those who wash their robes, that they may have the right to the tree of life and may go through the gates into the city.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在城外，有那些狗，那些行邪术的、淫乱的、杀人的、拜偶像的，以及所有喜爱说谎的和实行说谎的人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在城外，有那些狗，那些行邪术的、淫乱的、杀人的、拜偶像的，以及所有喜爱说谎的和实行说谎的人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>城外有那些犬类、行邪术的、淫乱的、杀人的、拜偶像的，并一切喜好说谎言、编造虚谎的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Outside are the dogs, those who practice magic arts, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Outside are the dogs and sorcerers and the sexually immoral and murderers and idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
verses.textEnNkjv: But outside are dogs and sorcerers and sexually immoral and murderers and idolaters, and whoever loves and practices a lie.
verses.textEnNlt: Outside the city are the dogs—the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idol worshipers, and all who love to live a lie.
verses.textEnNasb: Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral persons, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices lying.
verses.textEn: <red>Outside are the dogs, those who practice magic arts, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"差遣了我的使者、为众教会向你们证明这些事的，就是我耶稣。我是大卫的根，又是他的后裔，我是明亮的晨星。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"差遣了我的使者、为众教会向你们证明这些事的，就是我耶稣。我是大卫的根，又是他的后裔，我是明亮的晨星。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 「<red>我－耶稣差遣我的使者为众教会将这些事向你们证明。我是大卫的根，又是他的后裔。我是明亮的晨星。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I, Jesus, have sent my angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, and the bright Morning Star.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify to you about these things for the churches. I am the root and the descendant of David, the bright morning star."
verses.textEnNkjv: "I, Jesus, have sent My angel to testify to you these things in the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the Bright and Morning Star."
verses.textEnNlt: "I, Jesus, have sent my angel to give you this message for the churches. I am both the source of David and the heir to his throne. I am the bright morning star."
verses.textEnNasb: "I, Jesus, have sent My angel to testify to you of these things for the churches. I am the root and the descendant of David, the bright morning star."
verses.textEn: <red>“I, Jesus, have sent my angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, and the bright Morning Star.”</red>

verses.textZh: 圣灵和新娘都说："来！"听见的人也要说："来！"口渴的人也要来！愿意的人都要白白接受生命的水！
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣灵和新娘都说："来！"听见的人也要说："来！"口渴的人也要来！愿意的人都要白白接受生命的水！
verses.textZhCuv: 圣灵和新妇都说：「来！」听见的人也该说：「来！」口渴的人也当来；愿意的，都可以白白取生命的水喝。
verses.textEnNiv: The Spirit and the bride say, "Come!" And let the one who hears say, "Come!" Let the one who is thirsty come; and let the one who wishes take the free gift of the water of life.
verses.textEnEsv: The Spirit and the Bride say, "Come." And let the one who hears say, "Come." And let the one who is thirsty come; let the one who desires take the water of life without price.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Spirit and the bride say, "Come!" And let him who hears say, "Come!" And let him who thirsts come. Whoever desires, let him take the water of life freely.
verses.textEnNlt: The Spirit and the bride say, "Come." Let anyone who hears this say, "Come." Let anyone who is thirsty come. Let anyone who desires drink freely from the water of life.
verses.textEnNasb: The Spirit and the bride say, "Come." And let the one who hears say, "Come." And let the one who is thirsty come; let the one who desires, take the water of life without cost.
verses.textEn: The Spirit and the bride say, "Come!" And let the one who hears say, "Come!" Let the one who is thirsty come; and let the one who wishes take the free gift of the water of life.

verses.textZh: 我警告所有听见这书上预言的人：如果有人在这些预言上加添甚么，神必把写在这书上的灾难加在他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我警告所有听见这书上预言的人：如果有人在这些预言上加添甚么，神必把写在这书上的灾难加在他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我向一切听见这书上预言的作见证，若有人在这预言上加添什么，神必将写在这书上的灾祸加在他身上；
verses.textEnNiv: I warn everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this scroll: If anyone adds anything to them, God will add to that person the plagues described in this scroll.
verses.textEnEsv: I warn everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book,
verses.textEnNkjv: For I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: If anyone adds to these things, God will add to him the plagues that are written in this book;
verses.textEnNlt: And I solemnly declare to everyone who hears the words of prophecy written in this book: If anyone adds anything to what is written here, God will add to that person the plagues described in this book.
verses.textEnNasb: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues that are written in this book;
verses.textEn: I warn everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this scroll: If anyone adds anything to them, God will add to that person the plagues described in this scroll.

verses.textZh: 如果有人从这书上的预言删减甚么，神必从这书上所记的生命树和圣城删去他的分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人从这书上的预言删减甚么，神必从这书上所记的生命树和圣城删去他的分。
verses.textZhCuv: 这书上的预言，若有人删去什么，神必从这书上所写的生命树和圣城删去他的分。
verses.textEnNiv: And if anyone takes words away from this scroll of prophecy, God will take away from that person any share in the tree of life and in the Holy City, which are described in this scroll.
verses.textEnEsv: and if anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and in the holy city, which are described in this book.
verses.textEnNkjv: and if anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part from the Book of Life, from the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.
verses.textEnNlt: And if anyone removes any of the words from this book of prophecy, God will remove that person’s share in the tree of life and in the holy city that are described in this book.
verses.textEnNasb: and if anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree of life and from the holy city, which are written in this book.
verses.textEn: And if anyone takes words away from this scroll of prophecy, God will take away from that person any share in the tree of life and in the Holy City, which are described in this scroll.

verses.textZh: 证明这些事的那一位说："<red>是的，我必快来！</red>"阿们！主耶稣啊，请你来吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 证明这些事的那一位说："<red>是的，我必快来！</red>"阿们！主耶稣啊，请你来吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 证明这事的说：「<red>是了，我必快来！</red>」阿们！主耶稣啊，我愿你来！
verses.textEnNiv: He who testifies to these things says, <red>“Yes, I am coming soon.”</red> Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: He who testifies to these things says, "Surely I am coming soon." Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
verses.textEnNkjv: He who testifies to these things says, "Surely I am coming quickly." Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus!
verses.textEnNlt: He who is the faithful witness to all these things says, "Yes, I am coming soon!" Amen! Come, Lord Jesus!
verses.textEnNasb: He who testifies to these things says, "Yes, I am coming quickly." Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.
verses.textEn: He who testifies to these things says, <red>“Yes, I am coming soon.”</red> Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.

verses.textZh: 愿主耶稣的恩惠与所有的圣徒同在！阿们！
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿主耶稣的恩惠与所有的圣徒同在！阿们！
verses.textZhCuv: 愿主耶稣的恩惠常与众圣徒同在。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with God’s people. Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: May the grace of the Lord Jesus be with God’s holy people.
verses.textEnNasb: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all. Amen.
verses.textEn: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with God’s people. Amen.
